deepLinks.labelEn: US Air Force official: C-130 fact sheet

aircraft.nameZh: 波音 KC-135 同溫層加油機

engines.noteZh: R 型換裝的渦輪扇引擎

payload.noteZh: 貨物載重；另可載約 90,700 公斤燃油供轉移（視任務）
payload.noteEn: Cargo payload; it also carries up to about 90,700 kg of fuel for transfer, mission dependent

range.noteZh: 帶 68,000 公斤轉移燃油的任務航程；輕載轉場航程約 17,766 公里
range.noteEn: Mission radius with 68,000 kg of transfer fuel; ferry range about 17,766 km

photo.author: Senior Airman James Seymore, U.S. Air Force
photo.creditZh: 相片：James Seymore 上級空兵／美國空軍／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· 俄亥俄州空中國民警衛隊 KC-135R（62-3511）自土耳其因吉爾利克起飛
photo.creditEn: Photo: SrA James Seymore / U.S. Air Force / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · Ohio ANG KC-135R (62-3511) taking off from Incirlik, Türkiye
photo.captionZh: 離地一刻：四台 CFM56、軍用灰機身同短翼展的 707 家族身形齊晒。
photo.captionEn: Just airborne: four CFM56s, grey windowless body and the shorter 707-family wing.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: KC-135 家族早期型號用 J57 噴射引擎（A 型）；本卡以換裝 CFM56 引擎、至今仍是主力的 KC-135R 為代表。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Early KC-135s used J57 jets (the A model); this card uses the CFM56-re-engined KC-135R, still today's mainstay, as representative.
aircraft.introZh: 服役近七十年的空中加油站：KC-135 以飛桿（flying boom）為戰機加油，由 1950 年代撐起美國空軍的全球航程，R 型換上 CFM56 後繼續服役。
aircraft.introEn: An airborne petrol station for nearly seventy years: the KC-135's flying boom has underwritten the USAF's global reach since the 1950s, and the re-engined R model soldiers on.

history.statusZh: 服役中（1957 年 6 月交付美國空軍；共建 803 架，R 型仍是主力，正逐步由 KC-46 補充而非即時取代）。
history.statusEn: In service (delivered to the USAF from June 1957; 803 built, and the R model remains the mainstay, gradually supplemented by the KC-46).

wings.zh: 下單翼後掠，翼下四台引擎；外形源自波音 367-80／707 家族但翼展較短。
wings.en: Swept low wing with four podded engines; derived from the Boeing 367-80/707 family with a shorter span.

engines.zh: R 型四台 CFM56 引擎艙粗短（舊 A 型 J57 較幼長兼起飛注水冒黑煙，是老照片的線索）。
engines.en: Four short, fat CFM56 nacelles on the R (the old A model's slim J57s smoked with water injection on takeoff).

fuselage.zh: 軍用灰色機身幾乎無窗，上甲板可載貨載人；機腹近尾部是加油操作員艙和收起的飛桿。
fuselage.en: Nearly windowless grey fuselage with a cargo-capable upper deck; the boom operator's station and stowed flying boom sit under the rear fuselage.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼；垂直尾翼根部向前伸延，尾翼塗有空軍標誌和編號。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a dorsal fillet; USAF markings and serials on the fin.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同波音 707／E-3 預警機比：機體同源，但 KC-135 機身較窄、機腹有加油飛桿、全機軍用灰無客窗。同自家後繼者 KC-46 比：KC-46 源自 767、駕駛艙後以遙控視像加油，KC-135R 的加油員仍是伏在機腹目視操作。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Boeing 707/E-3 family: same ancestry, but the KC-135 is narrower, windowless grey and carries the refuelling boom. Versus its KC-46 successor: the newer jet uses remote camera refuelling, while the KC-135R's boom operator still lies prone and steers by eye.

engines.noteZh: 兩台渦輪扇引擎（連後燃器）

seats.noteZh: 單座（雙座教練型 2 名）

range.noteZh: 最大航程（約數，視掛載而定）

cruise.noteZh: 最大速度；不開後燃器可 Mach 1.5 超音速巡航
cruise.noteEn: Maximum speed; supercruises at Mach 1.5 without afterburner

photo.author: Chris Lofting
photo.creditZh: 相片：Chris Lofting／Wikimedia Commons（GFDL 1.2）· 英國皇家空軍 Typhoon F2（ZJ924）在威爾斯 Mach Loop 低空飛行
photo.creditEn: Photo: Chris Lofting / Wikimedia Commons (GFDL 1.2) · An RAF Typhoon F2 (ZJ924) in the Mach Loop, Wales
photo.captionZh: 低空高速的 Typhoon：三角翼、鴨翼同機腹進氣道一覽無遺。
photo.captionEn: A Typhoon at low level: delta wing, canards and chin intake all on show.

aircraft.introZh: 歐洲四國聯手研製的雙引擎戰機：三角翼加鴨翼令 Typhoon 轉彎極靈活，不用開後燃器都可以超音速巡航，是英、德、意、西等國的空防主力。
aircraft.introEn: A four-nation European twin-engine fighter: its delta wing and canards make it exceptionally agile, and it can cruise supersonically without afterburner — the backbone of British, German, Italian and Spanish air defence.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Eurofighter Typhoon」；本卡以單座生產型數據為準（另有雙座教練型；各國批次 Tranche 的航電設備有別）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Eurofighter Typhoon; this card uses the single-seat production standard (a two-seat trainer exists, and avionics vary by Tranche).

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（2003 年 8 月起服役；逾 600 架交付多國空軍，持續升級雷達和武器）。
history.statusEn: In production and in service (entered service in August 2003; over 600 delivered to several air forces, with ongoing radar and weapons upgrades).

wings.zh: 無尾三角翼（delta），翼根前緣有一對鴨翼（canard）在座艙兩側，是歐洲戰機的招牌組合。
wings.en: A tailless delta wing with canard foreplanes beside the cockpit — the classic European fighter recipe.

engines.zh: 兩台 EJ200 並列機尾，機腹是方形雙進氣道（下巴式進氣口有一塊分隔板）。
engines.en: Two EJ200s side by side, fed by a boxy twin intake under the chin.

fuselage.zh: 機身扁闊，座艙在前高高隆起，機鼻幼長；機背有一列整流脊。
fuselage.en: A wide, flat body with a high bubble cockpit and slim nose.

tail.zh: 單一高大垂直尾翼（三角翼戰機無水平尾翼，靠鴨翼和主翼後緣控制俯仰）。
tail.en: A single tall fin (no tailplanes — pitch is controlled by the canards and wing trailing edges).

aircraft.similarZh: 同法國 Rafale 比：兩者都是三角翼加鴨翼；Typhoon 鴨翼位置較前較高、進氣道在機腹正中，Rafale 鴨翼貼近主翼、進氣道在機身兩側。同 F-35 比：Typhoon 無匿蹤折角、雙引擎外露噴口，格鬥靈活度更高。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus France's Rafale: both are canard deltas, but the Typhoon's foreplanes sit higher and farther forward and its intake is a single chin box; the Rafale's canards hug the wing and its intakes are at the fuselage sides. Versus the F-35: no stealth faceting, exposed twin nozzles, and agility-first aerodynamics.

aircraft.nameZh: 波音 F/A-18F 超級大黃蜂

engines.noteZh: 通用電氣渦輪扇引擎（連後燃器）

seats.noteZh: 串列雙座（機師＋武器系統官）
seats.noteEn: Two in tandem (pilot and weapon systems officer)

cruise.noteZh: 最大速度（戰鬥機慣例在此欄列最大速度）

photo.author: U.S. Navy
photo.creditZh: 相片：美國海軍／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· VFA-102 中隊 F/A-18F 自航母甲板彈射起飛
photo.creditEn: Photo: U.S. Navy / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · An F/A-18F of VFA-102 launching from a carrier deck
photo.captionZh: 彈射起飛一刻：雙座座艙、外傾雙尾翼同方形進氣口（在翼根邊條下）都睇得到。
photo.captionEn: Catapult launch: tandem cockpit, canted twin tails and the square intakes under the LERX.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: ICAO 代碼方面，舊型 Hornet（A–D 型）用 F18，Super Hornet（E／F 型）用 F18S，本卡跟 Doc 8643 用 F18S。F 型是雙座版（單座為 E 型），同系另有 EA-18G 電子戰型。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: On ICAO codes: legacy Hornets (A–D) are F18, Super Hornets (E/F) are F18S per Doc 8643, as used here. The F is the two-seat model (E is single-seat); the EA-18G Growler is the electronic-warfare sibling.
aircraft.introZh: 美國海軍航母甲板的主力：雙座的 F/A-18F「超級大黃蜂」集空戰、對地攻擊與伙伴加油於一身，是當今產量最大的艦載戰機。
aircraft.introEn: The backbone of US Navy carrier decks: the two-seat F/A-18F Super Hornet combines air combat, strike and buddy refuelling in today's most numerous carrier fighter.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（1999 年起交付美國海軍；澳洲皇家空軍亦有 F 型，最新 Block III 型持續交付）。
history.statusEn: In production and in service (delivered to the US Navy from 1999; the Royal Australian Air Force also flies the F, and Block III jets continue to arrive).

wings.zh: 中單翼加巨大的前緣邊條（LERX）伸向座艙兩側，是大黃蜂家族的高攻角法寶；翼尖有導彈掛架。
wings.en: Mid wing with huge leading-edge extensions (LERX) reaching past the cockpit — the Hornet family's high-alpha trick; missile rails on the tips.

engines.zh: 兩台 F414 並列在機身後部，進氣口是 Super Hornet 的方形設計（舊 Hornet 是半圓形），尾噴口在雙尾翼之間。
engines.en: Two F414s side by side at the rear, fed by square intakes (legacy Hornets had semicircular ones); nozzles sit between the tails.

fuselage.zh: 串列雙座座艙（F 型），機身比舊 Hornet 大約四分之一；機鼻修長，座艙前有敵我識別天線小突起。
fuselage.en: Tandem two-seat cockpit on the F; the airframe is about a quarter bigger than the legacy Hornet, with a long nose.

tail.zh: 一對向外傾的垂直尾翼加全動水平尾翼，方便航母低速進近操控。
tail.en: Twin outward-canted fins and all-moving tailplanes, sized for slow carrier approaches.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同舊型 F/A-18C 比：Super Hornet 大一截、進氣口方形（舊型半圓）、邊條更大。同 F-35C 比（F-35 家族見 AC-0024）：F-35 是單引擎匿蹤設計，F/A-18F 是雙引擎傳統外形加大量外掛武器。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the legacy F/A-18C: the Super Hornet is much bigger with square intakes (the old jet's are semicircular) and larger LERX. Versus the F-35 (family card AC-0024): a single-engine stealth design against this twin-engine jet carrying weapons externally.

deepLinks.labelZh: 英文維基：Boeing F/A-18E/F Super Hornet
deepLinks.labelEn: English Wikipedia: Boeing F/A-18E/F Super Hornet

wingspan.noteZh: 翼展（比機身長度短得多，是三角翼特徵）
wingspan.noteEn: Wingspan (much less than the length — a delta signature)

height.noteZh: 全高（地面姿態；不同來源有 11.3–12.2 米，本卡用維基量產型數字，見 docs/05）
height.noteEn: Overall height (sources vary 11.3–12.2 m; production-aircraft figure used, see docs/05)

engines.noteZh: 勞斯萊斯／斯奈克瑪渦輪噴射引擎（連後燃器）

cruise.noteZh: 巡航速度（約 2,158 公里／小時）

photo.author: Eduard Marmet
photo.creditZh: 相片：Eduard Marmet／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 3.0）· 英國航空協和號（G-BOAC）起飛爬升（1986 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Eduard Marmet / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0) · British Airways Concorde (G-BOAC) climbing out (1986)
photo.captionZh: 招牌式大攻角爬升：垂下的機鼻、三角翼同收起中的起落架正是協和號起飛的經典畫面。
photo.captionEn: The signature steep climb: drooped nose, delta wing and retracting gear — Concorde's classic takeoff picture.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 協和號只有一個基本型號（原型、預產型與量產型尺寸相若）；本卡數字為量產型。英法兩國共建 20 架（連原型）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Concorde had a single basic model (prototypes and production aircraft were near-identical in size); figures are for production aircraft. Twenty were built in total, prototypes included.
aircraft.introZh: 民航史上唯一的超音速客運傳奇：協和號以兩倍音速、六萬呎高空載客橫越大西洋，倫敦到紐約只需約三個半小時，至今無民航機超越。
aircraft.introEn: Civil aviation's only supersonic airliner legend: Concorde crossed the Atlantic at Mach 2 and 60,000 ft, London to New York in about three and a half hours — still unmatched.

history.statusZh: 已退役（2003 年 11 月 26 日最後飛行；20 架全數保存於英、法、美等地博物館）。
history.statusEn: Retired (last flight 26 November 2003; all 20 survive in museums in Britain, France, the US and elsewhere).

wings.zh: 修長的 ogee 三角翼（前緣呈 S 形曲線），無襟翼設計，翼下是高而幼的起落架。
wings.en: A slender ogee delta wing with an S-curved leading edge and no flaps; tall, spindly gears below.

engines.zh: 四台 Olympus 引擎兩兩一組，裝在翼下兩隻長方形引擎艙內。
engines.en: Four Olympus engines in two long rectangular pods under the wing.

fuselage.zh: 針幼機身加可下垂的機鼻（droop nose）：起降時機鼻垂下讓機師看到跑道，巡航時升起並放下遮光罩。
fuselage.en: Needle fuselage with a droop nose: lowered for takeoff and landing visibility, raised with its visor for cruise.

tail.zh: 沒有水平尾翼（無尾三角翼佈局），只有一片高垂直尾翼；機尾另有小尾輪防擦尾。
tail.en: No tailplane at all (tailless delta); a single tall fin, plus a small tail bumper wheel.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同蘇聯 Tu-144 比：外形極似，但 Tu-144 機鼻後有一對可收起的小鴨翼、產量和服役期都短得多。同一般亞音速客機比：協和號無尾翼、機鼻可垂，遠望已可分辨。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Soviet Tu-144: a near-twin shape, but the Tupolev had retractable canards behind the nose and a far shorter career. Versus any subsonic airliner: no tailplane and a drooping nose give Concorde away instantly.

aircraft.nameZh: 洛克希德 SR-71 黑鳥

wingspan.noteZh: 翼展（相對機身長度異常地短）

engines.noteZh: 普惠 J58 連續放氣渦輪噴射引擎（連後燃器）
engines.noteEn: Pratt & Whitney J58 continuous-bleed turbojets with afterburners

seats.noteZh: 串列雙座（機師＋偵察系統官）
seats.noteEn: Two in tandem (pilot and reconnaissance systems officer)

range.noteZh: 作戰航程（不含空中加油）

cruise.noteZh: 巡航速度（最大可逾 Mach 3.3；高速巡航為本型常態，故列於此欄）
cruise.noteEn: Cruise speed (maximum over Mach 3.3; high-Mach cruise was its normal regime)

photo.author: USAF / Judson Brohmer
photo.creditZh: 相片：USAF／Judson Brohmer（NASA Dryden）／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· NASA 的 SR-71B（NASA 831）加油後飛越內華達山脈（1994 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: USAF / Judson Brohmer (NASA Dryden) / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · NASA's SR-71B (NASA 831) over the Sierra Nevada after refuelling (1994)
photo.captionZh: 雪山上空的黑鳥：邊條、進氣尖錐同雙尾翼齊晒；留意後座艙隆起，是教練型 B 型的記號。
photo.captionEn: The Blackbird over snowy peaks: chines, intake spikes and twin fins; note the raised rear cockpit of the B trainer.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 本卡數字為主力偵察型 SR-71A；相片中是雙座教練型 SR-71B（後座艙隆起），由 NASA 用作研究機。家族另有前身 A-12。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the main SR-71A reconnaissance model; the photo shows the SR-71B trainer (raised rear cockpit) flown by NASA. The A-12 was its predecessor.
aircraft.introZh: 史上最快的有人噴射機：SR-71「黑鳥」以三倍音速、八萬五千呎高空執行偵察，靠速度和高度避開所有攔截，服役三十多年從未被擊落。
aircraft.introEn: The fastest crewed jet aircraft ever: the SR-71 Blackbird reconnoitred at Mach 3 and 85,000 ft, outrunning every interception — none was ever shot down in over three decades.

history.statusZh: 已退役（美國空軍 1998 年退役，NASA 1999 年最後飛行；共建 32 架，多架在博物館展出——最快一架在史密森尼）。
history.statusEn: Retired (USAF retired it in 1998; NASA's last flight was 1999; 32 were built and many are museum exhibits).

wings.zh: 三角翼與機身融為一體，兩側邊條（chine）由機鼻一路伸到翼根，令全機像一片扁平的箭頭。
wings.en: Delta wing blended into the body, with chines running from the nose to the wing roots — the whole jet looks like a flat arrowhead.

engines.zh: 兩台 J58 裝在翼中段的巨型引擎艙內，進氣口前端有尖錐（spike），是黑鳥最搶眼的部件。
engines.en: Two J58s in huge nacelles mid-wing, each with a sharp intake spike — the Blackbird's most striking feature.

fuselage.zh: 全黑鈦合金機身，表面幼長扁平；地面時油箱會微漏，要到高速發熱膨脹才密封，是著名的小故事。
fuselage.en: All-black titanium fuselage, long and flat; its tanks famously seeped on the ground until heat expansion sealed them at speed.

tail.zh: 一對垂直尾翼分別裝在兩台引擎艙上方，微微向內傾；沒有水平尾翼。
tail.en: Twin fins, one atop each nacelle, canted slightly inward; no tailplane.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同前身 A-12 比：A-12 是單座、較早的 CIA 版本，外形極似（博物館常被混淆，相片要核對座艙數目）。同 U-2 比（兩者同為洛克希德高空偵察機）：U-2 是直翼慢速，SR-71 是三角翼三倍音速，完全兩個世界。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus its A-12 predecessor: the single-seat CIA jet looks nearly identical (count the cockpits in museum photos). Versus the U-2: both are Lockheed high-altitude spies, but the U-2 is a straight-wing slow sailplane next to this Mach 3 delta.

deepLinks.labelZh: 史密森尼國家航空太空博物館：SR-71 藏品頁

engines.noteZh: 兩台星形活塞引擎，各約 1,200 匹馬力
engines.noteEn: Two radial piston engines of about 1,200 hp each

seats.noteZh: 民用客機佈局（初版含臥鋪型 DST）

range.noteZh: 典型載客航程；最大燃油時可達約 2,400 公里（各來源有出入，見 docs/05）
range.noteEn: Typical passenger range; up to about 2,400 km with maximum fuel (sources vary, see docs/05)

photo.author: Peter Bakema
photo.creditZh: 相片：Peter Bakema／Wikimedia Commons（GFDL 1.2）· Super Constellation Flyers Association 的 DC-3（HB-IRJ，Breitling 塗裝）在日內瓦（2012 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Peter Bakema / Wikimedia Commons (GFDL 1.2) · The Super Constellation Flyers Association's DC-3 (HB-IRJ, Breitling colours) at Geneva (2012)
photo.captionZh: 尾輪式停機姿態：機鼻昂起、星形引擎同大尾翼，正是 1930 年代客機的標準像。
photo.captionEn: Tail-down parked stance: nose high, radial engines and a big rounded tail — the 1930s airliner profile.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 本卡數字為民用 DC-3；軍用版 C-47 Skytrain／Dakota 是二戰產量最大的運輸機之一，連蘇聯仿製的 Li-2，家族總產量逾 16,000 架。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the civil DC-3; the military C-47 Skytrain/Dakota was among WWII's most-produced transports, and with the Soviet Li-2 the family exceeded 16,000 aircraft.
aircraft.introZh: 改變世界航空旅行的飛機：DC-3 在 1935 年把安全、舒適、賺錢的民航變成現實，二戰時化身 C-47 空運主力，九十年後仍有少量在飛。
aircraft.introEn: The aeroplane that changed air travel: in 1935 the DC-3 made airlines safe, comfortable and profitable, became the C-47 workhorse of WWII, and a few still fly ninety years on.

history.statusZh: 已退役出定期航班，但全球仍有少量作觀光、貨運和紀念飛行；民用版建 607 架，連軍用版家族逾 16,000 架。
history.statusEn: Retired from scheduled service, but a small number still fly sightseeing, cargo and memorial flights; 607 civil aircraft, over 16,000 including military versions.

wings.zh: 低翼，中段平直、外段後掠收尖；翼下是可收起的主起落架（向前收）。
wings.en: Low wing with a straight centre section and tapered outer panels; main gears retract forward into the nacelles.

engines.zh: 兩台星形活塞引擎，圓形引擎罩加三葉螺旋槳，是活塞客機年代的標準樣貌。
engines.en: Two radial piston engines in round cowlings with three-blade propellers — the classic piston-airliner look.

fuselage.zh: 全金屬圓筒機身，窗戶一排方形小窗；尾輪式設計令停機時機鼻高高昂起。
fuselage.en: All-metal circular fuselage with a row of small square windows; the tailwheel layout parks it nose-high.

tail.zh: 大型垂直尾翼加低置水平尾翼，線條圓潤，帶 1930 年代的流線風格。
tail.en: Large rounded fin and low tailplane in 1930s streamline style.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 DC-2 比：DC-3 機身更闊更長（DC-2 載 14 人，DC-3 載 21 人以上）。同二戰對手 C-47 分辨：其實是同一家族軍用版，外觀幾乎一樣（軍用版多天窗和貨艙門）。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus its DC-2 parent: the DC-3 is wider and longer (14 seats grew to 21-plus). Versus the C-47: it is the same family in uniform — look for military windows and the big cargo door.

engines.noteZh: 由修車師傅 Charlie Taylor 六星期內手工製成，鏈條驅動兩副螺旋槳
engines.noteEn: Hand-built in six weeks by mechanic Charlie Taylor; chain drive to two propellers

seats.noteZh: 機師伏臥在下翼上操控
seats.noteEn: The pilot lay prone on the lower wing

range.noteZh: 最長一次飛行 260 米（59 秒）；全日四次共飛約 1 分 42 秒
range.noteEn: Longest single flight 260 m (59 s); four flights totalled about 1 min 42 s

cruise.noteZh: 最大速度約 48 公里／小時（本機只有「飛行速度」，此欄列其最快速度）
cruise.noteEn: Maximum speed about 48 km/h (its only flying speed; shown here as fastest)

photo.author: John T. Daniels
photo.creditZh: 相片：John T. Daniels／美國國會圖書館／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· 1903 年 12 月 17 日 10:35 人類首次動力飛行（Orville 駕駛，Wilbur 在翼側奔跑）
photo.creditEn: Photo: John T. Daniels / Library of Congress / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · The first powered flight, 17 December 1903, 10:35 (Orville at the controls, Wilbur running at the wingtip)
photo.captionZh: 航空史最著名的一張相：飛行器剛離開木軌，Orville 伏在翼上，Wilbur 剛放開右翼——由救生員 Daniels 按下快門。
photo.captionEn: Aviation's most famous photograph: the Flyer just off the rail, Orville prone aboard, Wilbur having just let go — lifesaver Daniels worked the shutter.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: ICAO 代碼：無——ICAO 機型代碼制度在 1903 年並不存在，本機亦從未有過代碼，卡面以「—」如實標示（是全清單唯一沒有代碼的機型）。全世界只建了一架，只在 1903 年 12 月 17 日飛了四次。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: ICAO code: none — the ICAO designator system did not exist in 1903 and this aircraft never had one; the card shows '—' honestly (the only aircraft in this guide without a code). Only one was built and it flew just four times, all on 17 December 1903.
aircraft.introZh: 一切的起點：1903 年 12 月 17 日，萊特兄弟的飛行器一號在北卡羅來納州完成人類首次有動力、可操控、持續的飛行，第一趟只飛了 12 秒、37 米，卻打開了航空時代。
aircraft.introEn: Where it all began: on 17 December 1903 the Wright Flyer made the first powered, controlled, sustained flight — just 12 seconds and 37 metres, but it opened the aerial age.

history.statusZh: 唯一一架原機保存於美國史密森尼國家航空太空博物館（1903 年當日第四次飛行後被強風吹翻損壞，此後沒有再飛）。
history.statusEn: The sole original survives at the Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum (it was wrecked by a gust after its fourth flight that day and never flew again).

wings.zh: 雙層翼（上下兩片）以木柱和鋼線拉緊，布面覆蓋；靠「扭翼」（wing warping）拉動翼尖轉彎，是現代副翼的祖先。
wings.en: Biplane wings braced with struts and wires under fabric; roll control by wing-warping — twisting the tips, ancestor of the aileron.

engines.zh: 一台 12 匹馬力引擎橫置在下翼，用單車鏈帶動翼後的兩副推進螺旋槳（一正一反轉，抵消扭力）。
engines.en: One 12 hp engine on the lower wing, driving two pusher propellers by bicycle chains (counter-rotating to cancel torque).

fuselage.zh: 根本沒有機艙：機師伏臥在下翼上，雙腳旁有控制桿；起飛靠滑橇沿木軌滑出，沒有起落架。
fuselage.en: No fuselage at all: the pilot lay prone on the lower wing beside the controls; it launched on skids along a wooden rail, with no wheels.

tail.zh: 升降舵在機頭前方（前置鴨翼式），雙方向舵在螺旋槳之後；與現代飛機前後倒轉，是先驅時代的標誌。
tail.en: The elevator sits ahead of the nose (canard style) and twin rudders behind the propellers — front-to-back opposite of modern aircraft.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同後繼者 Flyer II／III 比：外形相近，但 III 型（1905 年）才是第一架真正實用、可盤旋久飛的飛機。同現代輕型機比（例如 Cessna 172，本網 AC-0015 有卡）：控制面位置、推進方式全部倒轉，可見百年演變。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus its own Flyer II/III successors: similar shapes, but the 1905 Flyer III was the first truly practical aircraft that could circle and stay up. Versus a modern light aircraft (Cessna 172, card AC-0015): every control and the propellers sit at the opposite end — a century of evolution in one comparison.

deepLinks.labelZh: 美國國家公園管理局：萊特兄弟紀念地
deepLinks.labelEn: US National Park Service: Wright Brothers National Memorial

deepLinks.labelZh: Wikimedia Commons：Wright Flyer 圖庫分類

aircraft.nameZh: 安東諾夫 An-225 夢想

engines.noteZh: 六台渦輪扇引擎（每邊三台）

range.noteZh: 無載重最大航程（載重時大幅減少）
range.noteEn: Maximum range without cargo (much less when loaded)

photo.author: Dmitry Avdeev
photo.creditZh: 相片：Dmitry Avdeev／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 3.0）· 安東諾夫 An-225（UR-82060）於 2001 年莫斯科航展
photo.creditEn: Photo: Dmitry Avdeev / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0) · Antonov An-225 (UR-82060) at MAKS 2001, Moscow
photo.captionZh: 由機尾望去：雙垂直尾翼同右翼三台引擎一覽無遺，地面人群正好襯托出它的巨大。
photo.captionEn: From behind: the twin tails and three engines under the right wing; the crowd below shows its sheer size.

annotations.zh: 右翼三台 D-18T 引擎

aircraft.introZh: 人類有史以來最大的飛機：六台引擎、84 米長，原本為蘇聯太空穿梭機計劃設計；唯一一架在 2022 年於烏克蘭戰火中被毀。
aircraft.introEn: The largest aeroplane ever built: six engines and 84 m long, designed for the Soviet space-shuttle programme; the sole example was destroyed in Ukraine in 2022.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單寫「Antonov An-225」；An-225 只建成一架（UR-82060），本卡即以該機數據為準。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list names the Antonov An-225; only one was ever completed (UR-82060), and this card uses its data.

history.statusZh: 已損毀（2022 年 2 月 27 日在基輔附近霍斯托梅爾機場被毀；安東諾夫公司表示希望重建第二架未完成的機體）。
history.statusEn: Destroyed (on 27 February 2022 at Hostomel Airport near Kyiv; Antonov hopes to complete the unfinished second airframe).

wings.zh: 高單翼大幅後掠，翼下每邊吊掛三台引擎。
wings.en: High, strongly swept wing with three engines under each side.

engines.zh: 六台 D-18T 一字排開，是民用／運輸機中罕見的六引擎佈局。
engines.en: Six D-18T turbofans in a row — a rare six-engine layout.

fuselage.zh: 機身粗大；機鼻可整段向上揭起入貨，貨艙長 43 米。
fuselage.en: Huge fuselage; the nose hinges up for loading into a 43 m cargo hold.

tail.zh: 雙垂直尾翼（H 形尾），為背馱太空梭時避開亂流而設計。
tail.en: Twin vertical tails (H-tail), designed to keep rudders clear of a shuttle carried on the back.

aircraft.similarZh: 同細佬 An-124 比（本網有卡）：An-225 長約 15 米、六引擎（An-124 四引擎）、雙垂尾（An-124 單垂尾），而且沒有機尾入貨門。同 C-5 Galaxy 比：An-225 更大、更多引擎。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus its smaller brother the An-124 (also in this guide): about 15 m longer, six engines instead of four, twin tails instead of one, and no rear loading door. Versus the C-5 Galaxy: bigger, with more engines.

aircraft.nameZh: 波音 B-17 空中堡壘

engines.noteZh: 四台星形活塞引擎，各約 1,200 匹（連渦輪增壓）
engines.noteEn: Four radial piston engines of about 1,200 hp each (turbo-supercharged)

seats.noteZh: 十名機組（機師、投彈手、炮手等）
seats.noteEn: Crew of ten (pilots, bombardier, gunners and others)

payload.noteZh: 短程任務炸彈量；長程任務約 2,000 公斤
payload.noteEn: Bomb load on short missions; about 2,000 kg on long ones

range.noteZh: 攜 2,700 公斤炸彈時航程
range.noteEn: Range with a 2,700 kg bomb load

photo.author: MSgt. Ken Hammond, U.S. Air Force
photo.creditZh: 相片：Ken Hammond 軍士長／美國空軍／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· 修復後的 B-17G「Shoo Shoo Shoo Baby」（42-32076）試飛（1988 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: MSgt. Ken Hammond / U.S. Air Force / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · Restored B-17G 'Shoo Shoo Shoo Baby' (42-32076) on a test flight (1988)
photo.captionZh: 空中側面：四台星形引擎、透明機鼻、下巴炮塔同大尾翼——G 型的特徵齊晒。
photo.captionEn: In-flight profile: four radials, glazed nose, chin turret and tall fin — all the G model's marks.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: B-17 有 A 至 G 多個型號；本卡以產量最大、二戰後期的 B-17G（8,680 架，連下巴炮塔）為代表。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The B-17 ran from A to G models; this card uses the B-17G (8,680 built, with the chin turret), the main late-war production model.
aircraft.introZh: 二戰美國日間精確轟炸的象徵：B-17「空中堡壘」以十人機組、十三挺機槍和驚人的抗損能力聞名，不少重傷機身仍能帶機員返航。
aircraft.introEn: The symbol of US daylight precision bombing: the B-17 Flying Fortress, with a crew of ten and thirteen guns, became legendary for bringing crews home in shot-up airframes.

history.statusZh: 已退役（1936–1945 年共建 12,731 架；戰後轉作救護、消防等用途，今日只有少數仍可飛的紀念機）。
history.statusEn: Retired (12,731 built 1936–1945; postwar roles included rescue and firefighting, and only a handful of warbirds still fly).

wings.zh: 低翼，翼面闊大；四台引擎沿翼前緣排開，是戰時新聞片中最易認的剪影。
wings.en: Low, broad wing with four engines along the leading edge — one of the most recognisable silhouettes in wartime newsreels.

engines.zh: 四台星形活塞引擎連渦輪增壓器，三葉螺旋槳；引擎艙後有大型排氣。
engines.en: Four turbo-supercharged radials with three-blade propellers and big exhausts behind the nacelles.

fuselage.zh: 機鼻透明投彈艙、機頂炮塔、機腹球形炮塔和腰部槍位遍佈全機；G 型機鼻下多一座下巴炮塔。
fuselage.en: Glazed bombardier nose, dorsal and ball turrets and waist guns all over; the G model adds a chin turret under the nose.

tail.zh: 巨大垂直尾翼（晚期型加高），尾端有尾槍座；高尾翼是 B-17 與 B-24 的主要分野。
tail.en: Tall single fin (raised on late models) with a tail-gun position — the clear split from the twin-tailed B-24.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同 B-24 解放者比：B-24 是高翼加雙尾翼、航程較遠；B-17 低翼單大尾，抗損名聲更響。同現代 C-130 比（本網 AC-0026 有卡）：同為四發，但一個是活塞轟炸機、一個是渦槳運輸機，任務完全不同。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the B-24 Liberator: high wing and twin tails there, longer range; the B-17's low wing and single tall fin carried the toughness legend. Versus the modern C-130 (card AC-0026): both four-engined, but a piston bomber against a turboprop transport.

deepLinks.labelZh: 英文維基：Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress
deepLinks.labelEn: English Wikipedia: Boeing B-17 Flying Fortress

aircraft.nameZh: 空中巴士 BelugaXL 大白鯨

cruise.noteZh: 巡航速度（受巨大機身氣動限制而較慢，ICAO Doc 8643 數字）
cruise.noteEn: Cruise speed (limited by the huge fuselage; ICAO Doc 8643 figure)

photo.author: Julien Jeany
photo.creditZh: 相片：Julien Jeany／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· BelugaXL（F-WBXL）首飛當日爬升（2018 年 7 月 19 日，裁切版）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Julien Jeany / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · BelugaXL (F-WBXL) climbing on its maiden flight (19 July 2018; cropped version)
photo.captionZh: 首飛爬升：白鯨笑臉、巨型貨艙背部同翼下「BELUGA」字樣齊晒。
photo.captionEn: Maiden-flight climb: smiling whale face, giant cargo hump and 'BELUGA' lettering under the wing.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: ICAO 正式名稱為 A-330-700，代碼 A337；本卡數字為 BelugaXL（A330-743L）。全數只建 6 架，全部由空中巴士自家物流公司營運，不對外售賣。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: ICAO calls it the A-330-700, designator A337; figures are for the BelugaXL (A330-743L). Only six were built, all flown by Airbus's own transport company and never sold.
aircraft.introZh: 天上最可愛的貨機：BelugaXL 以 A330 為基礎加大貨艙，一次過運兩隻 A350 機翼，在歐洲各工廠之間接送飛機部件，機頭還畫上白鯨笑臉。
aircraft.introEn: The sky's friendliest freighter: based on the A330, the BelugaXL carries two A350 wings at once between Airbus factories across Europe — with a smiling whale face painted on the nose.

history.statusZh: 服役中（6 架全數交付，接替上一代 A300-600ST 大白鯨（本網 AC-0059 有卡）的歐洲部件運輸任務）。
history.statusEn: In service (all six delivered, taking over European component transport from the earlier A300-600ST Beluga, card AC-0059 in this guide).

wings.zh: 沿用 A330 的下單翼連小翼，在巨型機身之下顯得比例特別修長。
wings.en: The A330's low wing with winglets, looking slender beneath the giant fuselage.

engines.zh: 兩台 Trent 700 吊掛翼下，與 A330-200F（本網 AC-0011）同款動力。
engines.en: Two Trent 700s under the wing — the same power as the A330-200F (card AC-0011).

fuselage.zh: 機身上半部膨脹成直徑 8.8 米的巨型貨艙（全球最大截面之一）；駕駛艙被壓到貨艙地板之下，機頭貨艙門可向上掀開。
fuselage.en: The upper fuselage swells into an 8.8 m cargo hold, among the world's largest cross-sections; the cockpit is lowered beneath the cargo floor and the nose door swings up.

tail.zh: A330 式尾翼加大了垂直尾翼和尾端整流，機尾有輔助尾翼面穩定巨型機身。
tail.en: Enlarged A330-style tail with extra fin area and endplate surfaces to steady the huge body.

aircraft.recognitionSource: 原創撰寫：WEFT 四項（見 docs/02）
aircraft.similarZh: 同上一代 A300-600ST 大白鯨比（本網 AC-0059 有卡）：XL 長多 6 米、貨艙闊多 1 米、可以一架運兩隻 A350 翼（舊型只能一隻），而且換上較新的 A330 底盤。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the earlier A300-600ST Beluga (card AC-0059): the XL is 6 m longer and 1 m wider, carries two A350 wings at once instead of one, and sits on the newer A330 platform.

seats.noteZh: 波音官方兩級艙範圍；典型約 248 座

range.noteZh: 典型兩級艙約 7,305 海里；波音官網現以最高 8,000 海里宣傳，見 docs/05
range.noteEn: Typical two-class about 7,305 nmi; Boeing now markets up to 8,000 nmi — see docs/05

photo.author: Alan Wilson
photo.creditZh: 相片：Alan Wilson／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 全日空 787-8（JA807A）降落東京成田
photo.creditEn: Photo: Alan Wilson / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · ANA 787-8 (JA807A) landing at Tokyo Narita
photo.captionZh: 降落前側面全景：拉直的翼尖、鋸齒引擎尾緣同順滑機鼻一次過睇齊。
photo.captionEn: Side profile on approach: raked wingtips, chevron engine nozzles and the smooth nose in one view.

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規清單指定「B787-8」；本卡正是 787 家族最短的 -8（同系列 -9、-10 機身更長，記得用長度同座位數分清楚）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list specifies the B787-8; this card is exactly that — the shortest 787 (the -9 and -10 are longer, so use length and seating to tell them apart).
aircraft.introZh: 夢幻客機始祖：首款大量使用複合材料的廣體客機，窗大、安靜，專門開拓又長又唔算多人坐的新航線。
aircraft.introEn: The original Dreamliner: the first airliner built mainly from composites, with big windows and a quiet cabin, made to open long, thinner new routes.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（2011 年由全日空首航）
history.statusEn: In production and in service (entered service with All Nippon Airways in 2011)

wings.zh: 下單翼，翼尖向後拉直的 raked 翼尖，沒有向上翹的小翼，飛行時機翼彎起弧度明顯。
wings.en: Low wing with straight raked wingtips and no upturned winglets; the wing flexes visibly in flight.

engines.zh: 兩台大風扇引擎（GEnx-1B 或 Trent 1000），引擎艙後緣有鋸齒紋，幫助減低噪音。
engines.en: Two large engines (GEnx-1B or Trent 1000) with serrated chevrons at the back of the nacelle to cut noise.

fuselage.zh: 廣體機身線條順滑，機鼻微微下垂，駕駛艙四塊黑窗，客窗比舊款飛機大。
fuselage.en: A smooth widebody shape with a gently drooped nose, four black cockpit panes and larger passenger windows.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼後掠，機尾尖細。
tail.en: Conventional swept tail with a tapered tail cone.

aircraft.similarZh: 同空中巴士 A350-900 比：787-8 機身較短、沒有黑色駕駛艙眼罩，翼尖是拉直的 raked 翼尖；A350 翼尖向上彎，兼有搶眼的黑色眼罩窗框。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Airbus A350-900: the 787-8 is shorter, has no black cockpit mask, and uses straight raked wingtips; the A350 has curved-up wingtips and the striking black mask.

aircraft.nameZh: 奧古斯塔偉士蘭 AW139 直升機

seats.noteZh: 最多乘客（另加 1–2 名機員）

range.noteZh: 連輔助油箱、無預留燃油時最大航程
range.noteEn: Max range with auxiliary tank, no reserve

photo.author: James (Flickr: Aircaft @ Gloucestershire Airport By James)
photo.creditZh: 相片：James／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· Babcock 離岸服務 AW139（G-PERB）
photo.creditEn: Photo: James / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Babcock offshore AW139 (G-PERB)
photo.captionZh: 地面側面全相：機鼻向右，五葉主旋翼、大窗客艙同左面尾旋翼都睇得清楚。
photo.captionEn: Ground side profile, nose to the right: five-blade main rotor, big cabin windows and the tail rotor are all clear.

annotations.zh: 五葉主旋翼（直徑 13.8 米）
大型方形客艙窗，最多 15 名乘客
annotations.en: Large square cabin windows, up to 15 passengers

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規寫「Agusta Westland AW-139」；2016 年起品牌改名 Leonardo，本卡規格以標準 AW139 為準。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list says “Agusta Westland AW-139”; the brand became Leonardo in 2016. Specs are for the standard AW139.
aircraft.introZh: 意大利 Leonardo 的中型雙引擎直升機，同級全球最暢銷之一：離岸石油平台運輸、搜救同醫療後送都常見，客艙大、速度快。
aircraft.introEn: Leonardo's medium twin-engine helicopter from Italy and one of the world's best sellers in its class: offshore transport, search and rescue, and air ambulance work, with a big cabin and high cruise speed.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（2003 年投入服務；全球交付超過 1,300 架）
history.statusEn: In production and in service (entered service in 2003; over 1,300 delivered worldwide)

wings.zh: 五葉主旋翼，旋翼轂高高企起；旋翼直徑 13.8 米，轉動時好有存在感。
wings.en: Five-blade main rotor on a tall mast; the 13.8 m rotor disc is hard to miss.

engines.zh: 兩台 PT6C-67C 渦輪軸引擎並排裝喺機艙頂，機身兩側有圓形排氣口。
engines.en: Two PT6C-67C turboshafts side by side on top of the cabin, with round exhausts on the fuselage sides.

fuselage.zh: 機艙又闊又方，一排大型方形窗；兩側有短翼艙收起落架，機鼻圓鈍向下斜。
fuselage.en: A wide, boxy cabin with a row of large square windows; sponsons on both sides house the retractable gear, and the nose is rounded.

tail.zh: 尾梁向後收細，高垂直尾翼末端有傳統尾旋翼同水平安定面——唔係涵道式。
tail.en: A tapered tail boom with a tall fin, a conventional tail rotor and a horizontal stabiliser — no fenestron.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 H175 比：兩款都係雙引擎中型直升機兼香港常見搜救級別；AW139 機身較短（16.66 米對 18.06 米，旋翼轉動計），客艙窗較方，尾旋翼係外露式；H175 用五葉主旋翼加較修長機身。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the H175: both are medium twins in the SAR class. The AW139 is shorter (16.66 m vs 18.06 m, rotors turning) with squarer cabin windows and an exposed tail rotor; the H175 has a five-blade main rotor and a sleeker fuselage.

length.noteZh: 旋翼轉動時全長（EASA 型號證書數據）
length.noteEn: Overall length, rotors turning (EASA type-certificate data)

engines.noteZh: 渦輪軸引擎，每台起飛功率 1,776 shp

seats.noteZh: 最多乘客（海上運輸版通常 16 座）

range.noteZh: Airbus 官方最大航程；EASA 資料另有 1,259 km（測試條件不同），見 docs/05 #8
range.noteEn: Airbus official max range; EASA-derived data also quotes 1,259 km under different conditions — see docs/05 #8

photo.author: N509FZ
photo.creditZh: 相片：N509FZ／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 香港政府飛行服務隊 H175（B-LVG）
photo.creditEn: Photo: N509FZ / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Hong Kong Government Flying Service H175 (B-LVG)
photo.captionZh: 飛行服務隊 B-LVG 停喺海旁直升機坪，機鼻向左：成架機嘅側面、五葉旋翼同尾旋翼一次過睇晒。
photo.captionEn: GFS B-LVG on a harbour-side helipad, nose to the left: the whole side profile, five-blade rotor and tail rotor in one frame.

annotations.zh: 五葉主旋翼（直徑 14.8 米）
大客艙窗（最多 18 名乘客）

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 前稱 Eurocopter EC175；中國合產版叫 AC352（早期稱直-15）。香港政府飛行服務隊用 H175 做長程搜救，相片正是飛行服務隊的 B-LVG。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Formerly the Eurocopter EC175; the Chinese co-production version is the AC352 (earlier called Z-15). Hong Kong's Government Flying Service flies the H175 on long-range SAR — the photo is GFS B-LVG itself.
aircraft.introZh: 空中巴士「超中型」雙引擎直升機：航程遠、客艙大。香港政府飛行服務隊 2018 年起用佢接替超級美洲豹做搜救，喺灣仔直升機場同赤鱲角都見得到。
aircraft.introEn: Airbus's “super-medium” twin: long range and the biggest cabin in its class. Hong Kong's Government Flying Service has flown it on search and rescue since 2018, replacing the Super Puma; look for it at Wan Chai heliport and Chek Lap Kok.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（2014 年 12 月由比利時 NHV 首投入離岸服務；香港飛行服務隊 2018 年起服役）
history.statusEn: In production and in service (entered service with NHV of Belgium in December 2014; Hong Kong GFS since 2018)

wings.zh: 五葉主旋翼，葉片闊、轉速慢，飛行特別寧靜；旋翼直徑 14.8 米。
wings.en: Five-blade main rotor with wide, slow-turning blades for a quiet ride; 14.8 m diameter.

engines.zh: 兩台 PT6C-67E 並排喺機艙頂，機身側有圓形排氣口；用 Helionix 航電。
engines.en: Two PT6C-67E turboshafts on top of the cabin with round side exhausts; Helionix avionics.

fuselage.zh: 機身修長，客艙窗又大又多；起落架可收起，兩側有短艙；政府飛行服務隊塗裝係灰綠色加黃色尾旋翼尖。
fuselage.en: A sleek fuselage with many large cabin windows and retractable gear in side sponsons; the GFS scheme is grey-green with yellow tail-rotor tips.

tail.zh: 傳統三葉尾旋翼裝喺尾fin右側（相片角度），尾梁幼長，水平安定面喺尾梁中段。
tail.en: A conventional three-blade tail rotor on the fin (right side in this photo), a slim tail boom and a mid-boom horizontal stabiliser.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 AW139 比：H175 機身明顯較長（18.06 米對 16.66 米，旋翼轉動計），主旋翼得五葉但直徑更大，客艙窗較密；AW139 窗較方、機身較短粗。兩款都係搜救主力，睇長度同窗形最易分。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the AW139: the H175 is visibly longer (18.06 m vs 16.66 m rotors turning) with more, rounder cabin windows; the AW139 is shorter and boxier with square windows. Length and window shape are the quickest separators.

香港政府飛行服務隊（用家）

engines.noteZh: 渦輪軸引擎，每台起飛功率 697 kW（935 hp）
engines.noteEn: Turboshafts, 697 kW (935 hp) take-off power each

seats.noteZh: 最多乘客（另加 1–2 名機員）

photo.author: James (Flickr: Aircaft @ Gloucestershire Airport By James)
photo.creditZh: 相片：James／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 私人 EC155 B1（M-LIZI，牛津機場）
photo.creditEn: Photo: James / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Private EC155 B1 (M-LIZI, Oxford Airport)
photo.captionZh: 地面側面，機鼻向右：涵道尾旋翼、五葉主旋翼同大客艙窗係辨認重點。
photo.captionEn: Ground side view, nose to the right: fenestron, five-blade rotor and the big cabin windows are the recognition points.

annotations.zh: 五葉主旋翼（直徑 12.6 米）
加大客艙大窗（最多 13 名乘客）

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 2015 年起改稱 Airbus H155；本卡跟章規用 B1 型——2002 年 11 月香港政府飛行服務隊係全球首個 B1 用家。相片 M-LIZI 本身正係 EC155 B1（機身序號 6771）。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Renamed Airbus H155 in 2015; this card follows the badge list's B1 — first delivered to Hong Kong's Government Flying Service in November 2002. The photo aircraft M-LIZI is itself an EC155 B1 (c/n 6771).
aircraft.introZh: 法國「海豚」家族的加大客艙版：五葉旋翼加涵道尾旋翼，飛得靜、坐得闊。香港飛行服務隊 2002 年率先用 B1 型，之後先由 H175 接棒。
aircraft.introEn: The big-cabin member of the French Dauphin family: five-blade rotor and a shrouded fenestron tail rotor for a quiet, roomy ride. Hong Kong's GFS was the B1 launch operator in 2002, before the H175 took over.

history.statusZh: 服役中（1999 年 3 月起交付 EC155 B；B1 型 2002 年 11 月首交付香港政府飛行服務隊；2015 年改稱 H155）
history.statusEn: In service (EC155 B deliveries from March 1999; the B1 was first delivered to Hong Kong GFS in November 2002; renamed H155 in 2015)

wings.zh: 五葉 Spheriflex 主旋翼，葉片幼長，轉動時震動低、噪音細。
wings.en: Five-blade Spheriflex main rotor with slim blades, tuned for low vibration and noise.

engines.zh: 兩台 Arriel 2C2 渦輪軸引擎喺機艙頂，引擎艙整流罩圓滑向後收。
engines.en: Two Arriel 2C2 turboshafts on top of the cabin under a smooth, tapering engine cowling.

fuselage.zh: 海豚家族入面最闊的客艙，一排大窗；機鼻圓滑，起落架可收起。相片黑白色機身係私人 VIP 塗裝。
fuselage.en: The widest cabin in the Dauphin family with a row of large windows, a rounded nose and retractable gear. The photo shows a black-and-white VIP scheme.

tail.zh: 招牌涵道尾旋翼（Fenestron）藏喺大垂直尾翼入面，尾翼下面有刀片形小翼——海豚家族一眼認得的記號。
tail.en: The signature fenestron — a shrouded fan inside the big vertical fin, with a small ventral fin below. The classic Dauphin giveaway.

aircraft.similarZh: 同直-9 比：兩款同屬海豚家族，都有涵道尾旋翼；EC155 B1 客艙明顯較闊較高、主旋翼五葉，機身長 14.3 米；直-9 係中國授權生產型，機身較窄（12.11 米、四葉主旋翼），多見軍用灰綠塗裝。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Z-9: both are Dauphin family with fenestrons. The EC155 B1 has a visibly wider, taller cabin, a five-blade rotor and a 14.3 m fuselage; the Chinese-built Z-9 is narrower (12.11 m, four blades) and usually wears military grey-green.

deepLinks.labelEn: Hong Kong Government Flying Service (B1 launch operator)

aircraft.nameZh: 哈爾濱 直-9 直升機

engines.noteZh: 渦軸-8A 渦輪軸引擎，每台 632 kW（848 hp）；株洲航空發動機廠製
engines.noteEn: WZ-8A turboshafts, 632 kW (848 hp) each, by Zhuzhou Aeroengine Factory

range.noteZh: 連機內輔助油箱的轉場航程
range.noteEn: Ferry range with internal auxiliary tank

photo.author: POA(Phot) Owen King / MOD
photo.creditZh: 相片：POA(Phot) Owen King／英國國防部 MOD，經 Wikimedia Commons（OGL v1.0）· 中國海軍直-9 離開英艦 HMS Cornwall 甲板
photo.creditEn: Photo: POA(Phot) Owen King / UK MOD, via Wikimedia Commons (OGL v1.0) · PLAN Z-9 departing HMS Cornwall's deck
photo.captionZh: 飛行中的側面：機鼻向右，涵道尾旋翼喺左面尾fin，灰色海軍塗裝加紅色軍徽好清楚。
photo.captionEn: In flight, nose to the right: the fenestron sits in the left-hand fin, with naval grey paint and red PLA markings.

annotations.zh: 四葉主旋翼（直徑 11.94 米）

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 直-9 係法國 AS365「海豚」的中國授權生產型，所以 ICAO 機型代碼同海豚共用 AS65，北約代號同樣叫 Haitun（海豚）。系列包括運輸型、武裝型直-9W 同艦載型直-9C；規格以直-9B 為準，相片係海軍艦載型。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The Z-9 is China's licence-built AS365 Dauphin, so it shares the Dauphin's ICAO designator AS65 and the NATO name Haitun (“Dolphin”). The family spans transport, armed Z-9W and naval Z-9C versions; specs are for the Z-9B and the photo shows a naval aircraft.
aircraft.introZh: 哈爾濱飛機製造的通用直升機：法國海豚的中國版，解放軍陸、海、空軍都大量使用，艦載版成日喺軍艦甲板升降，係中國最具代表性的國產直升機家族之一。
aircraft.introEn: Harbin's licence-built Dauphin is China's all-service utility helicopter: flown by the army, navy and air force, with naval versions working from ship decks — one of China's signature home-produced helicopter families.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（1981 年首飛；國產化直-9B 1994 年入列解放軍）
history.statusEn: In production and in service (first flight 1981; the indigenised Z-9B entered PLA service in 1994)

wings.zh: 四葉主旋翼，旋翼直徑 11.94 米；旋翼轂比 EC155 矮貼。
wings.en: Four-blade main rotor of 11.94 m diameter, with a lower-profile hub than the EC155.

engines.zh: 兩台渦軸-8A 並排喺機艙頂，佈局同法國海豚原設計一樣。
engines.en: Two WZ-8A turboshafts side by side above the cabin, in the original Dauphin layout.

fuselage.zh: 水滴形機身、圓機鼻、階梯式駕駛艙窗，起落架可收起，機底平直；軍用機多為灰或灰綠色。
fuselage.en: A teardrop fuselage with a rounded nose, stepped cockpit windows, retractable gear and a flat belly; military aircraft wear grey or grey-green.

tail.zh: 涵道尾旋翼（直-9B 用 11 葉涵道風扇）藏喺尾fin入面，尾梁向後收細——海豚家族的共同記號。
tail.en: An 11-blade fenestron inside the tail fin (Z-9B) on a tapered boom — the shared Dauphin-family signature.

aircraft.similarZh: 同 EC155 B1 比：同屬海豚家族、同樣涵道尾旋翼，最易撈亂。直-9 機身較窄較短（12.11 米對 14.3 米）、四葉主旋翼、客艙窗較細；EC155 B1 客艙明顯較闊、五葉旋翼。見到軍用編號同灰綠塗裝，多數係直-9。
aircraft.similarEn: Versus the EC155 B1: same Dauphin family and fenestron, so they are easy to confuse. The Z-9 is narrower and shorter (12.11 m vs 14.3 m) with a four-blade rotor and smaller windows; the EC155 B1 is wider with five blades. Military serials and grey-green paint point to the Z-9.

aircraft.nameZh: 羅便臣 R22 直升機

engines.noteZh: 四汽缸活塞引擎，降額定至起飛 131 hp／連續 124 hp
engines.noteEn: Four-cylinder piston engine, derated to 131 hp take-off / 124 hp continuous

seats.noteZh: 並排兩座（機師加一名乘客／學員）

range.noteZh: 最大航程約 250 海里（無預留燃油）

photo.author: James (Flickr: Aircaft @ Gloucestershire Airport By James)
photo.creditZh: 相片：James／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· Robinson R22 Beta（G-OJAN，格洛斯特郡機場）
photo.creditEn: Photo: James / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Robinson R22 Beta (G-OJAN, Gloucestershire Airport)
photo.captionZh: 地面側面，機鼻向左：氣泡座艙、高旋翼桅杆、滑橇同幼長尾梁係 R22 的全套記號。
photo.captionEn: Ground side view, nose to the left: bubble canopy, tall rotor mast, skids and the long thin boom — the full R22 signature.

annotations.en: Two-blade main rotor on a tall mast

aircraft.variantNoteZh: 章規只寫「Robinson R22」；系列有 HP、Alpha、Beta、Beta II 等，規格以現行生產的 Beta II 為代表。相片 G-OJAN 機身寫「Beta」，同系列外形幾乎一樣，主要分別在引擎型號。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The badge list just says “Robinson R22”; the family runs HP, Alpha, Beta and Beta II. Specs use the current production Beta II as representative. The photo aircraft G-OJAN carries “Beta” titles — the variants look almost identical; the difference is mainly the engine.
aircraft.introZh: 全球飛行學校最常見的入門直升機：得兩個位、一台活塞引擎、細細架。好多直升機飛行員的第一堂，就係坐 R22 學起飛降落。
aircraft.introEn: The world's archetypal first helicopter: two seats, one piston engine, tiny airframe. Generations of helicopter pilots took their very first lesson in an R22.

history.statusZh: 生產中、服役中（1975 年首飛；1979 年 3 月取得 FAA 認證、10 月首架交付）
history.statusEn: In production and in service (first flight 1975; FAA certification in March 1979, first delivery that October)

wings.zh: 兩葉半剛性主旋翼，旋翼桅杆又高又幼，葉片直徑只得 7.67 米——全清單最細的旋翼之一。
wings.en: A two-blade semi-rigid main rotor on a tall, slim mast; at 7.67 m it is one of the smallest rotors in this guide.

engines.zh: 單台 Lycoming 活塞引擎藏喺座艙後面，靠風扇吹風散熱；係清單入面少數的活塞引擎直升機。
engines.en: A single Lycoming piston engine behind the cabin, cooled by a directly driven fan — one of the few piston helicopters in this list.

fuselage.zh: 氣泡形大玻璃座艙得兩個位，成架機好似一隻大蜻蜓；用滑橇式起落架，冇起落架轆。
fuselage.en: A bubble-canopy cabin with just two seats — the whole aircraft looks like a big dragonfly, resting on skid gear with no wheels.

tail.zh: 尾梁幼長，末端有細垂直尾翼同兩葉尾旋翼（相片黑白間條好搶眼），中間有水平安定面。
tail.en: A long, thin tail boom ending in a small fin and two-blade tail rotor (black-and-white striped in the photo), with a mid-boom stabiliser.

aircraft.similarZh: 同清單其他直升機比，R22 細一個碼：兩葉旋翼、滑橇、得兩個位，最大起飛重量只係 622 公斤，AW139 一架可以載 15 人。見到氣泡座艙加高桅杆，唔使猶豫就係 R22 家族。
aircraft.similarEn: It is a whole size smaller than every other helicopter here: two-blade rotor, skids, two seats and a 622 kg maximum weight, where an AW139 carries 15 people. The bubble canopy on a tall mast gives it away instantly.
