aircraft.similarEn: Versus the E195-E2 (card AC-0079): near-identical size — split them by the A220's bigger windows and teardrop cockpit pane. Versus the A320neo (card AC-0003): the A220 is a size smaller with similar range.
aircraft.similarZh: 同對手 E195-E2 比（本網 AC-0079 有卡）：兩者尺寸接近，A220 的窗更大、機身直徑略闊（2-3 佈局一樣），靠駕駛艙淚滴窗同翼形分辨。同自家 A320neo 比（本網 AC-0003）：A220 細一級、載客少約 30 人，但航程相近。
aircraft.introEn: A clean-sheet design for the 100–160 seat market: big windows, wide seats in a 2-3 layout with only one middle seat per row, and frugal geared fans — the A220-300 is the fastest-growing small mainline jet.
aircraft.introZh: 為 100–160 座市場全新設計的窄體機：大窗、闊座位（2-3 佈局冇「中間位」之苦）同慳油齒輪扇引擎，A220-300 是近年全球增長最快的小型幹線客機。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Born as Canada's Bombardier CS300 (BD-500) and renamed when Airbus took over in 2018; this card uses the larger -300 (a shorter -100 exists). The photo is a QantasLink A220-300 landing at Canberra.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 前身是加拿大龐巴迪 CS300（BD-500），2018 年由空中巴士接手改名 A220；本卡以較大的 -300 型為代表（家族另有 -100 型）。相片是澳洲航空旗下 QantasLink 的 A220-300 降落坎培拉。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（2016 年以 CS300 之名由 airBaltic 首航；用戶包括達美、法航、JetBlue 等，訂單持續增加）。
history.statusEn: In service with deliveries continuing (entered service as the CS300 with airBaltic in 2016; operators include Delta, Air France and JetBlue).

photo.author: Bidgee
photo.creditZh: 相片：Bidgee／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 3.0 AU）· QantasLink A220-300（VH-X4B）降落坎培拉機場（2024 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Bidgee / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0 AU) · QantasLink A220-300 (VH-X4B) landing at Canberra Airport (2024)
photo.captionZh: QantasLink 的 A220-300 降落：淚滴形尾窗、大窗排同短粗引擎艙。
photo.captionEn: A QantasLink A220-300 landing: teardrop cockpit pane, big windows, stubby nacelles.

engines.noteZh: CFM International 渦輪扇引擎（與 A320neo／737 MAX 同家族）
engines.noteEn: CFM International turbofans (same family as the A320neo/737 MAX engines)

seats.noteZh: 視佈局（東航兩級艙 164 座）

range.noteZh: 基本型航程；增程型 ER 約 5,555 公里
range.noteEn: Baseline range; the ER version reaches about 5,555 km

wings.zh: 主翼翼尖向上翹起的小翼，形狀介乎 A320neo 鯊鰭同 737 MAX 分叉之間，要配合其他特徵分辨。
wings.en: Upturned winglets somewhere between the A320neo's Sharklet and the MAX's split tip — use other cues too.

engines.zh: LEAP-1C 引擎艙與 A320neo 的 LEAP-1A 幾乎同款（同家族），單靠引擎分唔到，要睇機身。
engines.en: LEAP-1C nacelles are near-identical to the A320neo's LEAP-1A (same family) — engines alone won't split them.

fuselage.zh: 駕駛艙用四片式風擋（側窗弧線特別圓），機鼻線條比 A320 圓潤；機身直徑與 A320 相近。
fuselage.en: Four-piece cockpit glazing with a distinctly curved side pane and a rounder nose than the A320; similar fuselage width.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼根部延伸段較短，尾錐收尾與 A320neo 唔同角度。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a shorter fin-root fillet and a differently angled tail cone from the A320neo.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the A320neo (card AC-0003): near-identical size and engines — the curved four-piece cockpit glazing and rounder nose are the reliable tells, and the C919's winglets are shorter. Versus the 737 MAX 8 (card AC-0074): the MAX has split winglets and sits lower.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 A320neo 比（本網 AC-0003 有卡）：兩者大小、引擎幾乎一樣，最可靠是睇駕駛艙四片風擋的弧形側窗同機鼻弧度；C919 的翼尖小翼亦較短。同 737 MAX 8 比（本網 AC-0074）：MAX 翼尖分叉、機身較矮，C919 兩樣都唔同。
aircraft.introEn: One with a special Hong Kong connection: the C919's first trip outside the mainland in December 2023 was to Hong Kong, including a low flypast over Victoria Harbour; since 2025 China Eastern has flown it on scheduled Shanghai–Hong Kong services.
aircraft.introZh: 香港讀者特別有共鳴的一款：C919 在 2023 年 12 月首次飛出內地就係嚟香港，仲在維港上空低飛展示；2025 年起東航更用它執飛上海虹橋—香港定期航班，在香港機場已經見得到真身。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: China's first mainline narrowbody built to international standards; figures are for the baseline aircraft (an ER version exists). The photo is China Eastern's first C919 (B-919A) landing at Beijing Capital.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 中國第一款按國際標準研製的幹線窄體客機；本卡數字為基本型（另有增程型 ER）。相片是中國東方航空首架 C919（B-919A）在北京首都機場降落。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（中國東方航空 2023 年首航；國航、南航等陸續接收，主要飛中國國內幹線，東航以 C919 飛上海—香港定期航班）。
history.statusEn: In service with deliveries continuing (China Eastern launched it in May 2023; Air China and China Southern followed; mainly Chinese trunk routes, plus China Eastern's scheduled C919 service between Shanghai and Hong Kong).

photo.author: N509FZ
photo.creditZh: 相片：N509FZ／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 中國東方航空 C919（B-919A）降落北京首都機場（2022 年驗證飛行）
photo.creditEn: Photo: N509FZ / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · China Eastern C919 (B-919A) landing at Beijing Capital (2022 validation flight)
photo.captionZh: 首架量產 C919 落地：四片式風擋同圓潤機鼻是認佢的關鍵。
photo.captionEn: The first production C919 landing: four-piece glazing and the rounded nose are the keys.

deepLinks.labelZh: 中國商飛官方：C919 機型頁

range.noteZh: 最大航程（2,600 海里，廠方與 ICAO Doc 8643 數字）
range.noteEn: Maximum range (2,600 nmi, manufacturer/ICAO Doc 8643 figure)

wings.zh: 全新主翼比上一代長，翼尖向後斜削（raked），沒有大彎小翼。
wings.en: A new, longer wing with raked tips and no tall winglet.

engines.zh: PW1900G 齒輪扇引擎艙比 E190 的 CF34 大一圈，艙體短粗。
engines.en: PW1900G nacelles are a size up from the E190's CF34s — short and fat.

fuselage.zh: 機身是 E-Jet 家族最長的，窗排密而長；2-2 座位佈局冇中間位。
fuselage.en: The longest E-Jet fuselage with a dense, long window line; 2-2 seating means no middle seats.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，尾錐比 E190 修長。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a slimmer tail cone than the E190's.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the E190 (card AC-0013): about 5 m longer, over 6 m more span, visibly bigger engines and raked tips. Versus the A220-300 (card AC-0077): similar size — the A220 has bigger windows and the teardrop cockpit pane; the E2's windows are smaller and denser.
aircraft.similarZh: 同上一代 E190 比（本網 AC-0013 有卡）：E195-E2 長約 5 米、翼展大 6 米有多、引擎明顯大一號，翼尖斜削而非小翼。同對手 A220-300 比（本網 AC-0077）：大小接近，A220 窗更大、駕駛艙尾窗呈淚滴形，E195-E2 的窗較細密。
aircraft.introEn: Embraer's second-generation E-Jet: a new wing and geared fans give the E195-E2 mainline efficiency at 130-seat size — a new mainstay of European and South American regional networks.
aircraft.introZh: 巴西航空工業的第二代 E-Jet：新翼、新齒輪扇引擎，E195-E2 以 130 座級的尺寸飛出幹線機的效率，是歐洲同南美支線網絡的新主力。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The largest E-Jet E2 (ERJ 190-400); the family also has the E190-E2 and E175-E2. Figures are for the E195-E2. The photo is a KLM Cityhopper aircraft landing at Berlin.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: E-Jet E2 家族最大的一員（ERJ 190-400）；家族另有 E190-E2 與 E175-E2。本卡數字為 E195-E2。相片是荷蘭皇家城市短途航空（KLM Cityhopper）的 E195-E2 降落柏林。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（巴西 Azul 航空 2019 年首航；用戶包括 KLM Cityhopper、Porter、Helvetic 等）。
history.statusEn: In service with deliveries continuing (launched by Brazil's Azul in 2019; operators include KLM Cityhopper, Porter and Helvetic).

photo.author: MarcelX42
photo.creditZh: 相片：MarcelX42／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· KLM Cityhopper E195-E2（PH-NXC）降落柏林布蘭登堡機場（2022 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: MarcelX42 / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · KLM Cityhopper E195-E2 (PH-NXC) landing at Berlin Brandenburg (2022)
photo.captionZh: KLM 的 E195-E2 進場：斜削翼尖、大齒輪扇引擎同密窗排。
photo.captionEn: A KLM E195-E2 on approach: raked wingtips and big geared fans.

deepLinks.labelZh: 英文維基：Embraer E-Jet E2 family
deepLinks.labelEn: English Wikipedia: Embraer E-Jet E2 family

length.noteZh: 旋翼轉動時全長（機身 10.93 米）

rotorDiameter.noteZh: 主旋翼直徑（三葉 Starflex 旋翼頭）

engines.noteZh: 單台渦輪軸引擎（B3e 型）

seats.noteZh: 機師 1 名＋乘客最多 5 名
seats.noteEn: One pilot plus up to five passengers

wings.zh: 三葉主旋翼，旋翼頭是星形柔性 Starflex 設計，沒有傳統鉸鏈外露。
wings.en: Three-blade main rotor on a Starflex head with no exposed hinges.

engines.zh: 單台 Arriel 引擎裝在座艙後上方，排氣口在機身上方側面；只有一台引擎是同 H145 等雙引擎機的最大分別。
engines.en: One Arriel on top behind the cabin — a single engine is the big split from twins like the H145.

fuselage.zh: 機身短圓，大面積弧形風擋；固定滑橇起落架，是輕型通用直升機的經典樣。
fuselage.en: Short, round fuselage with a big curved windscreen and fixed skids — the classic light utility shape.

tail.zh: 尾槳是傳統兩葉開放式，裝在垂直尾翼右側；尾翼下方有水平安定面。
tail.en: Conventional two-blade open tail rotor on the fin, with a tailplane below.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the H135 (card AC-0019): twin engines and a fenestron there; one engine and an open tail rotor here — check the tail. Versus the Bell 407 (card AC-0018): four blades and a sleeker body there; three blades and rounder here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 H135 比（本網 AC-0019 有卡）：H135 是雙引擎加涵道尾槳（fenestron），H125 單引擎加開放尾槳，一睇尾部就分到。同 Bell 407 比（本網 AC-0018）：407 是四葉旋翼、機身較修長；H125 三葉旋翼、機身較圓。
aircraft.introEn: One of the world's best-selling light helicopters: the single-engine, skid-geared H125 (AS350 Squirrel) even landed on the summit of Everest in 2005 — it does everything from mountain rescue to lifting work over Hong Kong.
aircraft.introZh: 全球賣得最好的輕型直升機之一：H125（AS350 松鼠）單引擎、滑橇起落架，2005 年更創下在珠穆朗瑪峰頂降落的世界紀錄——由山區救援到香港上空的觀光吊運都見到佢。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Born as the 1970s Aérospatiale AS350 Écureuil ('Squirrel') and renamed H125 in 2015; this card uses today's H125 (AS350 B3e). Hong Kong helicopter operators also fly the AS350/H125 family. The photo is an LAPD aircraft.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 前身是 1970 年代的 Aérospatiale AS350 松鼠（Écureuil），2015 年改名 H125；本卡以現行 H125（AS350 B3e）為代表。香港的直升機營運商亦有 AS350／H125 系列在飛。相片是洛杉磯警局的 H125。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續生產（AS350 家族累計交付逾 7,000 架，遍布警務、救援、吊運同觀光；2015 年起以 H125 之名銷售）。
history.statusEn: In production and worldwide service (over 7,000 of the AS350 family delivered for police, rescue, lifting and touring work; sold as the H125 since 2015).

photo.author: Colin Sheridan (U.S. Navy)
photo.creditZh: 相片：Colin Sheridan／美國海軍經 Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· 洛杉磯警局 H125 空中支援機（2022 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Colin Sheridan / U.S. Navy via Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · LAPD Air Support H125 (2022)
photo.captionZh: 警用 H125 飛行中：三葉旋翼、滑橇同單引擎短圓機身。
photo.captionEn: A police H125 airborne: three-blade rotor, skids and a single engine.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：AS50 代碼頁

rotorDiameter.noteZh: 主旋翼直徑（D-2 四葉；D-3 五葉）
rotorDiameter.noteEn: Main rotor diameter (four blades on D-2; five on D-3)

engines.noteZh: 兩台渦輪軸引擎（EC145 早期型為 Arriel 1E2）

seats.noteZh: 乘客最多 9 名（加機師 1–2 名）；救護佈局載擔架 2–4 張
seats.noteEn: Up to nine passengers plus one or two pilots; air-ambulance layouts carry two to four stretchers

wings.zh: 主旋翼四葉（新款 D-3 五葉），旋翼頭低矮貼近機頂。
wings.en: Four-blade main rotor (five on the new D-3) on a low mast.

engines.zh: 兩台引擎並排裝在座艙上方，排氣口向後；機頂有明顯的引擎整流罩隆起。
engines.en: Two engines side by side above the cabin with a pronounced top fairing.

fuselage.zh: 座艙方正寬闊，側面大趟門，機尾有左右對開艙門方便抬擔架入艙——救護型的招牌。
fuselage.en: Boxy, wide cabin with big sliding doors and rear clamshell doors for stretchers — the ambulance signature.

tail.zh: H145 改用涵道尾槳（fenestron）：尾翼入面一個圓形風扇；舊款 EC145 則是開放尾槳，是兩代最快分辨法。
tail.en: The H145 switched to a fenestron — a fan inside the fin; the older EC145 has an open tail rotor, the quickest generational tell.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the H135 (card AC-0019): both have fenestrons, but the H145 is a class bigger (nine seats vs six) with rear clamshell doors. Versus its EC145 parent: open tail rotor there, fenestron here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 H135 比（本網 AC-0019 有卡）：兩者都有涵道尾槳，但 H145 大一級（9 座對 6 座）、機尾有對開艙門。同前身 EC145 比：EC145 是開放式尾槳，H145 是涵道尾槳加新航電，外觀睇尾翼即分到。
aircraft.introEn: The world's air-ambulance and rescue workhorse twin: a big cabin, rear clamshell doors and a fenestron — H145s fly ambulance services across Britain, Germany and France, and its UH-72 military version serves throughout the US Army.
aircraft.introZh: 全球空中救護同搜救的主力雙引擎直升機：H145 以大座艙、後艙門同涵道尾槳見長，英國、德國、法國的救護直升機好多都是佢，軍用版 UH-72 更用遍美軍。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Developed from the Eurocopter EC145 (BK117 C-2), renamed H145 in 2015 with a fenestron and Helionix avionics; this card uses the H145 (BK117 D-2), and the latest D-3 has a five-blade rotor. The photo is a Yorkshire Air Ambulance aircraft.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 前身是 Eurocopter EC145（BK117 C-2），2015 年改名 H145 並換上涵道尾槳同 Helionix 航電；本卡以 H145（BK117 D-2）為代表，最新 D-3 型改用五葉旋翼。相片是英國約克郡空中救護的 H145。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續生產（EC145 2002 年投產，H145 2014 年起交付；全球機隊逾千架，最新五葉 D-3 型持續交付）。
history.statusEn: In production and worldwide service (EC145 from 2002, H145 deliveries from 2014; a fleet of over a thousand, with the five-blade D-3 now delivering).

photo.author: James
photo.creditZh: 相片：James／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 約克郡空中救護 H145（G-YOAA）飛行中（2020 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: James / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Yorkshire Air Ambulance H145 (G-YOAA) in flight (2020)
photo.captionZh: 救護黃的 H145：涵道尾槳、方正大座艙同滑橇一覽無遺。
photo.captionEn: An ambulance-yellow H145: fenestron, boxy cabin and skids.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：EC45 代碼頁

engines.noteZh: 勞斯萊斯渦輪扇引擎，後置機身兩側
engines.noteEn: Rolls-Royce turbofans on the rear fuselage

range.noteEn: Baseline G650 (7,000 nmi); the G650ER reaches 13,890 km (7,500 nmi)

wings.zh: 低翼，後掠角大，翼尖有小翼；機翼裝在機身後半段，令機鼻顯得特別長。
wings.en: Low, strongly swept wing set well back, giving a long nose; small winglets.

engines.zh: 兩台 BR725 裝在機尾兩側（後置引擎），進氣口圓大，是商務機的標準佈局。
engines.en: Two BR725s flank the rear fuselage — the classic business-jet layout, with big round intakes.

fuselage.zh: 機身修長，窗戶是灣流招牌的大橢圓窗，一排約 8 隻；機鼻尖長下垂。
fuselage.en: Slim fuselage with Gulfstream's signature large oval windows (about eight a side) and a long pointed nose.

tail.zh: T 形尾翼：水平尾翼裝在垂直尾翼頂端。
tail.en: T-tail with the tailplane on top of the fin.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the G550 (card AC-0066): bigger, more oval windows and a longer, faster airframe here. Versus the Global 7500 (card AC-0083): the Bombardier is longer with squarer windows; both are rear-engined T-tails, so window shape and nacelle shape decide it.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 G550 比（本網 AC-0066 有卡）：G650 的窗更大更橢圓、機身更長更快；G550 窗較細隻而且數量多。同對手 Global 7500 比（本網 AC-0083）：Global 機身更長、窗較方大；兩者都係後置引擎 T 尾，要數窗形同睇機尾引擎艙形狀。
aircraft.introEn: The business-jet benchmark for speed and range: cruising at Mach 0.90 with over 12,900 km of range for Hong Kong–New York-class legs, and unmistakable on any business apron for its huge oval windows.
aircraft.introZh: 商務機界的速度與航程標竿：G650 以 Mach 0.90 高速巡航、逾 12,900 公里航程直飛香港—紐約級別的航線，招牌大橢圓窗在商務機坪一眼就認到。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The family pairs the baseline G650 with the longer-range G650ER (about 930 km more), identical in shape; the photo is a Royal Netherlands Air Force G650ER (V-117) government aircraft. G650s are frequent visitors to Hong Kong's business-aviation apron.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 家族有基本型 G650 與長程型 G650ER（航程多約 930 公里），外形相同；本卡規格以兩型並記，相片是荷蘭皇家空軍的 G650ER（V-117）政府專機。香港國際機場的商務機坪亦常見 G650 系。

history.statusZh: 服役中（2012 年投產，後由 G700／G800 家族接棒新交付；全球機隊龐大，包括多國政府專機）。
history.statusEn: In service (entered service in 2012; new deliveries have passed to the G700/G800 family, but the G650 fleet remains large, including several government fleets).

photo.author: Ministerie van Defensie（荷蘭國防部）
photo.creditZh: 相片：荷蘭國防部／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 荷蘭皇家空軍 G650ER（V-117）政府專機（2023 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Dutch Ministry of Defence / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Royal Netherlands Air Force G650ER (V-117) government aircraft (2023)
photo.captionZh: 政府專機版 G650ER：招牌大橢圓窗、後置引擎同 T 尾齊晒。
photo.captionEn: A government G650ER: signature oval windows, rear engines and T-tail.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：GLF6 代碼頁

length.noteZh: 全長（現役商務機中最長之一）
length.noteEn: Overall length (among the longest business jets)

engines.noteZh: 通用電氣渦輪扇引擎，後置機身兩側
engines.noteEn: GE turbofans on the rear fuselage

cruise.noteZh: 典型巡航（高速巡航 Mach 0.90、極速 0.925）

wings.zh: 全新跨音速主翼，後掠大、翼尖有小翼，翼面比舊款 Global 更修長。
wings.en: New transonic wing — more sweep and span than the older Globals, with winglets.

engines.zh: 兩台 GE Passport 裝在機尾兩側，引擎艙比 Global 6000 更修長，排氣錐明顯。
engines.en: Two GE Passports flank the tail, in slimmer nacelles than the Global 6000's with visible exhaust cones.

fuselage.zh: 機身非常長，窗戶大而方，數量多（每邊約 14 隻）；機鼻圓滑，駕駛艙窗呈彎月形。
fuselage.en: Very long fuselage with many large, squarish windows (about fourteen a side) and a smooth nose with crescent cockpit panes.

tail.zh: T 形尾翼，垂直尾翼後掠，尾錐裝 APU 排氣。
tail.en: T-tail with a swept fin and APU exhaust in the tail cone.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Global Express XRS (card AC-0055): about 3 m longer with nearly 3,000 km more range and more, bigger windows. Versus the G650 (card AC-0082): oval windows there, squarish ones here, and a longer fuselage.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 Global Express XRS 比（本網 AC-0055 有卡）：7500 長約 3 米、航程多近 3,000 公里，窗更多更大。同對手 G650 比（本網 AC-0082）：G650 窗是橢圓形、Global 是方形大窗；Global 機身亦較長。
aircraft.introEn: Among the largest and longest-legged business jets in service: 14,260 km of range and Mach 0.90 cruise put Hong Kong–US East Coast within reach — a head-turning regular at Hong Kong's business apron.
aircraft.introZh: 現役最大、最長程的商務機之一：Global 7500 以 14,260 公里航程同 Mach 0.90 高速巡航直飛香港—北美東岸級別航線，是香港商務機坪的矚目常客。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Launched as the Global 7000 and renamed when range grew to 7,700 nmi; the faster Global 8000 followed. Figures are for the 7500. The photo is a Swiss Air Force Global 7500 (T-787) VIP aircraft landing at Berlin.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 原名 Global 7000，因航程增至 7,700 海里改名 7500；家族後續有更快的 Global 8000。本卡數字為 7500。相片是瑞士空軍的 Global 7500（T-787）政要專機降落柏林。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（2018 年底投產；用戶以企業、租賃同政府專機為主，機隊持續增長）。
history.statusEn: In service with deliveries continuing (entered service in late 2018; corporate, charter and government operators, with a growing fleet).

photo.author: André Gerwing
photo.creditZh: 相片：André Gerwing／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 瑞士空軍 Global 7500（T-787）降落柏林（2025 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: André Gerwing / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Swiss Air Force Global 7500 (T-787) landing at Berlin (2025)
photo.captionZh: 瑞士空軍的 Global 7500 進場：特長機身、方形大窗同後置引擎。
photo.captionEn: A Swiss Air Force Global 7500 on finals: long fuselage, square windows, rear engines.

annotations.zh: 後置 GE Passport 引擎

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：GL7T 代碼頁

wingspan.noteZh: 裝鯊鰭小翼翼展（早期翼尖圍欄型 34.10 米）
wingspan.noteEn: Span with Sharklets (34.10 m with original wingtip fences)

engines.noteZh: 兩款引擎任選其一，同場要靠引擎艙形狀分
engines.noteEn: A choice of two engine types; nacelle shape separates them

seats.noteZh: 典型兩級至全經濟（最大 180）

wings.zh: 下單翼，早期機翼尖是細小的圍欄式小翼，後期改裝向上翹的鯊鰭小翼（Sharklet）；比 A320neo 的翼尖更直、更短。
wings.en: Low wing; early aircraft wear small wingtip fences, later ones upturned Sharklets — smaller and straighter than the neo's.

engines.zh: 兩台引擎吊掛翼下：CFM56 艙較短圓、V2500 較修長，是同型機之間唯一要落足眼力分的地方。
engines.en: Two underwing engines: the CFM56 nacelle is shorter and rounder, the V2500 slimmer — the one detail worth a second look.

fuselage.zh: 窄體單通道，機鼻圓潤下垂；駕駛艙窗是空中巴士家族式的斜切下角。
fuselage.en: Narrowbody single aisle with a rounded, drooped nose and the Airbus family's notched cockpit-window corner.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼根部有背鰭向前延伸，尾錐裝 APU 排氣。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a dorsal fillet running forward from the fin and the APU in the tail cone.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the A320neo (card AC-0003): much bigger engines and taller Sharklets there; the ceo's engines are visibly smaller. Versus the 737-800 (AC-0006): the Boeing sits lower with a flattened engine bottom; the Airbus stands taller on a rounder nose.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 A320neo 比（本網 AC-0003）：neo 引擎明顯更大、翼尖鯊鰭更高，ceo 引擎細一圈。同波音 737-800 比（AC-0006）：737 機身較矮、引擎艙底部較平（貼地低），A320 起落架較高、機鼻較圓。
aircraft.introEn: The founding member of the world's most common airliner family, the fly-by-wire, sidestick A320-200 redefined narrowbodies — you will meet one at almost any airport on the planet.
aircraft.introZh: 全球最常見的客機家族開山祖師：A320-200 以電傳操縱（fly-by-wire）同側杆駕駛艙開創窄體機新時代，去到世界任何一個機場都幾乎一定撞到佢。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The original A320 (ceo = Current Engine Option): in service since 1988 and still one of the largest fleets on earth. This card uses the common A320-200; later Sharklet-fitted aircraft have a wider span. The shorter A319 and longer A321 are siblings, and all have been Hong Kong regulars.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: A320 家族元老（ceo = Current Engine Option），1988 年投產至今仍是全球數量最多的機隊之一；本卡以最常見的 A320-200 為代表，翼尖裝鯊鰭小翼（Sharklet）的後期機翼展較大。較短的 A319、較長的 A321 同屬這一代，香港各大航空公司都飛過。

history.statusZh: 服役中（生產已由 A320neo 家族接棒，但全球仍有數千架 A320ceo 在飛，是二手及租賃市場主力）。
history.statusEn: In service (production has passed to the A320neo family, but thousands of A320ceos still fly and anchor the used and leasing markets).

photo.author: Adrian Pingstone
photo.creditZh: 相片：Adrian Pingstone／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· 漢莎航空 A320-200（D-AIPA）降落倫敦希斯路（2007 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Adrian Pingstone / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · Lufthansa A320-200 (D-AIPA) landing at London Heathrow (2007)
photo.captionZh: 漢莎的 A320-200 進場：翼尖圍欄小翼與 CFM56 引擎是 ceo 一代的記號。
photo.captionEn: A Lufthansa A320-200 on approach: wingtip fences and CFM56s mark the ceo generation.

deepLinks.labelZh: 中文維基：空中巴士 A320

wingspan.noteZh: 翼展（無翼尖小翼，翼尖斜削）

engines.noteZh: 三款引擎任選其一，風扇直徑逾 3 米
engines.noteEn: Three engine options; fan diameter over 3 m

wings.zh: 主翼長而斜削，翼尖尖削（raked）沒有小翼；翼下起落架是招牌的六輪小車式（每邊 6 轆）。
wings.en: Long raked wingtips with no winglets; below, the signature six-wheel bogies each side.

engines.zh: 兩台巨大引擎，進氣口接近成人高度，是全機最引人注目的比例。
engines.en: Two enormous engines with intakes nearly as tall as a person — the type's most striking proportion.

fuselage.zh: 廣體雙通道，機身橫切面近乎正圓；機鼻圓滑，尾部 APU 排氣口呈扁平狀。
fuselage.en: Widebody twin-aisle with a near-circular section, smooth nose and a flattened APU outlet at the tail.

tail.zh: 尾翼高大，垂直尾翼後緣有明顯的 APU 進氣與尾錐收尖。
tail.en: Tall tail surfaces with a tapered tail cone and APU intake at the fin base.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the 777-300ER (card AC-0005): about 10 m longer there with raked extensions; the -200ER is shorter. Versus the A350-900 (AC-0001): bigger, rounder engines here and no black mask; the Airbus has curved-up wingtips.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 777-300ER 比（本網 AC-0005）：-300ER 長約 10 米並有斜削延長翼尖連小翼翼端，-200ER 較短、翼尖無小翼。同對手 A350-900 比（AC-0001）：777 引擎更大更圓、無黑色眼罩窗框；A350 翼尖向上彎起。
aircraft.introEn: The long-haul king of the 1990s: the 777-200ER proved a big twin could replace four engines across oceans, and it joined almost every major airline's fleet.
aircraft.introZh: 九十年代長途航線的王者：777-200ER 以雙引擎飛越太平洋、大西洋，證明大雙引擎機可以取代四引擎機做超長途，全球各大航空公司機隊都見到佢。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The Extended Range member and best-seller of the 777 family; the baseline 777-200 is shorter-legged but identical in shape. Figures are for the -200ER, first flown on 7 October 1996 (the family first flew on 12 June 1994).
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 777 家族的長程版（ER = Extended Range），是全家族賣得最好的子型號；基本型 777-200 航程較短，外形相同。本卡數字為 -200ER，首飛日期以 -200ER 計（家族首飛 1994-06-12）。香港快運以外的長途航線以往亦常見 -200ER。

history.statusZh: 服役中（生產已結束，全球仍有數百架飛長途及高密度航線；部分轉投貨運改裝行列）。
history.statusEn: In service (production has ended, but several hundred still fly long-haul and high-density routes, with some earmarked for freighter conversion).

photo.author: Mitchell R Hope
photo.creditZh: 相片：Mitchell R Hope／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 美國航空 777-200ER（N777AN）抵達倫敦希斯路（2023 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Mitchell R Hope / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · American Airlines 777-200ER (N777AN) arriving at London Heathrow (2023)
photo.captionZh: 美航的 777-200ER 進場：巨型引擎同六輪起落架一覽無遺。
photo.captionEn: An American 777-200ER on finals: huge engines and six-wheel bogies on show.

wingspan.noteZh: 翼展，後期機裝翼尖小翼
wingspan.noteEn: Wingspan; many later aircraft have winglets

engines.value: 2 × Rolls-Royce RB211-535 or Pratt & Whitney PW2000
engines.noteZh: 推力強勁，熱高機場表現出色
engines.noteEn: Powerful engines with strong hot-and-high performance

seats.noteZh: 典型兩級至全經濟（最大 239）

range.noteZh: 最大航程（3,900 海里），夠飛大西洋
range.noteEn: Maximum range (3,900 nmi) — enough for the Atlantic

wings.zh: 中置低翼，翼尖後期多裝向上小翼；機翼位置令機身前段顯得特別長。
wings.en: Low wing, often retrofitted with winglets; its position leaves a notably long forward fuselage.

engines.zh: 兩台引擎相對機身比例偏大，進氣口圓而深，係 757 動力澎湃的外在證據。
engines.en: Engines look oversized for the fuselage, with deep round intakes — the visible sign of its power.

fuselage.zh: 窄體單通道但機鼻特別長而尖，起落架高，停喺地面有「企得高」的感覺。
fuselage.en: Narrowbody with a strikingly long, pointed nose and tall landing gear — it stands high on the ramp.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼高聳；尾錐有 APU 排氣。
tail.en: Conventional, tall tail with the APU exhaust in the tail cone.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the 737-800 (card AC-0006): much longer, taller and bigger-engined here. Versus the A321neo (AC-0073): Sharklets and a lower stance there; a longer, pointier nose here. Freighters are told by blanked windows.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 737-800 比（本網 AC-0006）：757 長得多、企得高、引擎比例更大。同 A321neo 比（AC-0073）：A321neo 翼尖鯊鰭同較矮的姿態可分；757 機鼻更長更尖。貨機版同客機版睇窗戶有無封口。
aircraft.introEn: The sports car of narrowbodies: the 757-200 pairs transatlantic range with short-field punch on a long nose and tall gear — a fixture of US and Icelandic routes.
aircraft.introZh: 窄體機界的跑車：757-200 推力重量比驚人，可以飛大西洋又可以落短跑道，機鼻長、起落架高，喺美國同冰島航線最常見。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Siblings are the stretched 757-300 and the 757-200F freighter (a FedEx staple); this card uses the passenger -200. Out of production for over twenty years yet still everywhere — famously the narrowbody with no true successor.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 家族另有加長型 757-300 與貨機版 757-200F（聯邦快遞機隊龐大）；本卡以客機版 -200 為代表。停產逾二十年仍有大批在飛，是公認「無直接後繼者」的窄體機。

history.statusZh: 服役中（2004 年停產，客機版漸退但貨機版同美軍 C-32 專機版繼續主力服役）。
history.statusEn: In service (production ended in 2004; passenger examples are thinning out, but freighters and the USAF's C-32s remain front-line).

photo.author: Brorsson
photo.creditZh: 相片：Brorsson／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 3.0）· 冰島航空 757-200 在雪中降落斯德哥爾摩阿蘭達
photo.creditEn: Photo: Brorsson / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0) · Icelandair 757-200 landing in snow at Stockholm Arlanda
photo.captionZh: 冰島航空的 757-200 雪地進場：長機鼻、高起落架同大引擎比例分明。
photo.captionEn: An Icelandair 757-200 in the snow: long nose, tall gear, big engines.

wingspan.noteZh: 長翼尖型 E75L（早期型 26.00 米）
wingspan.noteEn: Long-wing E75L (26.00 m on early aircraft)

seats.noteZh: 美國支線主流 76 座（最大 88）

wings.zh: 下單翼，後期機翼尖加長並向上斜削；起落架收放艙門貼近翼根。
wings.en: Low wing with long, raked wingtips on current aircraft and gear doors tight to the wing root.

engines.zh: 兩台 CF34 吊掛翼下，引擎艙比例比 E190 細一號。
engines.en: Two CF34s under the wing, in nacelles a size down from the E190's.

fuselage.zh: 機身是「雙泡型」橫切面，客艙 2+2 無中間位；機鼻尖細，尾部上翹收細。
fuselage.en: Double-bubble fuselage with 2+2 seating and no middle seat; a fine nose and upswept tail.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼，垂直尾翼根部背鰭明顯。
tail.en: Conventional tail with a clear dorsal fillet at the fin root.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the E190 (card AC-0013): about 5 m longer there with more seats; most US E175s wear American Eagle or United Express colours. Versus the CRJ900 (AC-0014): rear-fuselage engines there, underwing here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 E190 比（本網 AC-0013）：E190 長約 5 米、載客多一截；E175 較短，美國機隊多數掛 American Eagle／United Express 品牌。同 CRJ900 比（AC-0014）：CRJ 引擎在機尾兩側，E175 引擎在翼下，一睇就分到。
aircraft.introEn: North America's regional workhorse: 76 seats, a genuinely spacious no-middle-seat cabin, and a route map covering every small US city for the big three airlines.
aircraft.introZh: 北美支線航空的頭號主力：E175 以 76 座級距同「無中間位」的寬敞客艙，承包咗美國三大航空公司大量地區航線，細機場日日見到。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: An E-Jet family member: early aircraft have shorter wingtips (ICAO E75S); the current long-wing E75L is used here (28.65 m span vs 26.00 m). US regional airlines fly it in 76-seat layouts under scope clauses, making it North America's regional king.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: E-Jet 家族成員，早期機翼尖較短（ICAO 代碼 E75S），後期加長翼尖型為 E75L，本卡規格以 E75L 為準（翼展 28.65 米，早期型 26.00 米）。美國支線航空因工會條款以 76 座佈局大量營運，是北美支線一哥。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（美國支線訂單龐大，E175 仍是 Embraer 民航線的銷量支柱之一）。
history.statusEn: In service and still delivering (huge US regional order books keep the E175 a pillar of Embraer's airliner line).

photo.author: SkyHigh757
photo.creditZh: 相片：SkyHigh757／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 美鷹航空（Republic Airways 營運）E175 停泊外站（2014 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: SkyHigh757 / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · American Eagle (Republic Airways) E175 at an outstation (2014)
photo.captionZh: American Eagle 的 E175 泊在外站：翼下引擎同 2+2 支線客機身段。
photo.captionEn: An American Eagle E175 at an outstation: underwing engines, 2+2 cabin.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：E75L 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 德哈維蘭加拿大 Dash 8 Q400

engines.noteZh: 渦輪螺旋槳，配六葉 Dowty 螺旋槳

seats.noteZh: 典型 78 座至高密度 90 座

cruise.noteZh: 最高巡航（360 節，渦槳機中極快）
cruise.noteEn: Maximum cruise (360 kt — very fast for a turboprop)

wings.zh: 高置直翼，機翼裝在機身上方，兩台引擎艙修長，六葉螺旋槳直徑大。
wings.en: High straight wing on top of the fuselage, long nacelles and big six-blade propellers.

engines.zh: PW150A 渦槳引擎裝在翼下長艙內，主起落架亦收入引擎艙後方，是 Q400 的結構記號。
engines.en: PW150A turboprops in long wing nacelles; the main gears retract into those nacelles — a Q400 signature.

fuselage.zh: 機身長而幼，「鉛筆形」比例在支線機中最誇張；窗戶細密一排。
fuselage.en: Long, thin pencil fuselage — the most stretched proportions of any regional airliner, with rows of small windows.

tail.zh: T 形尾翼，水平尾翼裝在高垂直尾翼頂端，尾翼下方有腹鰭。
tail.en: T-tail with the tailplane atop a tall fin and a ventral strake below.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the ATR 72-600 (card AC-0012): both are high-wing turboprops, but the Q400 is much longer, some 160 km/h faster, six-bladed (ATR: four) and retracts its gear into the nacelles. Versus the E175 (AC-0087): jets there, propellers here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 ATR 72-600 比（本網 AC-0012）：兩者都是高翼渦槳，但 Q400 機身長得多、速度快近 160 km/h，螺旋槳六葉（ATR 四葉），起落架收在引擎艙而非機身兩側。同 E175 比（AC-0087）：嗰款是噴射引擎，這款是螺旋槳。
aircraft.introEn: The fastest regional turboprop: near-jet speed on short hops, six-blade propellers and a high wing — a regular across Europe, Canada and Japan.
aircraft.introZh: 最快的支線渦輪螺旋槳機：Q400 以接近噴射機的速度飛短途，六葉螺旋槳同高置主翼，是歐洲、加拿大同日本地區航線的常客。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The stretched, fast Q400 of the Dash 8 family — Q for Quiet, after its active noise suppression. Shorter -100/-200/-300 siblings exist; production has ended but the world fleet remains large.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: Dash 8 家族的加長高速型，Q 代表 Quiet（主動降噪系統）；家族另有較短的 -100／-200／-300。本卡以 78–90 座的 Q400 為代表，生產已結束但全球機隊仍大。

history.statusZh: 服役中（生產已結束；全球數百架繼續飛地區航線，部分改作滅火機 Q400-MR）。
history.statusEn: In service (production has ended; hundreds still fly regional routes, with some converted to Q400-MR water bombers).

photo.author: BriYYZ
photo.creditZh: 相片：BriYYZ／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· Porter Airlines Dash 8 Q400（C-GLQN）自渥太華起飛（2015 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: BriYYZ / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Porter Airlines Dash 8 Q400 (C-GLQN) departing Ottawa (2015)
photo.captionZh: Porter 的 Q400 剛離地：高翼、六葉槳同 T 尾齊晒。
photo.captionEn: A Porter Q400 just airborne: high wing, six-blade props, T-tail.

deepLinks.labelZh: 英文維基：De Havilland Canada Dash 8
ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：DH8D 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 麥克唐納-道格拉斯 MD-11F

height.noteZh: 全高（尾引擎令尾翼高大）
height.noteEn: Overall height (tall tail around the third engine)

engines.value: 3 × GE CF6-80C2 or Pratt & Whitney PW4460
engines.noteZh: 兩台翼下加一台尾翼引擎，三引擎佈局
engines.noteEn: Two underwing plus one in the tail — a true trijet

payload.noteZh: 最大結構載重（主貨艙 26 個托盤）

range.noteZh: 典型載重航程（3,910 海里）

wings.zh: 下單翼連翼尖小翼，翼下兩台引擎；主起落架中間多一組中置起落架（centre gear）是 MD-11 的獨有記號。
wings.en: Low wing with winglets and two engines, plus the MD-11's unique extra centre landing gear between the main bogies.

engines.zh: 第三台引擎裝在垂直尾翼根部，進氣口在尾翼前緣上方——三引擎佈局一眼就認到。
engines.en: The third engine sits in the fin root with its intake above the leading edge — the trijet giveaway.

fuselage.zh: 廣體機身，貨機版窗戶封口、機頭側有大型主貨艙門；比 DC-10 長約 6 米。
fuselage.en: Widebody with blanked windows and a big main-deck cargo door on the freighter; about 6 m longer than the DC-10.

tail.zh: 垂直尾翼特別高大以容納尾引擎，水平尾翼比 DC-10 細，是改良氣動的結果。
tail.en: An extra-tall fin houses the tail engine; the tailplane is smaller than the DC-10's after aerodynamic clean-ups.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus its DC-10 ancestor: longer, winglets, a centre gear and a glass cockpit. Versus the 777F (card AC-0009): twin engines and a fatter fuselage there; the tail engine settles it here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同祖先 DC-10 比：MD-11 較長、有翼尖小翼同中置起落架，駕駛艙是玻璃座艙。同 777F 比（本網 AC-0009）：777F 雙引擎、機身更粗；MD-11F 三引擎同較幼，尾引擎是決定性分別。
aircraft.introEn: The last widebody trijet: an engine buried in the tail, straight DC-10 ancestry, and a second life hauling freight at cargo airports worldwide.
aircraft.introZh: 最後的三引擎廣體機：MD-11F 尾翼入面藏一台引擎，是 DC-10 的直系後代，而家專心做貨機，喺全球貨運機場仍然日日見到。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The MD-11 family split into passenger versions (all retired) and the MD-11F freighter used here. Passenger service began with Finnair in 1990; the freighter followed a year later.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: MD-11 家族有客機版（已全退）同貨機版 MD-11F；本卡以仍在役的貨機版為代表，數字為貨機型。客機版 1990 年由芬蘭航空首航，貨機版翌年跟進。

history.statusZh: 貨機服役中（客機版 2014 年全退；FedEx、UPS 等仍營運逾百架 MD-11F，預計飛到 2030 年代）。
history.statusEn: In freighter service (passenger versions retired in 2014; FedEx, UPS and others still operate over a hundred MD-11Fs into the 2030s).

photo.author: Bidgee
photo.creditZh: 相片：Bidgee／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 3.0 au）· FedEx MD-11F（N582FE）降落悉尼機場（2020 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Bidgee / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0 au) · FedEx MD-11F (N582FE) landing at Sydney Airport (2020)
photo.captionZh: FedEx 的 MD-11F 進場：尾引擎同翼尖小翼是三引擎廣體的最後身影。
photo.captionEn: A FedEx MD-11F on approach: tail engine and winglets — the last widebody trijet.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：MD11 代碼頁

seats.noteZh: 典型公務佈局（最多 11 名乘客）

range.noteZh: 最大航程（1,806 海里，輕載）

wings.zh: 低翼，翼尖有小翼；翼展比細一號的 King Air 200 明顯較闊。
wings.en: Low wing with winglets, noticeably wider than the smaller King Air 200's.

engines.zh: 兩台 PT6 裝在翼上長艙，螺旋槳四葉；排氣管在艙側前方，是 PT6 家族的記號。
engines.en: Two PT6s in long wing nacelles with four-blade props and the family's signature forward exhaust stubs.

fuselage.zh: 機身每邊比 200 系多兩隻窗，客艙可做「雙俱樂部」對坐佈局；機鼻圓而短。
fuselage.en: Two extra windows a side over the 200 series for double-club seating, on a short, rounded nose.

tail.zh: T 形尾翼，水平尾翼在垂直尾翼頂；尾部下方有腹鰭。
tail.en: T-tail with a ventral strake under the tail cone.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the King Air 200: longer here (two more windows a side) with a wider wing. Versus the PC-12 (card AC-0091): one engine there, two here — count them.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 King Air 200 比：350 機身較長（每邊多兩窗）、翼展較闊。同 PC-12 比（本網 AC-0091）：PC-12 得一台引擎，King Air 350 雙引擎；兩者大小相近，要數引擎數目。
aircraft.introEn: The default twin turboprop: short-field capable, eight-to-ten seats, doing everything from corporate flying to air ambulance and military surveillance work worldwide.
aircraft.introZh: 雙渦槳公務機的代名詞：King Air 350 可以落細機場、坐 8–10 人，由企業專機做到空中救護同軍用偵察，全球賣出逾千架的 350 系。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The King Air line has run since the 1960s — the longest-lived civil turboprop family. The 350 (Super King Air 350 until 1996) is the stretched, high-capacity model; today's successor is the King Air 360.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: King Air 家族由 1960 年代生產至今，是史上最長壽的民用渦槳家族；350 是加長高載版（1996 年前稱 Super King Air 350），現行後繼型為 King Air 360。本卡以 350 為代表。

history.statusZh: 服役中（350 生產至約 2009 年由 350i 接替，家族現行型為 King Air 360；全球機隊龐大）。
history.statusEn: In service (the 350 gave way to the 350i and today's King Air 360; the worldwide fleet remains very large).

photo.author: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
photo.creditZh: 相片：美國國家海洋暨大氣總署（NOAA）／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· NOAA 的 King Air 350 CER（N68RF）準備起飛（2015 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: NOAA / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · NOAA King Air 350 CER (N68RF) preparing for takeoff (2015)
photo.captionZh: NOAA 的 King Air 350：T 尾、雙 PT6 同加長客艙窗排。
photo.captionEn: NOAA's King Air 350: T-tail, twin PT6s and the long window line.

deepLinks.labelZh: 英文維基：Beechcraft Super King Air
ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：B350 代碼頁

engines.noteZh: 單台渦輪螺旋槳（NG 版為 -67P 前身 -67B）
engines.noteEn: Single turboprop (-67B on earlier NG aircraft)

seats.noteZh: 公務佈局 6 座至通勤 9 座（連機師最多 10 人）
seats.noteEn: Six executive to nine commuter seats (ten people max with pilot)

range.noteZh: NGX 最大航程（1,803 海里）

wings.zh: 低翼，翼尖有小翼；主翼位置偏前，令尾段顯得修長。
wings.en: Low wing with winglets, set well forward and leaving a long tail section.

engines.zh: 得一台引擎——機鼻 PT6 驅動四葉（NGX 五葉）螺旋槳，是同 King Air 級距分別的關鍵。
engines.en: Just one engine — a nose PT6 driving four blades (five on the NGX); the key split from King Air-class twins.

fuselage.zh: 機身粗壯，左側尾段有大型向上揭的貨艙門（1.35 × 1.32 米），是 PC-12 的招牌。
fuselage.en: Chunky fuselage with the signature large upward-opening aft cargo door (1.35 × 1.32 m) on the left side.

tail.zh: T 形尾翼，垂直尾翼後掠，尾下有腹鰭。
tail.en: T-tail with a swept fin and a ventral strake.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the King Air 350 (card AC-0090): similar size, but one engine and an aft cargo door here. Versus Pilatus's own PC-24 jet: twin fans and no propeller there.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 King Air 350 比（本網 AC-0090）：大小相近，但 PC-12 單引擎加尾貨門，King Air 雙引擎。同自家後繼 PC-24 噴射機比：PC-24 是雙扇引擎、無螺旋槳，睇機鼻就分到。
aircraft.introEn: The best-selling single turboprop: one engine, a business-jet cabin, a freighter's aft door and grass-strip manners — over two thousand sold from Switzerland.
aircraft.introZh: 單引擎渦槳的銷量王：PC-12 一台引擎做到公務機的客艙同貨機的尾門，可以落草地跑道，全球賣出逾二千架，瑞士製造的國民機。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The family runs PC-12/45, PC-12/47E (NG) and today's NGX; figures here are NGX (PT6A-67P, five-blade prop), told apart by window frames and blade count. The USAF special-operations version is the U-28A.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 家族有早期 PC-12/45、PC-12/47E（NG）同現行 PC-12 NGX；本卡規格以 NGX 為代表（PT6A-67P、五葉槳），外形分別主要是窗框同槳葉數目。美軍特戰版編號 U-28A。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續生產（PC-12 NGX 為現行型；全球機隊逾 2,000 架，包括澳洲皇家飛行醫生服務）。
history.statusEn: In production and worldwide service (the NGX is current; over 2,000 fly, including with Australia's Royal Flying Doctor Service).

photo.author: Adrian Pingstone
photo.creditZh: 相片：Adrian Pingstone／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· Pilatus PC-12（HB-FOT）降落費爾福德 RIAT（2006 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Adrian Pingstone / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · Pilatus PC-12 (HB-FOT) landing at RAF Fairford RIAT (2006)
photo.captionZh: 廠方示範機 PC-12 進場：單槳、T 尾同粗壯機身。
photo.captionEn: The Pilatus demonstrator PC-12 on approach: single prop, T-tail, chunky fuselage.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：PC12 代碼頁

length.noteZh: 旋翼轉動時全長（機身 9.50 米）

rotorDiameter.noteZh: 主旋翼直徑（兩葉半剛性旋翼）

engines.noteZh: 單台渦輪軸引擎（原稱 Allison 250）

seats.noteZh: 機師 1 名＋乘客 4 名（LongRanger 7 座）
seats.noteEn: One pilot plus four passengers (seven seats in the LongRanger)

range.noteZh: 最大航程（374 海里，無後備燃油）

wings.zh: 兩葉主旋翼，旋翼頭簡單外露（半剛性蹺蹺板式），旋轉時聲響特別易認。
wings.en: Two-blade main rotor on a simple exposed teetering head — and a sound you learn once and never forget.

engines.zh: 單台引擎裝在座艙後上方，兩個小排氣口向後；引擎艙令機背有一段隆起。
engines.en: Single engine behind the cabin with twin rear exhausts and a humped spine.

fuselage.zh: 機身如水滴形，前座大面積玻璃；五座版窗數較少，LongRanger 拉長後多一隻窗。
fuselage.en: Teardrop fuselage with a big glazed nose; the stretched LongRanger adds a window bay.

tail.zh: 尾槳兩葉開放式，尾樑幼長，末端有垂直尾翼同水平安定面。
tail.en: Two-blade open tail rotor on a long, thin tail boom with fin and tailplane.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus its Bell 407 successor (card AC-0018): four blades and a bigger cabin there; two blades here settle it. Versus the H125 (AC-0080): three blades and a rounder body there; two blades and a longer boom here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家後繼 Bell 407 比（本網 AC-0018）：407 四葉旋翼、機身較大；206 兩葉旋翼係決定性分別。同 H125 比（AC-0080）：H125 三葉旋翼同較圓短的機身；206 兩葉加長尾樑。
aircraft.introEn: The people's helicopter: over 7,000 Bell 206s since 1967, its two-blade 'whop-whop' overhead on news, police and sightseeing work — one of the most recognisable sounds in the sky.
aircraft.introZh: 直升機界的「國民車」：Bell 206 自 1967 年賣出逾七千架，兩葉旋翼「答答」聲由新聞採訪、警務巡邏到觀光飛行都聽到，是全球最易撞到的直升機之一。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The family pairs the five-seat JetRanger (206A/B) with the stretched seven-seat LongRanger (206L). Figures are for the common 206B-3; the photo shows a stretched 206L-4 (longer cabin, extra window), otherwise identical. The OH-58 Kiowa is its military sibling.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 家族有五座 JetRanger（206A/B）同加長七座 LongRanger（206L）；本卡規格以最常見的 206B-3 為代表，相片是加長版 206L-4 LongRanger（機身較長、窗多一隻），其餘特徵相同。軍用版 OH-58 Kiowa 同源。

history.statusZh: 服役中（2017 年停產，全球仍有數千架在飛；二手市場同訓練學校主力）。
history.statusEn: In service (production ended in 2017, but thousands still fly and anchor the used and training markets).

photo.author: Anna Zvereva
photo.creditZh: 相片：Anna Zvereva／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· New York Helicopter 的 Bell 206L-4 LongRanger（N405MR）懸停中（2014 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Anna Zvereva / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · New York Helicopter Bell 206L-4 LongRanger (N405MR) hovering (2014)
photo.captionZh: LongRanger 版 206 懸停中：兩葉旋翼、水滴機身同長尾樑。
photo.captionEn: A LongRanger 206 hovering: two-blade rotor, teardrop cabin, long boom.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：B06 代碼頁

length.noteZh: 旋翼轉動時全長（機身 10.68 米）

engines.noteZh: 單台渦輪軸引擎（T2 型）

seats.noteZh: 機師 1 名＋乘客 6 名（部分佈局 7 名乘客）
seats.noteEn: One pilot plus six passengers (seven in some layouts)

wings.zh: 三葉主旋翼，旋翼頭低矮；同 AS350 家族同源但機身明顯較闊。
wings.en: Three-blade main rotor on a low mast; AS350 ancestry but a clearly wider body.

engines.zh: 單台 Arriel 裝在座艙後上方，排氣口在機背右側。
engines.en: Single Arriel behind the cabin, exhausting on the right side of the spine.

fuselage.zh: 機身特別闊，前排特大弧形玻璃一覽無遺，地板平坦——為觀光客設計的記號。
fuselage.en: Extra-wide fuselage with a huge curved front windscreen and flat floor — designed around sightseeing passengers.

tail.zh: 涵道尾槳（fenestron）：尾翼入面的圓形風扇令噪音大減，是同 H125 最易分的分別。
tail.en: Fenestron tail — the fan inside the fin cuts noise and is the easiest split from the H125.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the H125 (card AC-0080): same roots, but a much wider body and fenestron here versus an open tail rotor. Versus the Bell 206 (AC-0092): two blades and an open rotor there; three blades and a fenestron here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 H125 比（本網 AC-0080）：同源但 H130 機身闊得多、用涵道尾槳；H125 是開放尾槳。同 Bell 206 比（AC-0092）：206 兩葉旋翼加開放尾槳，H130 三葉加涵道，尾部一看即分。
aircraft.introEn: The sightseeing helicopter's first class: a giant curved windscreen, flat floor and quiet fenestron — Grand Canyon and Las Vegas tour ramps are lined with H130s.
aircraft.introZh: 觀光直升機的頭等艙：H130 以特大弧形風擋、平坦地板同涵道尾槳的低噪音做招牌，大峽谷、拉斯維加斯同各地觀光航線成排都是佢。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Born as the EC130 and renamed H130 in 2015 — a wide-body, sightseeing-optimised evolution of the AS350 Squirrel. Figures are for the current EC130 T2 (Arriel 2D, increased gross weight).
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 前身編號 EC130（2015 年改名 H130），源自 AS350 松鼠的寬體版，主打觀光飛行的大窗同低噪音；本卡以現行 EC130 T2 為代表（Arriel 2D、增重型）。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續生產（觀光、救護同接送市場主力輕型機之一）。
history.statusEn: In production and worldwide service (a leading light helicopter for touring, EMS and shuttle work).

photo.author: Bidgee
photo.creditZh: 相片：Bidgee／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 3.0 au）· Microflite 的 EC130 T2（VH-WVV）停泊 Wagga Wagga 機場（2017 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Bidgee / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0 au) · Microflite EC130 T2 (VH-WVV) at Wagga Wagga Airport (2017)
photo.captionZh: 紅色 EC130 T2：闊機身、大風擋同涵道尾槳齊晒。
photo.captionEn: A red EC130 T2: wide body, big windscreen and fenestron.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：EC30 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 麥克唐納-道格拉斯 F-15 鷹式

range.noteZh: 轉場航程（適形油箱加外掛）；作戰半徑約 1,965 公里
range.noteEn: Ferry range with conformal and external tanks; combat radius about 1,965 km

wings.zh: 主翼大而薄，前緣後掠，翼根同機身融合（blended），翼下可掛大量武器。
wings.en: Large, thin wing blended into the fuselage, with heavy underwing stores capability.

engines.zh: 兩台引擎並排在機尾，方形進氣口在機身兩側（可調斜板），尾噴口外露。
engines.en: Twin engines side by side with boxy variable intakes on the fuselage sides and exposed nozzles.

fuselage.zh: 機鼻修長，座艙罩高聳視野極佳；機背有一塊大型減速板。
fuselage.en: Long nose, a high bubble canopy with superb visibility, and a large dorsal airbrake.

tail.zh: 雙垂直尾翼是 F-15 的招牌，兩片尾翼外傾少許，中間夾一對水平尾翼。
tail.en: Twin, slightly canted vertical fins — the Eagle's signature — with tailplanes between the nozzles.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the F-16 (card AC-0023): one engine, one fin and a chin intake there; twin engines and twin fins, a size up, here. Versus the Su-30 (AC-0070): canards there, none here; intake shape and canopy proportions decide it.
aircraft.similarZh: 同自家 F-16 比（本網 AC-0023）：F-16 單引擎單尾翼、機腹進氣；F-15 雙引擎雙尾翼大一截。同對手 Su-30 比（AC-0070）：Su-30 有前置鴨翼，F-15 無；兩者都雙尾翼，要睇進氣口形狀同座艙比例。
aircraft.introEn: The Cold War air-superiority icon: twin engines, twin tails and enough thrust to accelerate vertically — flown by the US, Japan, Korea, Israel and Singapore, and an airshow staple.
aircraft.introZh: 冷戰空優的圖騰：F-15 鷹式雙引擎、雙尾翼，推力大到可以垂直爬升加速，美、日、韓、以色列、新加坡空軍都用佢，航展常客。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The family spans the single-seat F-15C air-superiority fighter, the two-seat F-15E strike version (the photo aircraft) and the new F-15EX. Dimensions are common across variants. After fifty years it remains a front-line fighter with a 104:0 air-combat record.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 家族有單座空優型 F-15C、雙座打擊型 F-15E（相片即 E 型）同最新 F-15EX；本卡尺寸為各型共通數字，座位以 C／E 並記。服役逾半世紀仍是多國空軍主力，實戰空戰紀錄 104:0。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續改良（F-15EX 仍在交付；全球機隊逾千架，預計服役至 2040 年代）。
history.statusEn: In service and still evolving (F-15EX deliveries continue; a fleet of over a thousand, expected to serve into the 2040s).

photo.author: U.S. Air Force / MSgt. Thomas Meneguin
photo.creditZh: 相片：美國空軍／MSgt. Thomas Meneguin 經 Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· 第 4 戰鬥機聯隊 F-15E 打擊鷹正面飛行（2000 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: U.S. Air Force / MSgt. Thomas Meneguin via Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · 4th Fighter Wing F-15E Strike Eagle head-on (2000)
photo.captionZh: F-15E 正面迎來：雙尾翼、大主翼同意氣口佈局一覽無遺。
photo.captionEn: An F-15E head-on: twin fins, big wing and intake layout in one frame.

deepLinks.labelZh: 英文維基：McDonnell Douglas F-15 Eagle
中文維基：F-15 鷹式戰鬥機
ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：F15 代碼頁

engines.noteZh: 四台渦輪螺旋槳（每台約 11,000 軸馬力），八葉槳
engines.noteEn: Four turboprops of about 11,000 shp each, eight-blade propellers

payload.noteZh: 最大載重（或 116 名傘兵）

range.noteZh: 載 30 噸航程（最大載重 3,300 公里；轉場 8,900 公里）
range.noteEn: Range with 30 t (3,300 km at max payload; 8,900 km ferry)

cruise.noteZh: 巡航（約 781 km/h，渦槳機中最快）
cruise.noteEn: Cruise (about 781 km/h — fastest in its class)

wings.zh: 高置主翼，翼尖下反少許；四個引擎艙沿翼展排開，螺旋槳左右兩對反向轉（down-between-engines 設計）。
wings.en: High wing with slight anhedral tips; four nacelles across the span, propellers turning 'down between engines'.

engines.zh: TP400 是史上最強渦槳之一，八葉彎刀形槳葉極易認；引擎艙粗大。
engines.en: The TP400 is among the most powerful turboprops ever flown, with unmistakable eight-blade scimitar propellers.

fuselage.zh: 機身粗短，貨艙橫切面 4×4 米；機尾向上收起連尾艙門，兩側主輪艙外凸（sponsons）。
fuselage.en: Short, fat fuselage with a 4×4 m hold, upswept rear loading ramp and bulged gear sponsons each side.

tail.zh: T 形尾翼，垂直尾翼高大，尾翼根部有長背鰭。
tail.en: T-tail on a tall fin with a long dorsal fillet.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the C-130H (card AC-0026): same high-wing four-turboprop layout, but nearly twice the size, eight-blade props and much faster. Versus the C-17 (AC-0025): jets and a longer body there; propellers and a stubbier frame here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 C-130H 比（本網 AC-0026）：同樣四渦槳高翼，但 A400M 大近一倍、槳葉八葉、速度快得多。同 C-17 比（AC-0025）：C-17 是噴射引擎同較長機身；A400M 螺旋槳同短粗身段分別明顯。
aircraft.introEn: Europe's airlift flagship: four big turboprops, 37 tonnes onto dirt strips, near-jet speed — German, French, British and Spanish fleets fly it at airshows and evacuation missions alike.
aircraft.introZh: 歐洲的運輸旗艦：A400M 四台大渦槳可以載 37 噸貨落泥地跑道，速度又接近噴射機，德、法、英、西空軍機隊在航展同撤僑任務都見到佢。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Europe's multinational tactical/strategic airlifter, with no sub-variants; it doubles as a tanker with underwing pods. The photo is Airbus test aircraft EC-400 arriving at RIAT (the filename's 'Spanish Air Force' caption is wrong, as the author notes on the file page).
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 歐洲多國聯合研發的戰術／戰略運輸機，無其他子型號；可兼任空中加油機（加油吊艙）。相片是空中巴士試飛機 EC-400 抵達 RIAT（檔案名誤植西班牙空軍，作者已在相片頁註明更正）。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（十個用戶國，產量逾 120 架；西班牙塞維利亞總裝）。
history.statusEn: In service with deliveries continuing (ten customer nations, over 120 built; final assembly at Seville).

photo.author: Adrian Pingstone
photo.creditZh: 相片：Adrian Pingstone／Wikimedia Commons（公共領域）· 空中巴士 A400M 試飛機（EC-400）抵達費爾福德 RIAT（2019 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Adrian Pingstone / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · Airbus A400M test aircraft (EC-400) arriving at RAF Fairford RIAT (2019)
photo.captionZh: A400M 進場：四台八葉槳渦槳、高翼同 T 尾齊晒。
photo.captionEn: An A400M arriving: four eight-blade turboprops, high wing, T-tail.

deepLinks.labelZh: 中文維基：空中巴士 A400M
ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：A400 代碼頁

wings.zh: 主翼同 A320 一樣大，但裝在明顯短一截的機身，所以翼相對特別大。
wings.en: Same big wing as the A320 on a clearly shorter fuselage — the wing looks oversized.

engines.zh: 兩台 CFM56 或 V2500 掛在翼下，機身短，引擎同機尾距離近。
engines.en: Two CFM56 or V2500 engines under the wing, close behind the short cabin.

fuselage.zh: A320 家族面孔，機身得 33.8 米，窗數明顯少過 A320；機翼前後各一隻門加翼上逃生門。
fuselage.en: The A320 face on a 33.8 m fuselage with visibly fewer windows than an A320.

tail.zh: 高尾翼加紅白格仔尾（相片 Volotea 塗裝）；翼尖鯊鰭向上翹。
tail.en: Tall tail and up-swept sharklets at the wingtips.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the A320-200 (card AC-0084): the A320 is 37.6 m with an extra window bay and two overwing exits; the A319 is nearly 4 m shorter. Versus the 737-700: lower tail and flatter-bottomed engine intakes there.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 A320-200 比（本網 AC-0084）：A320 長 37.6 米、多一排窗同多一對翼上逃生門；A319 短近 4 米。同 737-700 比：737 尾翼較矮、引擎進氣口底部較平。
aircraft.introEn: The shortest member of the A320 family: a clipped fuselage on the same wing and engines as its bigger brothers, which makes it lively — a staple of European short-haul and hot-and-high airports.
aircraft.introZh: A320 家族入面最短的一員：機身短一截，但翼同引擎同大哥一樣，所以飛得特別靈活，係歐洲短途航線同高海拔機場的常客。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Siblings are the longer A320/A321 and the shorter A318. Figures are for the A319-100; the photo aircraft wears sharklets (35.80 m span versus 34.10 m originally).
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 家族另有加長的 A320／A321 同再短的 A318。規格以 A319-100 為準；相片機已裝鯊鰭翼尖，翼展 35.80 米（原始翼尖 34.10 米）。

history.statusZh: 服役中（A320 家族最短成員，仍有逾千架營運；亦用作 ACJ 公務機）。
history.statusEn: In service (the shortest A320-family member; over a thousand still fly, and it doubles as the ACJ corporate jet).

photo.author: Hugo LUC
photo.creditZh: 相片：Hugo LUC／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· Volotea 的 A319（EC-MTF）雨中降落
photo.creditEn: Photo: Hugo LUC / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Volotea A319 (EC-MTF) landing in the rain
photo.captionZh: 雨中降落的 A319：短機身、大翼面一目了然。
photo.captionEn: An A319 landing in the rain: short fuselage, big wing.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：A319 代碼頁

wings.zh: 主翼同全長比例下顯得較短，因為機身拉到 44.5 米；翼較 A320 加強。
wings.en: The wing looks short against the 44.5 m fuselage (and is strengthened versus the A320).

engines.zh: 兩台 CFM56 或 V2500；機身長，後引擎位置相對靠前段。
engines.en: Two CFM56 or V2500 engines; on this long fuselage they sit relatively far forward.

fuselage.zh: 窄體機最長一群：窗數多，前後各兩隻全尺寸艙門，唔靠翼上逃生門。
fuselage.en: Among the longest narrowbodies: many windows and four full-size doors a side — no reliance on overwing exits.

tail.zh: 尾翼高 11.8 米，漢莎機尾有金色仙鶴圓標（相片塗裝）。
tail.en: An 11.8 m tail; the photo aircraft wears Lufthansa's crane roundel.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the A320 (AC-0084): almost 7 m longer with four full doors instead of overwing exits. Versus the A321neo (AC-0073): much fatter engines and different winglets there.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 A320 比（AC-0084）：A321 長近 7 米，艙門係四隻全尺寸而非翼上逃生門。同 A321neo 比（AC-0073）：neo 引擎明顯較粗、翼尖鯊鰭不同，機尾 APU 排氣亦有別。
aircraft.introEn: The big brother of the A320 family: stretched to 44.5 m, it carries the most passengers of any classic narrowbody and anchors countless short- and medium-haul fleets.
aircraft.introZh: A320 家族的大哥：機身拉到 44.5 米，係窄體機入面載客最多的一群，亦係好多航空公司中短途航線的主力。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The first-flight date is the family's A321-100 (1993); the longer-range -200 followed. Figures are for the A321-200.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 首飛日期為家族首款 A321-100（1993），-200 增程型隨後推出。規格以 A321-200 為準。

history.statusZh: 服役中（A320 家族最長成員；新一代 A321neo 已接棒生產）。
history.statusEn: In service (the longest classic A320-family member; the A321neo has taken over production).

photo.author: Laurent Errera
photo.creditZh: 相片：Laurent Errera／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 漢莎 A321-200（D-AISI）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Laurent Errera / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Lufthansa A321-200 (D-AISI)
photo.captionZh: 起飛中的 A321-200：窄體機最長的機身。
photo.captionEn: An A321-200 climbing out: the longest classic narrowbody fuselage.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：A321 代碼頁

range.noteZh: 航程（3,440 海里，裝翼尖小翼）

wings.zh: 翼尖小翼向上翹起（相片西南航空機），係新世代 737 的標記。
wings.en: Blended winglets sweep up at the tips — the Next Generation signature in this photo.

engines.zh: CFM56-7B 引擎進氣口底部較平，因為離地較低。
engines.en: CFM56-7B nacelles with flattened intake bottoms — the 737 sits low.

fuselage.zh: 機身 33.6 米，較 -800 短一截；駕駛艙窗上方有眉窗的早期機更易認（後期取消）。
fuselage.en: A 33.6 m fuselage, visibly shorter than the -800.

tail.zh: 尾翼高 12.6 米，相對機身比例偏高。
tail.en: A tall 12.6 m tail for the fuselage length.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the 737-800: the -800 is 39.5 m with more windows; the -700 is nearly 6 m shorter. Versus the A319: higher-set engines and tail there; the flat-bottomed intakes give the Boeing away.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 737-800 比（第一批高級清單代表）：-800 長 39.5 米、多一排窗；-700 短近 6 米。同 A319 比：A319 翼下引擎離地較高、尾翼較高聳，737 進氣口底平係關鍵。
aircraft.introEn: The baseline Next Generation 737: Southwest built an empire on it, and it remains one of the commonest sights on US domestic routes — compact and worked hard.
aircraft.introZh: 波音新世代 737 的基本型：西南航空靠佢起家，係美國國內線最常見的面孔之一，短小精悍、起降頻密。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Longer -800/-900ER siblings exist; the -700 also underpins the BBJ business jet. Figures are for the -700.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 家族有更長的 -800／-900ER；-700 亦是波音公務機 BBJ 的基礎。規格為 -700。

history.statusZh: 服役中（新世代 737 最短型；西南航空為最大用戶，產量逾 1,100 架）。
history.statusEn: In service (the shortest Next Generation 737; Southwest is the biggest user, with over 1,100 built).

photo.author: Dylan Ashe
photo.creditZh: 相片：Dylan Ashe／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 西南航空 737-700（N231WN）進場中
photo.creditEn: Photo: Dylan Ashe / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Southwest 737-700 (N231WN) on approach
photo.captionZh: 西南航空 737-700 進場：翼尖小翼同平底進氣口。
photo.captionEn: A Southwest 737-700 on approach: winglets and flat-bottomed intakes.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：B737 代碼頁

engines.value: 2 × Pratt & Whitney PW4000, GE CF6-80 or Rolls-Royce RB211

wings.zh: 廣體雙通道但翼展只有 47.6 米，係廣體機入面較細的一款。
wings.en: A widebody twin-aisle on a modest 47.6 m wing — the smallest of the widebody twins.

engines.zh: 兩台大引擎掛翼下；可選 PW4000、CF6 或 RB211。
engines.en: Two big underwing engines — PW4000, CF6 or RB211 depending on customer.

fuselage.zh: 機身闊 5.03 米，經濟艙多為 2-3-2 佈局；鼻頭圓潤，駕駛艙窗線平。
fuselage.en: A 5.03 m-wide cabin, usually 2-3-2 in economy; rounded nose, level cockpit windows.

tail.zh: 尾翼高 15.9 米，尾部 APU 排氣呈圓錐形收尾。
tail.en: A 15.9 m tail with a tapered APU cone at the rear.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the 787-8 (AC-0037): raked wingtips and chevron engine nozzles there. Versus the A330-300 (AC-0049): a much bigger wing with winglets and a taller tail there.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 787-8 比（AC-0037）：787 翼尖上翹弧度大、引擎有鋸齒尾緣，機身較長。同 A330-300 比（AC-0049）：A330 翼展大得多兼有翼尖小翼，尾翼較高。
aircraft.introEn: Boeing's first widebody twin: in the 1980s it opened the twin-engine transoceanic era, and after decades with Delta, United and others it still works the Atlantic.
aircraft.introZh: 波音第一款廣體雙引擎長途機：1980 年代靠佢打開越洋雙引擎時代，達美同聯航飛咗幾十年，至今仲係跨大西洋常客。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: First flight was the baseline 767-300 (1986); the -300ER entered service in 1988. Passenger figures are for the -300ER; the freighter sibling is card AC-0050.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 首飛為 767-300 基本型（1986）；-300ER 增程型 1988 年投入服務。客機規格以 -300ER 為準；同型貨機版另見 AC-0050。

history.statusZh: 客機版漸退（增程型 1988 年起交付）；貨機版 767-300F 同軍用加油機版繼續生產。
history.statusEn: Passenger versions are retiring (the ER arrived from 1988); the 767-300F freighter and military tanker versions remain in production.

photo.author: Dale Coleman
photo.creditZh: 相片：Dale Coleman／JetPhotos 經 Wikimedia Commons（GFDL 1.2）· 達美航空 767-300ER 起飛中
photo.creditEn: Photo: Dale Coleman / JetPhotos via Wikimedia Commons (GFDL 1.2) · Delta 767-300ER taking off
photo.captionZh: 達美 767-300ER 起飛：廣體雙引擎的始祖級面孔。
photo.captionEn: A Delta 767-300ER lifting off: the original widebody twin.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：B763 代碼頁

wings.zh: 翼尖有小型翼刀，翼形修長；齒輪傳動引擎風扇直徑大，機身相對顯得引擎粗。
wings.en: A slender wing with small winglets; the big geared fan looks chunky against the slim fuselage.

engines.zh: 兩台 PW1500G 齒輪傳動渦扇，進氣口大而圓。
engines.en: Two PW1500G geared turbofans with big, round intakes.

fuselage.zh: 機身得 35 米，經濟艙五座並排（2-3），窗戶特別大。
fuselage.en: A 35 m fuselage seating five abreast (2-3) with notably large windows.

tail.zh: 尾翼相對較高，尾翼尖有弧度；機尾 APU 段收窄明顯。
tail.en: A fairly tall tail and a noticeably tapered rear fuselage.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the A220-300 (AC-0077): the -300 is 38.7 m with extra window bays. Versus the E195-E2 (AC-0079): four-abreast seating and smaller windows there.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 A220-300 比（AC-0077）：-300 長 38.7 米、多兩排窗；-100 短一截。同 E195-E2 比（AC-0079）：E2 引擎同為齒輪傳動，但機身四座並排、窗較細。
aircraft.introEn: Born as the smaller Bombardier C Series and adopted by Airbus: five-abreast seating, big windows and quiet geared engines — the most modern hundred-seater flying.
aircraft.introZh: 原本係龐巴迪 C系列的細佬，後來過繼空中巴士：五座並排、窗大、引擎靜，係一百座級入面最先進的窄體機。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: It first flew in 2013 as the CS100 and became the A220-100 when Airbus took over in 2018. Figures are for the -100; the longer -300 is card AC-0077.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 2013 年首飛時仍叫 CS100；2018 年空中巴士入主後改名 A220-100。規格以 -100 為準，加長型 -300 另見 AC-0077。

history.statusZh: 服役中（原龐巴迪 C系列 CS100，2018 年改歸空中巴士；達美為主要用戶）。
history.statusEn: In service (born as the Bombardier CS100, adopted by Airbus in 2018; Delta is the anchor customer).

photo.author: Adam Moreira
photo.creditZh: 相片：Adam Moreira／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 達美航空 A220-100（N108DQ）進場紐約拉瓜迪亞
photo.creditEn: Photo: Adam Moreira / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Delta A220-100 (N108DQ) arriving at New York LaGuardia
photo.captionZh: 達美 A220-100 進場：五座並排、大窗、粗引擎。
photo.captionEn: A Delta A220-100 on approach: five-abreast cabin, big windows, big fan.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：BCS1 代碼頁

wings.zh: 翼平直細長，裝在低翼位置；無翼尖小翼（早期型）。
wings.en: A straight, slender low wing (early aircraft have no winglets).

engines.zh: 兩台 AE 3007 吊在機尾兩側，T 型尾翼——支線機經典佈局。
engines.en: Two AE 3007 engines flank the tail under a T-tail — the classic regional layout.

fuselage.zh: 機身極細長（29.9 米得 50 座），窗細密，1-2 佈局無中間位。
fuselage.en: A very slim 29.9 m fuselage for 50 seats in a 1-2 layout — no middle seat.

tail.zh: T 型尾翼，水平尾翼裝在垂直尾翼頂。
tail.en: T-tail with the tailplane on top of the fin.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the CRJ700 (AC-0102): winglets and a fatter 70-seat fuselage there. Versus the E175 (AC-0087): underwing engines and a much bigger cabin there.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 CRJ700 比（AC-0102）：CRJ 主翼有翼尖小翼、機身較粗可載 70 人；ERJ 145 得 50 座、機身更幼。同 E175 比（AC-0087）：E175 引擎掛翼下、機身粗得多。
aircraft.introEn: The definitive fifty-seat regional jet: in the 1990s it took US regional flying all-jet — a pencil-slim fuselage with tail-mounted engines, over a thousand built.
aircraft.introZh: 五十座支線噴射機的代表作：1990 年代令美國支線航線全面噴射化，細長機身加尾吊引擎，產量逾千架。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Shorter ERJ 135/140 siblings exist. Figures are for the common ERJ 145LR.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 家族有縮短的 ERJ 135／140。規格以最常見的 ERJ 145LR 為準。

history.statusZh: 服役中（生產至 2020 年前後；逾千架家族機仍在支線及包機市場營運）。
history.statusEn: In service (production ran to about 2020; over a thousand family jets still work regional and charter routes).

photo.author: Sla2931
photo.creditZh: 相片：Sla2931／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 3.0）· 美鷹航空 ERJ 145（N928AE）停泊登機口
photo.creditEn: Photo: Sla2931 / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0) · American Eagle ERJ 145 (N928AE) at the gate
photo.captionZh: 閘口的 ERJ 145：細長機身、尾吊引擎、T 尾。
photo.captionEn: An ERJ 145 at the gate: slim fuselage, rear engines, T-tail.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：E145 代碼頁

wings.zh: 低翼加明顯翼尖小翼，同 ERJ 的平直翼不同。
wings.en: A low wing with pronounced winglets — unlike the ERJ's plain wing.

engines.zh: 兩台 CF34 吊在機尾兩側，排氣長而幼。
engines.en: Two CF34s flank the tail with long, slim exhausts.

fuselage.zh: 機身較 ERJ 粗，窗線較高；機頭尖而長。
fuselage.en: A fatter fuselage and higher window line than the ERJ; long pointed nose.

tail.zh: T 型尾翼，垂尾後掠明顯。
tail.en: Swept fin with a T-tail.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the ERJ 145 (AC-0101): about 20 more seats and winglets here. Versus the CRJ900: the 900 is another stretch with more windows.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 ERJ 145 比（AC-0101）：CRJ 載客多約 20 人兼有翼尖小翼；同 CRJ900 比：900 再長一截、窗數更多。
aircraft.introEn: A Challenger business jet stretched into a 70-seater: low wing, rear engines and winglets — a backbone of North American regional networks.
aircraft.introZh: 由公務機 Challenger 拉長而成的 70 座支線機：低翼、尾吊引擎、翼尖小翼，係北美支線網絡的中堅。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The CRJ900 and CRJ1000 are its siblings. Figures are for the CRJ700.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 家族另有 CRJ900（AC 清單）同 CRJ1000。規格以 CRJ700 為準。

history.statusZh: 服役中（三菱重工接手支援；美國支線市場主力之一，逾 800 架家族機交付）。
history.statusEn: In service (support now with Mitsubishi; a US regional mainstay with 800-plus family deliveries).

photo.author: Colin Brown Photo
photo.creditZh: 相片：Colin Brown／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY 2.0）· 美鷹航空 CRJ-700（N709PS）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Colin Brown / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0) · American Eagle CRJ-700 (N709PS)
photo.captionZh: CRJ700 在跑道上：翼尖小翼、尾吊引擎、尖機頭。
photo.captionEn: A CRJ700 taxiing: winglets, rear engines, pointed nose.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：CRJ7 代碼頁

wings.zh: 高翼加六葉螺旋槳，引擎艙修長；主翼無後掠。
wings.en: A straight high wing with six-blade propellers and slim nacelles.

engines.zh: 兩台 PW127 渦槳，排氣在翼後；螺旋槳直徑 3.93 米。
engines.en: Two PW127 turboprops driving 3.93 m propellers.

fuselage.zh: 機身短粗（22.7 米），高翼令座艙窗線高；後登機門係 ATR 特色。
fuselage.en: A short, deep 22.7 m fuselage with a high window line; boarding is by the rear door, ATR-style.

tail.zh: T 型尾翼，垂尾高，尾翼尖平直。
tail.en: A tall fin with a T-tail.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the ATR 72-600: the 72 is 27.2 m with about 70 seats; the 42 is the short 48-seater. Versus the Dash 8 Q400 (AC-0088): much bigger and faster there; the ATR trades speed for economy.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 ATR 72-600 比（第四批已收）：72 長 27.2 米、載 70 人，42 短一截得 48 人左右；同 Dash 8 Q400 比（AC-0088）：Q400 大得多、快得多，ATR 慢而慳油。
aircraft.introEn: The smaller ATR: a 48-seat high-wing turboprop built for short strips and island hops — slow, frugal and everywhere that runways are short.
aircraft.introZh: ATR 家族的細佬：48 座高翼渦槳機，專走短跑道同島嶼航線，慢但慳油，落後地區機場成日見到佢。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: First flight and entry into service are for the ATR 42 family (1984/1985); the -600 is the 2010s glass-cockpit update. ICAO code AT45 also covers the -500. Figures are for the 42-600.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 首飛／投產為 ATR 42 家族（1984／1985）；-600 是 2010 年代玻璃座艙改良型。ICAO 代碼 AT45 同時涵蓋 -500／-600。規格以 42-600 為準。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續生產（-600 為現行玻璃座艙型，2012 年起交付；島嶼及短跑道航線主力）。
history.statusEn: In production and worldwide service (the glass-cockpit -600 has been delivered since 2012; an island and short-runway staple).

photo.author: Fabrizio Gandolfo
photo.creditZh: 相片：Fabrizio Gandolfo／JetPhotos 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 奧林匹克航空 ATR 42-600（SX-OAW）於雅典
photo.creditEn: Photo: Fabrizio Gandolfo / JetPhotos via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Olympic Air ATR 42-600 (SX-OAW) at Athens
photo.captionZh: 奧林匹克航空的 ATR 42-600：高翼、六葉槳、短粗機身。
photo.captionEn: Olympic Air's ATR 42-600: high wing, six-blade props, short deep fuselage.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：AT45 代碼頁

engines.value: 4 × Pratt & Whitney PW4000, GE CF6-80 or Rolls-Royce RB211

wings.zh: 翼尖有 1.8 米小翼，係 -400 的標記（747-8 翼尖改為弧形）。
wings.en: A 1.8 m winglet marks the -400 (the 747-8 uses a raked tip instead).

engines.zh: 四台引擎翼下掛載，機鼻貨門令機頭輪廓同客機一樣圓。
engines.en: Four underwing engines; the nose door keeps the classic 747 nose profile.

fuselage.zh: 機身無客窗（或少量），主貨艙全長 6.1 米闊貨艙；機鼻可向上揭 90 度入貨。
fuselage.en: Few or no cabin windows; the nose visor hinges up for drive-in loading.

tail.zh: 尾翼高 19.4 米，上層駕駛艙令機頭有經典「瘤」。
tail.en: A 19.4 m tail and the classic upper-deck hump over the nose.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the 747-8F (AC-0008): longer fuselage, raked tips and chevron nozzles there. Versus the 777F: twin engines and no nose door there.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 747-8F 比（AC-0008）：-8 機身更長、翼尖弧形無小翼、引擎鋸齒尾緣。同 777F 比：777F 雙引擎、無機鼻貨門。
aircraft.introEn: The classic 747 freighter: the whole nose swings up for cargo — air freight's packhorse for thirty years and a regular at Hong Kong's cargo terminals.
aircraft.introZh: 747 貨機版的經典：機鼻成個向上揭開入貨，係空運界三十年來的駝獸，香港貨運站亦成日見到佢。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: First flight was the passenger 747-400 (1988); the freighter followed in 1993. Figures are for the 747-400F.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 首飛為 747-400 客機（1988）；貨機型 1993 年投產。規格以 747-400F 為準（客機版另見清單 747-400 卡）。

history.statusZh: 服役中（747-400 貨機版；客機版已退，貨機仍有逾二百架營運，機鼻貨門獨一無二）。
history.statusEn: In freighter service (passenger 747-400s have retired, but over two hundred freighters still fly — the nose door is unique).

photo.author: BriYYZ
photo.creditZh: 相片：BriYYZ／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· Cargolux 747-400F（LX-ICV）於洛杉磯起飛
photo.creditEn: Photo: BriYYZ / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Cargolux 747-400F (LX-ICV) departing Los Angeles
photo.captionZh: Cargolux 747-400F 起飛：四引擎、翼尖小翼、無窗貨艙。
photo.captionEn: A Cargolux 747-400F climbing out: four engines, winglets, windowless hold.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：B744 代碼頁

wings.zh: 翼尖小翼同客機版一樣；留意主貨艙門框線在機身左側前段。
wings.en: Passenger-style winglets; look for the cargo-door outline on the forward left fuselage.

engines.zh: 兩台 CFM56-7B，平底進氣口照舊。
engines.en: Two CFM56-7Bs with the usual flat-bottomed intakes.

fuselage.zh: 客窗全部封掉（相片只見一列封窗痕），機身左前有大型主貨門。
fuselage.en: Cabin windows are plugged (a faint window line remains); a big main-deck door sits forward on the left.

tail.zh: 尾翼同客機版相同；貨機多數塗裝較素，航空公司標誌集中在尾翼。
tail.en: Standard 737 tail; freighter liveries are plain, with branding on the tail.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the passenger 737-800: plugged windows, the big left-side door and plain paint. Versus 757 freighters: longer, slimmer and heavier-lifting there.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 737-800 客機版比：分別在封窗、左側大貨門同素色塗裝。同 757-200 貨機版比：757 更長更瘦、載重更大。
aircraft.introEn: A second life for retired airliners: seats out, a side cargo door in — the 737-800BCF hauls e-commerce parcels and is the fastest-growing freighter fleet; this photo was taken at Macau.
aircraft.introZh: 退休客機的第二人生：737-800 拆走座位、開側貨門變貨機，專飛電商包裹，係近年增長最快的貨機群，相片仲要喺澳門影。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: First flight was the passenger 737-800 (1997); the BCF (Boeing Converted Freighter) was first delivered in 2018. Figures are for the converted freighter. The passenger version is the earlier 737-800 card.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 首飛為 737-800 客機（1997）；BCF（Boeing Converted Freighter）2018 年首架交付。規格以改裝後貨機為準。客機版另見第一批 737-800 卡。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續改裝（客改貨市場最暢銷型號之一，改裝線遍布多國，亞洲用戶眾多）。
history.statusEn: In service with conversions continuing (one of the best-selling passenger-to-freighter conversions, with lines worldwide and many Asian operators).

photo.author: Melvin Loi
photo.creditZh: 相片：Melvin Loi（澳門）／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· World Cargo Airlines 737-800BCF（9M-WCA）於澳門
photo.creditEn: Photo: Melvin Loi (Macau) / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · World Cargo Airlines 737-800BCF (9M-WCA) at Macau
photo.captionZh: 在澳門拍攝的 737-800BCF：封窗、紅色貨機塗裝、側貨門。
photo.captionEn: A 737-800BCF photographed at Macau: plugged windows, freighter livery, side door.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：B738 代碼頁

length.noteZh: 全長（旋翼轉動；括號為機身長）
length.noteEn: Overall length, rotors turning (fuselage in brackets)

wings.zh: 四葉主旋翼，旋翼頭有整流罩；尾槳在垂尾左側。
wings.en: Four-blade main rotor with a faired hub; tail rotor on the fin.

engines.zh: 兩台引擎並排在座艙後上方，排氣向兩側；D 型用 PW210S。
engines.en: Twin engines side by side behind the cabin, exhausting sideways.

fuselage.zh: 機身流線修長，可收放起落架係同級少數；窗大而多，VIP 味濃。
fuselage.en: A sleek fuselage with retractable gear — rare in class — and big VIP windows.

tail.zh: 垂尾下有腹鰭，尾輪式起落架令機尾較低。
tail.en: A ventral fin and tailwheel gear give a nose-high sit.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the AW139: bigger there with a nosewheel; the S-76 is sleeker with fully retracting gear. Versus the H155: a conventional tail rotor here, no fenestron.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 AW139 比（中級清單）：139 較大載 15 人、尾輪在機鼻；S-76 線條較修長、起落架全收放。同 H155 比：S-76 無涵道尾槳，用普通尾槳。
aircraft.introEn: The Rolls-Royce of offshore flying: designed in the 1970s to ferry oil-platform crews, it became a head-of-state favourite — the photo aircraft served The Queen's Helicopter Flight.
aircraft.introZh: 離岸石油業的勞斯萊斯：1970 年代專為接載石油平台工人而設計，後來變成政要 VIP 座機，相片就係英女王專用機。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the final S-76D; the photo is an S-76C-2 (G-XXEB of The Queen's Helicopter Flight) — the family silhouette is the same.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 規格以最後量產型 S-76D 為準；相片為 S-76C-2（女王直升機隊 G-XXEB），外形同家族一致。

history.statusZh: 服役中（生產至 2022 年前後結束；離岸石油、VIP 同救護市場仍有數百架）。
history.statusEn: In service (production ended around 2022; several hundred still fly offshore, VIP and air-ambulance work).

photo.author: Aeroprints.com
photo.creditZh: 相片：Aeroprints.com／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 3.0）· 女王直升機隊 S-76C-2（G-XXEB）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Aeroprints.com / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0) · S-76C-2 (G-XXEB) of The Queen's Helicopter Flight
photo.captionZh: 女王專用的 S-76C-2：酒紅色機身、流線造型、可收放起落架。
photo.captionEn: The Queen's S-76C-2: claret livery, sleek lines, retractable gear.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：S76 代碼頁

length.noteZh: 全長（旋翼轉動；括號為機身長）
length.noteEn: Overall length, rotors turning (fuselage in brackets)

wings.zh: 四葉主旋翼，旋翼頭低矮；飛行速度係同級最快一群（311 km/h）。
wings.en: Four-blade rotor on a low hub; among the fastest in class at 311 km/h.

engines.zh: 兩台引擎收在機背整流罩內，排氣細小向後。
engines.en: Twin engines tucked in the spine fairing with small rear exhausts.

fuselage.zh: 機身修長低矮，可收放前三點起落架；座艙窗呈淚滴形。
fuselage.en: A long, low fuselage on retractable tricycle gear with a teardrop cockpit.

tail.zh: 垂尾高聳，尾槳兩葉在左側，水平尾翼在尾樑中段。
tail.en: A tall fin, two-blade tail rotor and a mid-set tailplane.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the AW139: much bigger there. Versus the Bell 429 (AC-0109): skids and a taller body there; wheels and a lower, sleeker line here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 AW139 比：139 大一截（15 座）、不可收放輪款較常見；同 Bell 429 比（AC-0109）：429 用滑橇、機身較高；109 用輪式起落架、線條較扁。
aircraft.introEn: The Italian sports car of helicopters: born in 1971 — fast, pretty, twin-engined with retractable wheels — and flown by police and air ambulances for half a century.
aircraft.introZh: 意大利跑車式直升機：1971 年出世，快、靚、雙引擎加上可收放輪，警隊同空中救護用咗半個世紀。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: First flight was the original A109 (1971). Figures and photo are the current AW109 GrandNew.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 首飛為 A109 原型（1971）。規格及相片以現行 AW109 GrandNew 為準。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續生產（現行型 GrandNew／Trekker；警務、救護同 VIP 市場長青逾五十年）。
history.statusEn: In production and worldwide service (current GrandNew/Trekker versions; fifty years of police, EMS and VIP work).

photo.author: Zalasem1
photo.creditZh: 相片：Zalasem1／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· AW109 GrandNew（SP-AWW）飛行中
photo.creditEn: Photo: Zalasem1 / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · AW109 GrandNew (SP-AWW) in flight
photo.captionZh: 黑色的 AW109 GrandNew：低矮流線機身、四葉旋翼。
photo.captionEn: A black AW109 GrandNew: low sleek fuselage, four-blade rotor.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：A109 代碼頁

length.noteZh: 全長（旋翼轉動；括號為機身長）
length.noteEn: Overall length, rotors turning (fuselage in brackets)

wings.zh: 四葉主旋翼係同 Bell 212／UH-1Y 之前家族最易認的升級特徵。
wings.en: The four-blade main rotor is the headline upgrade over earlier Hueys.

engines.zh: 機背一組 PT6T 雙引擎組件，兩個排氣口在旋翼頭後方。
engines.en: A PT6T Twin-Pac on the spine with twin exhausts behind the mast.

fuselage.zh: 機身同 Huey 一脈相承：大側門、方窗、滑橇起落架，可載 14 人。
fuselage.en: Classic Huey lines: big sliding doors, square windows, skid gear, up to 14 seats.

tail.zh: 尾樑粗壯，兩葉尾槳，垂尾上下有端板。
tail.en: A sturdy boom, two-blade tail rotor and a fin with endplates.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Bell 212: two blades there, four here. Versus the UH-1Y: near-identical shape, told apart by kit and paint. Versus the AW139: five blades and wheels there; skids and four blades here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 Bell 212 比：212 係兩葉旋翼，412 四葉。同 UH-1Y 比（同廠軍用）：外形極似，分別在民用塗裝同設備。同 AW139 比：139 五葉旋翼、可收放輪，412 滑橇加四葉。
aircraft.introEn: The Huey family's four-blade upgrade: the two-blade 'whop' traded for a four-blade rotor and a twinned engine pack — firefighting, police patrol and ship supply all lean on it.
aircraft.introZh: Huey 家族的四葉升級版：把兩葉「撲撲」聲換成四葉旋翼加雙引擎組件，消防吊桶、警隊巡邏、船上運補都靠佢。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the common 412EP, as is the Niigata police photo aircraft. The PT6T is a Twin-Pac: two PT6s on one gearbox.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 規格以常見的 412EP 為準；相片同為日本新潟縣警的 412EP。引擎欄的 PT6T 係兩台 PT6 共用減速箱的一體組件。

history.statusZh: 服役中（逾 1,300 架交付；消防、警隊、離岸同軍用市場主力，相片為新潟縣警機）。
history.statusEn: In service (over 1,300 delivered; firefighting, police, offshore and military workhorse — the photo is a Niigata police aircraft).

photo.author: Cp9asngf
photo.creditZh: 相片：Cp9asngf／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 3.0）· 新潟縣警 Bell 412EP（JA01NP）飛行中
photo.creditEn: Photo: Cp9asngf / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0) · Niigata police Bell 412EP (JA01NP) in flight
photo.captionZh: 新潟縣警的 412EP：四葉旋翼、Huey 線條、滑橇。
photo.captionEn: Niigata's police 412EP: four-blade rotor, Huey lines, skids.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：B412 代碼頁

length.noteZh: 全長（旋翼轉動；括號為機身長）
length.noteEn: Overall length, rotors turning (fuselage in brackets)

wings.zh: 四葉主旋翼，葉片外形現代化，噪音同震動較低。
wings.en: A modern four-blade rotor, quieter and smoother than older Bells.

engines.zh: 兩台 PW207 收在機背，排氣向上後方斜出。
engines.en: Twin PW207s in the spine with upswept exhausts.

fuselage.zh: 機身高而闊，側門特大（可選對開尾門）；窗線水平。
fuselage.en: A tall, wide body with huge side doors and a level window line.

tail.zh: 尾樑末端有大型腹鰭加垂尾，兩葉尾槳加高置水平尾翼。
tail.en: A large ventral fin and tailplane; two-blade tail rotor set high.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Bell 407 (AC-0018): single engine and a narrower cabin there. Versus the AW109 (AC-0107): wheels and a low body there; skids and a tall cabin here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 Bell 407 比（AC-0018）：407 單引擎、四葉但機身較窄；429 雙引擎、座艙闊得多。同 AW109 比（AC-0107）：109 用輪、機身低扁；429 用滑橇、機身高。
aircraft.introEn: Bell's modern light twin: an extra-wide flat-floor cabin that swallows a stretcher lengthwise — EMS and police fleets love it.
aircraft.introZh: Bell 的現代輕型雙引擎機：座艙特別寬、地板平坦，擔架可以直入直出，救護同警隊特別鍾意。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the standard 429; wheeled gear is optional — the photo aircraft is on skids.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 規格以標準 429 為準；可選輪式起落架，相片為滑橇型。

history.statusZh: 服役中（警務、救護同離岸市場；寬敞平地板座艙係賣點）。
history.statusEn: In service (police, EMS and offshore roles; the big flat-floor cabin is its selling point).

photo.author: Robert Frola
photo.creditZh: 相片：Robert Frola／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（GFDL）· Bell 429（N10984）飛行中
photo.creditEn: Photo: Robert Frola / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (GFDL) · Bell 429 (N10984) in flight
photo.captionZh: 飛行的 429：高闊座艙、四葉旋翼、滑橇。
photo.captionEn: A 429 in flight: tall wide cabin, four-blade rotor, skids.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：B429 代碼頁

length.noteZh: 全長（旋翼轉動；括號為機身長）
length.noteEn: Overall length, rotors turning (fuselage in brackets)

wings.zh: 四葉主旋翼直徑 17.2 米，葉尖後掠；旋翼頭有大型整流罩。
wings.en: A 17.2 m four-blade rotor with swept tips and a big hub fairing.

engines.zh: 兩台 CT7 在機背兩側，引擎艙令機背兩邊隆起。
engines.en: Two CT7s flank the spine, bulging the engine decks.

fuselage.zh: 機身高大方正，窗多而大；機尾有跳板門可開（軍用版更明顯）。
fuselage.en: A tall, boxy fuselage with many big windows and a rear ramp on military versions.

tail.zh: 尾槳四葉，裝在垂尾左側高位；水平尾翼在尾樑右側單邊。
tail.en: A four-blade tail rotor high on the fin; single-sided tailplane.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the H225 family: taller body, bigger windows, four-blade tail rotor here. Versus the AW101: three engines there. Versus the CH-47 (AC-0022): a tandem-rotor layout entirely.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 H225／AS332 家族比：S-92 機身更高大、窗更大，尾槳四葉。同 AW101 比：101 三引擎；S-92 雙引擎。同 CH-47 比（AC-0022）：47 係串列雙旋翼，完全唔同佈局。
aircraft.introEn: The North Sea's airliner: a 19-seat cabin flown in all weathers to offshore rigs — and the red-and-white rescue helicopter of the UK Coastguard.
aircraft.introZh: 北海石油平台的空中巴士：19 座大機身、可以全天候飛去離岸平台，英國海岸防衛隊的紅白搜救機就係佢。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the civil S-92A; the H-92/CH-148 are military siblings. The photo is a Brazilian offshore S-92A.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 規格以民用 S-92A 為準；軍用版 H-92／CH-148 同源。相片為巴西離岸營運的 S-92A。

history.statusZh: 服役中（北海離岸運輸同英國、愛爾蘭海岸防衛搜救主力；亦作多國政要專機）。
history.statusEn: In service (North Sea offshore transport and UK/Irish coastguard SAR flagship; also a head-of-state mount for several nations).

photo.author: Halley Pacheco de Oliveira
photo.creditZh: 相片：Halley Pacheco de Oliveira／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 3.0）· S-92A（PR-OHE）於巴西
photo.creditEn: Photo: Halley Pacheco de Oliveira / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0) · S-92A (PR-OHE) in Brazil
photo.captionZh: 巴西離岸營運的 S-92A：高大機身、四葉大旋翼。
photo.captionEn: An offshore S-92A in Brazil: tall fuselage, big four-blade rotor.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：S92 代碼頁

length.noteZh: 全長（旋翼轉動；括號為機身長）
length.noteEn: Overall length, rotors turning (fuselage in brackets)

wings.zh: 五葉主旋翼直徑 21.3 米，係同級最大；旋翼頭外露複雜。
wings.en: A huge 21.3 m five-blade rotor on an exposed, busy hub.

engines.zh: 兩台 TV3-117 並排在座艙頂，圓形進氣口在旋翼頭前方。
engines.en: Twin TV3-117s atop the cabin with round intakes ahead of the mast.

fuselage.zh: 機身圓大，尾部有蚌殼門加跳板；側面圓窗一排，機鼻玻璃多面。
fuselage.en: A barrel body with clamshell rear doors and a ramp; rows of round windows and a multi-panel nose.

tail.zh: 尾槳三葉在垂尾左側（Mi-17 改到右側係辨認點之一），尾樑粗大。
tail.en: Three-blade tail rotor — on the left of the fin on the Mi-8, moved to the right on the Mi-17: a handy tell.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Mi-26: twice the size with eight blades there. Versus the S-92 (AC-0110): four blades and a boxy body there. Versus the UH-60 (AC-0020): four blades and a much flatter profile there.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 Mi-26 比：26 大一倍、八葉旋翼。同 S-92 比（AC-0110）：92 四葉旋翼、機身方正；Mi 八／十七五葉加圓身。同 UH-60 比（AC-0020）：黑鷹四葉、機身扁平得多。
aircraft.introEn: The most-produced helicopter in history: from Siberia to Africa, its five-blade rotor and barrel body carry 24 troops or a slung vehicle almost anywhere.
aircraft.introZh: 史上產量最高的直升機：由西伯利亞到非洲都見到佢，五葉大旋翼加圓碌碌機身，能載 24 人或吊起成台車。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: First flight and service entry are the Mi-8's (1961/1967); the Mi-17 is the late-1970s export upgrade with stronger engines. Both share ICAO code MI8. Figures centre on the Mi-17.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 首飛／投產為 Mi-8（1961／1967）；Mi-17 是 1970 年代末的出口改良型（引擎強化、高原性能較佳），兩者共用 ICAO 代碼 MI8。規格以 Mi-17 為主並註明。

history.statusZh: 服役中（全球最量產直升機家族，逾百國使用；Mi-17 為出口改良型，至今仍在生產）。
history.statusEn: In service (the most-produced helicopter family in history, flown by over a hundred nations; the Mi-17 export line is still in production).

photo.author: Sgt Deanne Hurla / MOD
photo.creditZh: 相片：Deanne Hurla 軍士／英國國防部（OGL v1.0）經 Wikimedia Commons · 阿富汗空軍 Mi-17 於坎普巴斯蒂安上空（2010 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Sgt Deanne Hurla / UK MOD (OGL v1.0) via Wikimedia Commons · Afghan Air Force Mi-17 over Camp Bastion (2010)
photo.captionZh: 阿富汗的 Mi-17 正面飛行照：五葉大旋翼、圓大機身。
photo.captionEn: An Afghan Mi-17 head-on: huge five-blade rotor, barrel fuselage.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：MI8 代碼頁

seats.noteZh: 座位（C 型 1 名、B 型 2 名）
seats.noteEn: Crew (one in C, two in B)

wings.zh: 三角翼加近距鴨翼，鴨翼在進氣口上方，係飆風最易認的組合。
wings.en: Delta wing with close-coupled canards above the intakes — the Rafale's signature.

engines.zh: 兩台 M88 並排在機腹後段，進氣口呈半橢圓貼在機身兩側。
engines.en: Twin M88s in the rear fuselage with half-oval cheek intakes.

fuselage.zh: 機身流線，單座 C 型座艙罩長；機頭有空中加油管（固定式在機鼻右側）。
fuselage.en: A sleek fuselage; the fixed refuelling probe on the nose is a French tell.

tail.zh: 單垂尾，尾翼尖有感測器整流罩；無水平尾翼（鴨翼代替）。
tail.en: Single fin with a sensor fairing at its tip; no tailplane — the canards do that job.
