aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Typhoon (AC-0028): lower, farther-forward canards and a chin intake there; cheek intakes and wing-hugging canards here. Versus the Gripen (AC-0113): a single engine and smaller there.
aircraft.similarZh: 同颱風戰機比（AC-0028）：颱風鴨翼位置較前較低、進氣口在機腹；飆風鴨翼貼近主翼、進氣口在兩側。同 JAS 39 比（AC-0113）：獅鷲單引擎細一截。
aircraft.introEn: France's omnirole fighter: delta wing and canards, one airframe for air force, navy, nuclear strike and carrier decks — Europe's export champion of its generation.
aircraft.introZh: 法國的全能戰機：三角翼加鴨翼，海軍陸軍用同一款，仲可以帶核武同上航空母艦，係歐洲三雄入面出口最成功的一款。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: First flight shown is the production Rafale C (1991; the Rafale A demonstrator flew in 1986). Figures are for the C/M.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 首飛為量產型 Rafale C（1991；技術驗證機 Rafale A 於 1986 年首飛）。規格以 C／M 型為準。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（法國海空軍主力，出口印度、埃及、希臘、印尼等多國；艦載 M 型在戴高樂號服役）。
history.statusEn: In service with deliveries continuing (France's front-line fighter, exported to India, Egypt, Greece, Indonesia and more; the M flies from Charles de Gaulle).

photo.author: Alan Wilson
photo.creditZh: 相片：Alan Wilson／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 法國海軍飆風 M（38 號）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Alan Wilson / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · French Navy Rafale M (number 38)
photo.captionZh: 艦載飆風 M 機腹照：三角翼、鴨翼、雙引擎一目了然。
photo.captionEn: A carrier Rafale M from below: delta, canards, twin engines.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：RFAL 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 紳寶 JAS 39 獅鷲戰鬥機

seats.noteZh: 座位（C 型 1 名、D 型 2 名）
seats.noteEn: Crew (one in C, two in D)

wings.zh: 三角翼加鴨翼，但成架只有 14 米長，係同級最細的組合。
wings.en: Delta plus canards on just 14 m of airframe — the smallest package in class.

engines.zh: 單台 RM12，進氣口在機腹兩側下方，機背乾淨。
engines.en: A single RM12 fed by two under-fuselage intakes; a clean spine.

fuselage.zh: 機身短小，座艙比例顯大；公路起降設計令起落架堅固外露。
fuselage.en: A stubby fuselage with a big-looking canopy and rugged road-base landing gear.

tail.zh: 單垂尾細高，無水平尾翼。
tail.en: A slim single fin; no tailplane.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Rafale (AC-0112): twin engines and bigger there. Versus the F-16 (AC-0023): no canards and a single chin intake there; canards and twin side intakes here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同飆風比（AC-0112）：飆風雙引擎大一截；獅鷲單引擎。同 F-16 比（AC-0023）：F-16 無鴨翼、單一机腹進氣口；獅鷲有鴨翼加兩側進氣。
aircraft.introEn: Sweden's clever fighter: small, affordable and able to refuel and rearm from a road strip — the thinking small nation's front-liner.
aircraft.introZh: 瑞典的聰明戰機：細小、平價、可以在公路上起降加油再戰，係小國空軍「以小博大」的代表作。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the JAS 39C; the E is the larger new generation with an F414 engine.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 規格以 JAS 39C 為準；E 型（F414 引擎、較大機身）為新一代。

history.statusZh: 服役中（瑞典主力，出口捷克、匈牙利、巴西、泰國等；新一代 E 型交付中）。
history.statusEn: In service (Sweden's front-liner, exported to Czechia, Hungary, Brazil, Thailand and more; the new E model is delivering).

photo.author: Milan Nykodym
photo.creditZh: 相片：Milan Nykodym／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 捷克空軍三架 JAS 39 編隊
photo.creditEn: Photo: Milan Nykodym / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Three Czech Air Force JAS 39s in formation
photo.captionZh: 三架捷克獅鷲編隊：細小三角翼加鴨翼。
photo.captionEn: Three Czech Gripens: small delta-canard jets in formation.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：SB39 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 米高揚 MiG-29 支點戰鬥機

seats.noteZh: 座位（UB 雙座型 2 名）

wings.zh: 主翼同機身融合（翼根邊條大），翼下掛架多；翼展 11.4 米較同級闊。
wings.en: A blended wing-body with big leading-edge extensions and an 11.4 m span.

engines.zh: 兩台 RD-33 間距較開，引擎艙之間有一條明顯凹槽（隧道）。
engines.en: Widely spaced RD-33s with a clear tunnel between the nacelles.

fuselage.zh: 機頭較短粗，座艙前有紅外搜索瞄準球；機背隆起。
fuselage.en: A stubby nose with an infrared search ball ahead of the windscreen and a humped spine.

tail.zh: 雙垂尾向外微傾，係同 Su-27 家族以外蘇系最易認的特徵之一。
tail.en: Twin, slightly canted fins — a Soviet signature outside the Flanker family.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Su-30 (AC-0070): much bigger with canards there. Versus the F-16 (AC-0023): one engine and one fin there; two of each here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 Su-30 比（AC-0070）：Su 系大得多兼有鴨翼（Su-30）；MiG-29 細一碼、無鴨翼。同 F-16 比（AC-0023）：單引擎單垂尾在彼，雙引擎雙垂尾在此。
aircraft.introEn: The Soviet front-line fighter of the Cold War: twin fins and a blended wing-body with stunning agility — NATO's 'Fulcrum', the jet the West most wanted to study in the 1980s.
aircraft.introZh: 冷戰蘇聯的前線戰機：雙垂尾、翼根融合體，機動性極強，北約俾咗佢代號「支點」，係 1980 年代西方最想研究的對手。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the baseline MiG-29 (9.12); the photo is a Peruvian MiG-29SE. The MiG-35 is its later development.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 規格以基本型 MiG-29（9.12）為準；相片為秘魯空軍的 MiG-29SE。後續 MiG-35 為其發展型。

history.statusZh: 服役中（多國升級延壽中；烏克蘭、印度、波蘭等仍在用，產量逾 1,600 架）。
history.statusEn: In service (life-extended upgrades continue; Ukraine, India, Poland and others still fly it, with over 1,600 built).

photo.author: Sergio de la Puente
photo.creditZh: 相片：Sergio de la Puente／Airliners.net 經 Wikimedia Commons（GFDL 1.2）· 秘魯空軍 MiG-29SE 飛行中
photo.creditEn: Photo: Sergio de la Puente / Airliners.net via Wikimedia Commons (GFDL 1.2) · Peruvian Air Force MiG-29SE in flight
photo.captionZh: 秘魯的 MiG-29SE：雙垂尾、融合翼身、間距闊的雙引擎。
photo.captionEn: Peru's MiG-29SE: twin fins, blended body, widely spaced engines.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：MG29 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 成都 殲-10 猛龍戰鬥機

seats.noteZh: 座位（S 型雙座 2 名）

wings.zh: 三角翼加鴨翼，鴨翼位置較前；機腹進氣口係早期矩形、C 型改為 DSI 鼓包進氣口。
wings.en: Delta wing with forward canards; a rectangular chin intake on early jets, a DSI bump intake on the C.

engines.zh: 單台引擎，尾噴管收在雙腹鰭之間；早期用俄製 AL-31，後期國產 WS-10。
engines.en: A single engine between twin ventral fins — Russian AL-31s early on, WS-10s later.

fuselage.zh: 機身 16.4 米，座艙罩大而前置；機頭雷達罩尖長。
fuselage.en: A 16.4 m fuselage with a big forward canopy and a long pointed radome.

tail.zh: 單垂尾高聳，雙腹鰭係低空辨認點。
tail.en: A tall single fin plus twin ventral fins underneath.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Gripen (AC-0113): same single-engine delta-canard idea, but bigger (16.4 m versus 14.1 m) with a central chin intake. Versus the J-20: a much larger twin-engine stealth jet there.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 JAS 39 比（AC-0113）：同為單引擎三角鴨翼，殲-10 大一截（16.4 對 14.1 米）、進氣口在機腹中央。同殲-20 比（第二批已收）：20 係隱身雙引擎重型機，大得多。
aircraft.introEn: China's first home-designed modern multirole fighter: a single-engine delta-canard that has anchored the PLAAF since the 2000s and stars at Zhuhai airshows.
aircraft.introZh: 中國第一款自主設計的現代多用途戰機：三角翼加鴨翼、單引擎，2000 年代起撐起解放軍半邊天，珠海航展成日見到佢表演。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: China publishes little performance data; figures are published estimates, flagged as such (the same treatment as the J-20 card). Figures centre on the J-10C; the photo shows August 1st aerobatic team J-10s.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 中國官方甚少公布性能，卡面數字屬公開資料估算並逐項標明（處理方式同殲-20 卡）。規格以殲-10C 為主；相片為八一飛行表演隊的殲-10。

history.statusZh: 服役中（解放軍空軍及海軍航空兵主力之一，C 型為現行主力；已出口巴基斯坦）。
history.statusEn: In service (a PLAAF and naval-aviation mainstay; the C is the current standard and it has been exported to Pakistan).

photo.author: 乘号同学
photo.creditZh: 相片：乘号同学／Wikimedia Commons（CC0）· 八一飛行表演隊殲-10 於珠海航展（2018 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: 乘号同学 / Wikimedia Commons (CC0) · August 1st team J-10s at Airshow China, Zhuhai (2018)
photo.captionZh: 八一表演隊六架殲-10 拉煙編隊：三角翼加鴨翼的機腹輪廓。
photo.captionEn: Six August 1st J-10s trailing smoke: the delta-canard underside.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：J10 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 費爾柴德 A-10 雷霆二式攻擊機

wings.zh: 主翼平直大面積，翼下掛架多達八個；低空低速設計。
wings.en: A big straight wing with up to eight pylons — built for low and slow.

engines.zh: 兩台 TF34 高置在尾部兩側（避開地面火力同機炮煙），係 A-10 最怪的輪廓。
engines.en: Twin TF34s perch high at the tail, clear of ground fire and gun gas — the A-10's oddest feature.

fuselage.zh: 機頭短粗，機炮口在機鼻下方正中；座艙有鈦合金浴缸裝甲。
fuselage.en: A stubby nose with the gun muzzle dead centre under it; the cockpit sits in a titanium bathtub.

tail.zh: 双垂尾夾在水平尾翼兩端，方便一台引擎失效仍可控。
tail.en: Twin fins at the tailplane tips keep control with one engine out.

aircraft.similarEn: It has no Western peer. Versus the F-16 (AC-0023): speed and sleekness there; a straight wing, tail-top engines and a gun nose here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同其他攻擊機比：無同級西方對手；同 F-16 比（AC-0023）：快同流線在彼，A-10 平直翼、尾置雙引擎加機炮鼻，一望即知。
aircraft.introEn: An aeroplane built around a gun: the entire jet wraps the 30 mm GAU-8 Avenger — slow, ugly, nearly unkillable, and the sound front-line troops trust most.
aircraft.introZh: 為一門 30 毫米機炮而設計的飛機：成架機圍繞 GAU-8 復仇者機炮建成，慢、醜、打不爛——前線士兵最信任的聲音。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the current A-10C. The gun is equipment, not a spec line; range is the ferry figure.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 規格以現行 A-10C 為準。機炮屬裝備，唔入規格欄；航程為轉場數字。

history.statusZh: 服役中（延壽至 2030 年代的計劃屢有討論；近距空中支援的代名詞）。
history.statusEn: In service (debated retirement timelines keep slipping; it remains the byword for close air support).

photo.author: Greg L. Davis, USAF
photo.creditZh: 相片：Greg L. Davis 高級飛行員／美國空軍（公有領域）經 Wikimedia Commons · 第 81 戰鬥機中隊 A-10（1999 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: SRA Greg L. Davis, USAF (Public domain) via Wikimedia Commons · 81st Fighter Squadron A-10 (1999)
photo.captionZh: A-10 正面飛行：尾置雙引擎、平直大翼、機炮鼻。
photo.captionEn: An A-10 head-on: tail-top engines, straight wing, gun nose.

deepLinks.labelZh: 英文維基：Fairchild Republic A-10 Thunderbolt II
deepLinks.labelEn: English Wikipedia: Fairchild Republic A-10 Thunderbolt II

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：A10 代碼頁
Wikimedia Commons 分類：Fairchild Republic A-10 Thunderbolt II
deepLinks.labelEn: Wikimedia Commons category: Fairchild Republic A-10 Thunderbolt II

aircraft.nameZh: 波音 B-52 同溫層堡壘轟炸機

wings.zh: 主翼長 56.4 米柔性大，地面時翼尖下垂、起飛時上揚明顯。
wings.en: A very flexible 56.4 m wing that droops on the ground and flexes up in flight.

engines.zh: 八台引擎四組雙聯吊艙掛翼下——全球現役獨一無二的佈置。
engines.en: Eight engines in four paired pods — a layout unique in today's skies.

fuselage.zh: 機身幼長（49 米），機翼位置高；機鼻圓鈍，窗細。
fuselage.en: A slim 49 m fuselage with a high wing and a blunt, small-windowed nose.

tail.zh: 尾翼高 12.4 米（早期型更高），尾炮艙已在 H 型取消改電子戰設備。
tail.en: A 12.4 m tail (taller on early models); the H traded its tail guns for electronics.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the B-17G: also a Boeing bomber, but the B-52 is nearly twice the size with eight jets. Versus the Tu-95: turboprops there, pure jets here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 B-17G 比（第四批已收）：同為波音轟炸機，B-52 大近一倍兼噴射八引擎。同圖-95 比：對方四渦槳加後掠翼，B-52 純噴射。
aircraft.introEn: The bomber that refuses to retire: eight engines and a 56 m wing, from Cold War nuclear alert to modern precision strikes — the USAF plans to fly it into the 2050s.
aircraft.introZh: 飛咗七十年仲未退休的轟炸機：八台引擎、56 米翼展，由冷戰核威懾飛到現代精確打擊，美軍打算畀佢飛到 2050 年代。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the B-52H, the only version still flying. 744 were built; about 76 Hs remain.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 規格以唯一現役型 B-52H 為準。產量 744 架，現役約 76 架 H 型。

history.statusZh: 服役中（B-52H 換引擎升級後預計服役至 2050 年代；1950 年代設計將飛足一世紀）。
history.statusEn: In service (re-engined B-52Hs are planned to serve into the 2050s — a 1950s design heading for a century of service).

photo.author: Pseudopanax
photo.creditZh: 相片：Pseudopanax／Wikimedia Commons（公有領域）· 美國空軍 B-52 於新西蘭航展打開彈艙飛越（2021 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: Pseudopanax / Wikimedia Commons (Public domain) · USAF B-52 overhead with bomb bay open, New Zealand (2021)
photo.captionZh: 機腹看 B-52：八引擎四組吊艙、打開的彈艙。
photo.captionEn: A B-52 from below: eight engines in four pods, bomb bay open.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：B52 代碼頁
Wikimedia Commons 分類：Boeing B-52 Stratofortress
deepLinks.labelEn: Wikimedia Commons category: Boeing B-52 Stratofortress

aircraft.nameZh: 波音 P-8 海神式海上巡邏機

seats.noteZh: 任務機組（另有 2 名機師）

wings.zh: 翼尖斜削（raked）而非 737 客機的小翼，方便低空巡邏同結冰環境。
wings.en: Raked wingtips instead of airliner winglets, for low-level patrol and icing.

engines.zh: 兩台 CFM56 同 737-800 一樣，但機翼加強、可掛武器。
engines.en: 737-800 engines on a strengthened wing with weapons stations.

fuselage.zh: 737 機身，窗大部分保留但機腹多咗武器艙門，機背同機尾天線林立。
fuselage.en: A 737 fuselage with most windows kept, a belly weapons bay and a forest of antennas.

tail.zh: 尾翼同 737 一樣，但機尾短錐無磁探長針（靠浮標獵潛）。
tail.en: A 737 tail but a short tail cone — no MAD stinger; it hunts by sonobuoy.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the airliner 737-800: raked tips, antennas, belly bay and grey paint. Versus the old P-3: four turboprops and a long MAD tail there.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 737-800 客機比：斜翼尖、天線、機腹艙門同灰色軍塗係分別。同舊 P-3 比：P-3 四渦槳加長尾針，P-8 噴射雙引擎。
aircraft.introEn: An airliner turned submarine hunter: a weapons bay, sonobuoys and torpedoes instead of the old tail stinger — the modern answer to maritime patrol.
aircraft.introZh: 737 客機變身潛艇獵手：機腹有武器艙、機尾無咗傳統磁探儀，靠浮標同魚雷獵潛，係現代海上巡邏機的標準答案。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the P-8A; India's P-8I differs in rear equipment. Its 737-800 parent is an earlier card.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 規格以 P-8A 為準；印度型為 P-8I（後部設備有別）。客機母型 737-800 另見第一批卡。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（美國海軍主力海上巡邏機，印度、澳洲、英國、紐西蘭、德國等相繼採用）。
history.statusEn: In service with deliveries continuing (the US Navy's main maritime patrol jet, also adopted by India, Australia, the UK, New Zealand, Germany and more).

photo.author: U.S. Navy
photo.creditZh: 相片：美國海軍（公有領域）經 Wikimedia Commons · VP-16 中隊 P-8A 投放 Mk 46 魚雷訓練彈（2013 年）
photo.creditEn: Photo: U.S. Navy (Public domain) via Wikimedia Commons · VP-16 P-8A dropping a Mk 46 practice torpedo (2013)
photo.captionZh: P-8A 投放魚雷：737 輪廓、斜翼尖、機腹武器艙。
photo.captionEn: A P-8A dropping a torpedo: 737 lines, raked tips, belly bay.

Wikimedia Commons 分類：Boeing P-8 Poseidon
deepLinks.labelEn: Wikimedia Commons category: Boeing P-8 Poseidon

aircraft.nameZh: 巴西航空工業 KC-390 千禧年運輸機

range.noteZh: 轉場航程（滿載 26 噸時約 2,815 公里）
range.noteEn: Ferry range (about 2,815 km at 26 t payload)

seats.noteZh: 機組（2 名機師＋2 名裝載員）

wings.zh: 上單翼加 T 尾，翼下兩台 V2500 噴射引擎——同級罕見的噴射動力（多數用渦槳）。
wings.en: A high wing and T-tail with two V2500 jets — rare jet power in a class of turboprops.

engines.zh: V2500 引擎同 A320 家族同源，推力大，令佢快到 Mach 0.8。
engines.en: A320-family V2500s give it Mach 0.8 speed.

fuselage.zh: 機身方闊，尾部跳板門；機鼻有空中加油探管（KC 型）。
fuselage.en: A wide, boxy fuselage with a rear ramp; the KC wears a refuelling probe on the nose.

tail.zh: T 型尾翼，垂尾高 11.8 米；主起落架在機身兩側莢艙。
tail.en: A T-tail on an 11.8 m fin; main gears in fuselage sponsons.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the C-130: four turboprops and slower there; jets and more payload here. Versus the A400M (AC-0095): the bigger 37-tonne turboprop there; a smaller jet here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 C-130 比（第一批 D 組）：130 四渦槳、慢啲；390 雙噴射、快而載得多。同 A400M 比（AC-0095）：400M 四渦槳載 37 噸較大；390 細一級兼噴射。
aircraft.introEn: The southern hemisphere's biggest military aircraft: Brazil's multirole airlifter — faster and heavier-lifting than a C-130, and it refuels other aircraft too.
aircraft.introZh: 南半球的最大軍用機：巴西造的多用途運輸機，快過 C-130 一截、載得更多，仲可以幫其他飛機空中加油。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Its ICAO code is E390 via doc8643.com (KC39 is an older rendering). Figures are for the KC-390; the pure transport is marketed as the C-390 Millennium.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: ICAO 代碼經 doc8643.com 核實為 E390（KC39 為舊稱寫法）。規格以 KC-390 為準；純運輸型稱 C-390 Millennium。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續交付（巴西首用，葡萄牙、匈牙利、荷蘭、捷克等選用；可兼空中加油）。
history.statusEn: In service with deliveries continuing (Brazil first, then Portugal, Hungary, the Netherlands, Czechia and others; doubles as a tanker).

photo.author: Colin Cooke
photo.creditZh: 相片：Colin Cooke／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 巴西空軍 KC-390（FAB 2857）於英國航展
photo.creditEn: Photo: Colin Cooke / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Brazilian Air Force KC-390 (FAB 2857) at a UK airshow
photo.captionZh: 巴西空軍 KC-390：噴射雙引擎、上單翼、T 尾。
photo.captionEn: Brazil's KC-390: twin jets, high wing, T-tail.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：E390 代碼頁

wings.zh: 主翼後掠細小，翼尖有小翼；低翼佈局。
wings.en: A small swept low wing with winglets.

engines.zh: 兩台 PW535 貼在機尾兩側，引擎艙圓潤。
engines.en: Two PW535s hug the rear fuselage.

fuselage.zh: 機身得 15.6 米，窗呈橢圓一列；機頭尖、線條似縮小的支線機。
fuselage.en: A 15.6 m fuselage with a row of oval windows — a miniature airliner look.

tail.zh: T 尾？——300 用傳統尾翼加腹鰭，垂尾後掠；係水平尾翼在垂尾底部。
tail.en: A conventional low-set tailplane (not a T-tail) with a ventral fin.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Citation Latitude (AC-0122): a size up there with a cruciform tail. Versus the PC-24: rough-field ability and a bigger cabin there.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 Citation Latitude 比（AC-0122）：Latitude 大一級、十字尾；Phenom 細小、尾翼佈局傳統。同 PC-24 比：24 可用泥地跑道、機身較大；300 純噴射輕型定位。
aircraft.introEn: The best-selling light jet in the world: a decade at the top of its class, seven to nine seats, single-pilot legal — the default small charter jet.
aircraft.introZh: 輕型公務機的銷量王：十幾年來交機量稱霸同級，七至九座、可以單機師飛，係老闆包機市場最常見的一款。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the current Phenom 300E; the photo is an early 300 (NetJets N300QS).
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 規格以現行 Phenom 300E 為準；相片為早期 300（NetJets N300QS，雨中攝於丹佛一帶）。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續生產（全球最暢銷輕型公務機，多年交付量同級第一；NetJets 大量營運）。
history.statusEn: In production and worldwide service (the best-selling light business jet for over a decade; NetJets flies a large fleet).

photo.author: Aeroprints.com
photo.creditZh: 相片：Aeroprints.com／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 3.0）· NetJets Phenom 300（N300QS）雨中停機坪
photo.creditEn: Photo: Aeroprints.com / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0) · NetJets Phenom 300 (N300QS) in the rain
photo.captionZh: 雨中的 Phenom 300：細小機身、尾吊雙引擎。
photo.captionEn: A Phenom 300 in the rain: compact fuselage, rear-mounted twins.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：E55P 代碼頁

wings.zh: 主翼後掠大，翼尖小翼高聳；翼下淨空高。
wings.en: A strongly swept wing with tall winglets and generous ground clearance.

engines.zh: 兩台 HTF7350 在機尾兩側，進氣口呈橢圓。
engines.en: Twin HTF7350s at the tail with oval intakes.

fuselage.zh: 機身闊（2.19 米艙寬），窗大而呈方形列陣；機頭圓潤。
fuselage.en: A wide body (2.19 m cabin) with a row of large squarish windows and a rounded nose.

tail.zh: T 型尾翼，垂尾後掠，尾翼尖有弧度。
tail.en: A swept T-tail with curved tips.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Falcon 2000 (AC-0123): a conventional tail and rounder windows there. Versus the Global 7500 (AC-0083): far bigger with nearly double the range there.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 Falcon 2000 比（AC-0123）：Falcon 尾翼非 T 型、窗較圓；同 Global 7500 比（AC-0083）：7500 大得多、航程近一倍。
aircraft.introEn: The super-midsize benchmark: a wide cabin and continent-crossing range that made it a charter and corporate staple; the 3500 carries the line on.
aircraft.introZh: 超中型公務機的台柱：機艙闊、航程夠飛跨大陸，包機公司同企業機隊買到停唔到手，3500 型已接棒。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The line began with the Challenger 300 (first flight 2001); the 350 is the 2013 upgrade. Figures are for the 350.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 家族源自 Challenger 300（2001 首飛）；350 為 2013 年升級型。規格以 350 為準。

history.statusZh: 服役中（超中型公務機銷量龍頭之一；進化型 Challenger 3500 已推出接棒）。
history.statusEn: In service (a super-midsize best-seller; the evolved Challenger 3500 now leads the line).

photo.author: ZLEA
photo.creditZh: 相片：ZLEA／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· Challenger 350（N595FX）於代托納比奇
photo.creditEn: Photo: ZLEA / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Challenger 350 (N595FX) at Daytona Beach
photo.captionZh: 滑行中的 Challenger 350：後掠翼、T 尾、闊機身。
photo.captionEn: A Challenger 350 taxiing: swept wing, T-tail, wide body.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：CL35 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 賽斯納 獎狀緯度 Citation Latitude

wings.zh: 主翼近乎平直（輕微後掠），翼尖小翼上翹；Citation 家族特徵。
wings.en: A nearly straight wing with upturned winglets — a Citation trait.

engines.zh: 兩台 PW306 在機尾，引擎艙較短粗。
engines.en: Short, chunky PW306 nacelles at the tail.

fuselage.zh: 機身圓筒形，窗細圓一列；艙高 1.83 米可以企直。
fuselage.en: A circular-section fuselage with small round windows; 1.83 m of stand-up cabin height.

tail.zh: 十字型尾翼（水平尾翼在垂尾中段），Citation 典型佈局。
tail.en: A cruciform tail — the tailplane part-way up the fin, Cessna-style.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Phenom 300 (AC-0120): a size up with a cruciform tail here. Versus the Challenger 350 (AC-0121): a more swept wing and T-tail there; straighter wing here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 Phenom 300 比（AC-0120）：Latitude 大一級兼十字尾；同 Challenger 350 比（AC-0121）：350 翼更掠、T 尾；Latitude 翼較直。
aircraft.introEn: Cessna's bread-and-butter jet: a stand-up flat-floor cabin at the price-and-range sweet spot that keeps it a sales champion.
aircraft.introZh: 賽斯納的台柱公務機：機艙可以企直個人、地板全平，價錢同航程啱啱好，令佢成年做銷量冠軍。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the Citation Latitude (680A); the Longitude is its stretched sibling.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 規格以 Citation Latitude（680A）為準；同門 Longitude 為加長版。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續生產（賽斯納最暢銷公務機之一；平地板直立機艙係賣點，新一代 Latitude 改良型已公布）。
history.statusEn: In production and worldwide service (one of Cessna's best-selling jets; the flat-floor stand-up cabin is its draw).

photo.author: Markus Eigenheer
photo.creditZh: 相片：Markus Eigenheer／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· NetJets Europe Citation Latitude（CS-DQA）進場日內瓦
photo.creditEn: Photo: Markus Eigenheer / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · NetJets Europe Citation Latitude (CS-DQA) arriving at Geneva
photo.captionZh: 進場中的 Latitude：近直翼、十字尾、圓筒機身。
photo.captionEn: A Latitude on approach: straightish wing, cruciform tail, round fuselage.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：C68A 代碼頁

wings.zh: 主翼後掠，LX 型有高翼尖小翼（相片 EX 型無）；前緣襟翼全翼展係達梭特色。
wings.en: A swept wing; tall winglets on the LX (absent on this EX) and full-span leading-edge slats, a Dassault touch.

engines.zh: 兩台 PW308 在機尾兩側，引擎艙長而貼身。
engines.en: Two PW308s in long, close-fitting tail nacelles.

fuselage.zh: 機身圓潤，窗呈橢圓列；機頭尖、座艙窗呈達梭式彎角。
fuselage.en: A rounded fuselage with oval windows and Dassault's faceted cockpit glazing.

tail.zh: 傳統尾翼（水平尾翼在機尾底部）加腹鰭，佈局樸實易認。
tail.en: A conventional low tailplane with a ventral fin.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Challenger 350 (AC-0121): a T-tail there, conventional here. Versus the Falcon 7X: three engines there; the centre tail engine gives it away.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 Challenger 350 比（AC-0121）：350 用 T 尾；Falcon 傳統尾翼。同 Falcon 7X 比：7X 三引擎、機尾中間多一台；2000 得兩台。
aircraft.introEn: Dassault's evergreen business jet: since 1993 its economy and short-field manners have sold over seven hundred — the company's most successful civil jet.
aircraft.introZh: 法國公務機的長青樹：1993 年出世，靠省油同短跑道性能賣咗七百幾架，係達梭民用機入面最成功的一款。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the wingleted 2000LX; the photo is a 2000EX (CS-DFG) — same airframe, different winglets and engine dash number.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 規格以 2000LX（加翼尖小翼）為準；相片為 2000EX（CS-DFG），同機體不同小翼／引擎小改。

history.statusZh: 服役中（家族逾 700 架；LX／S／LXS 等改型接力，2000LXS 為晚期型）。
history.statusEn: In service (700-plus family deliveries; the LX/S/LXS line carried it forward).

photo.author: Alan Wilson
photo.creditZh: 相片：Alan Wilson／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· NetJets Europe Falcon 2000EX（CS-DFG）降落特內里費
photo.creditEn: Photo: Alan Wilson / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · NetJets Europe Falcon 2000EX (CS-DFG) landing at Tenerife
photo.captionZh: 降落中的 Falcon 2000EX：後掠翼、傳統尾翼、橢圓窗。
photo.captionEn: A Falcon 2000EX landing: swept wing, conventional tail, oval windows.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：F2TH 代碼頁

wings.zh: 主翼近直，翼尖上翹少許；固定起落架有流線罩。
wings.en: A nearly straight wing with slight tip sweep and faired fixed gear.

engines.zh: 機頭單台活塞引擎加三葉螺旋槳；排氣在機鼻下方。
engines.en: A single piston engine and three-blade prop in the nose.

fuselage.zh: 複合材料機身線條圓滑，車門式艙門向上開；座艙窗大。
fuselage.en: A smooth composite fuselage with gullwing doors and big windows.

tail.zh: T 型尾翼係 SR22 同 SR20 的共同特徵，垂尾後掠。
tail.en: A T-tail shared with the SR20, on a swept fin.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the DA40 (AC-0125): bigger engine, faster, and the parachute here; diesel economy there. Versus the Cessna 172 (AC-0015): a high wing there; low-wing composite here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 DA40 比（AC-0125）：同為四／五座活塞機，SR22 引擎較大、速度更快兼有全機降落傘；DA40 柴油版較慳油。同 Cessna 172 比（AC-0015）：172 高翼；SR22 低翼加複合材料。
aircraft.introEn: The best-selling piston single of the century: a whole-airframe parachute, glass cockpit and car-style doors that redefined private flying.
aircraft.introZh: 廿一世紀最賣得的活塞小飛機：成架機有降落傘可以成架吊返落嚟，玻璃座艙加汽車式車門，重新定義咗私人飛機。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the current SR22 G6; the photo is an early G2 (VH-IBC). The SR20 is the smaller-engined sibling; the SR22T is turbocharged.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 規格以現行 SR22 G6 為準；相片為早期 G2（VH-IBC）。家族有 SR20（細引擎）同渦輪版 SR22T。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續生產（廿一世紀最暢銷活塞單引擎機；全機降落傘 CAPS 係標誌）。
history.statusEn: In production and worldwide service (the best-selling piston single of the 21st century; the whole-airframe CAPS parachute is its trademark).

photo.author: Robert Frola
photo.creditZh: 相片：Robert Frola／Flickr 經 Wikimedia Commons（GFDL）· Cirrus SR22 G2（VH-IBC）於澳洲 Archerfield
photo.creditEn: Photo: Robert Frola / Flickr via Wikimedia Commons (GFDL) · Cirrus SR22 G2 (VH-IBC) at Archerfield, Australia
photo.captionZh: 滑行中的 SR22 G2：低翼、T 尾、流線輪罩。
photo.captionEn: An SR22 G2 taxiing: low wing, T-tail, faired wheel spats.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：SR22 代碼頁

wings.zh: 長翼展（11.9 米）滑翔比高，翼尖有小翼；係 DA40 飛得慳的秘訣。
wings.en: A long 11.9 m wing with winglets — the secret of its economy.

engines.zh: 機頭柴油引擎加三葉槳，引擎罩左右有進氣口。
engines.en: A diesel engine and three-blade prop under a twin-intake cowl.

fuselage.zh: 機身全複合材料，座艙罩一體成型向前開；四座。
fuselage.en: An all-composite fuselage with a one-piece forward-hinged canopy; four seats.

tail.zh: T 型尾翼，垂尾同機身一體成型，線條似滑翔機。
tail.en: A T-tail on a glider-slim fuselage.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the SR22 (AC-0124): five seats, speed and a parachute there; four seats and diesel economy here. Versus the Cessna 172 (AC-0015): a metal high wing there; composite low wing and T-tail here.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 SR22 比（AC-0124）：SR22 五座、較快兼有降落傘；DA40 四座、柴油慳油、操縱溫和。同 Cessna 172 比（AC-0015）：172 高翼金屬機身；DA40 低翼複合材料加 T 尾。
aircraft.introEn: The new-generation trainer: all-composite, diesel-burning and forgiving — flight schools on every continent fly it.
aircraft.introZh: 飛行學校的新世代教練機：全複合材料、柴油引擎燒飛機油、失速溫和，全球訓練機隊四圍都係佢。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the diesel DA40 NG, as is the photo aircraft (LN-FTO over Norway). The petrol DA40-180 uses a Lycoming.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 規格以柴油版 DA40 NG 為準；相片同為 NG（LN-FTO，挪威上空）。汽油版 DA40-180 用 Lycoming 引擎。

history.statusZh: 服役中並持續生產（全球飛行學校主力教練機之一；柴油 NG 版燒 Jet A 燃油，營運成本低）。
history.statusEn: In production and worldwide service (a global flight-school staple; the diesel NG sips Jet A at low cost).

photo.author: Marius Vassnes
photo.creditZh: 相片：Marius Vassnes／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· DA40 NG（LN-FTO）於挪威上空
photo.creditEn: Photo: Marius Vassnes / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · DA40 NG (LN-FTO) over Norway
photo.captionZh: 飛行中的 DA40 NG：長翼、T 尾、滑翔機式線條。
photo.captionEn: A DA40 NG in flight: long wing, T-tail, glider-like lines.

deepLinks.labelEn: English Wikipedia: Diamond DA40 Diamond Star

aircraft.nameZh: 西安 MA60 新舟支線客機

wings.zh: 高翼雙螺旋槳，翼展 29.2 米；主翼後緣有大型襟翼，係安-24 家族的典型布局。
wings.en: A high wing with two propellers and a 29.2 m span; big trailing-edge flaps in classic An-24-family layout.

engines.zh: 兩台 PW127J 渦槳各推一副四葉槳，短艙長而突出翼前。
engines.en: Two PW127J turboprops, each driving a four-blade propeller in long nacelles ahead of the wing.

fuselage.zh: 機身 24.7 米，圓形截面加長機鼻雷達罩；窗口一列過，尾部上翹收尾。
fuselage.en: A 24.7 m round-section fuselage with a long nose, a single window line and an upswept tail cone.

tail.zh: 單垂尾加高置平尾，垂尾前緣有背鰭延伸落機身。
tail.en: A single fin with a high-set tailplane and a dorsal fillet running forward.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the ATR 42-600 (AC-0103): same 40-70-seat turboprop class, but the MA60 is an An-24/Y-7 descendant with a longer nose and four-blade props; the ATR is a Franco-Italian clean-sheet design.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 ATR 42-600 比（AC-0103）：同屬 40–70 座渦槳支線機，但 MA60 源自安-24／運-7 血統、機鼻較長、四葉槳；ATR 就係法意全新設計。
aircraft.introEn: China's home-grown 60-seat turboprop airliner, developed from the Y-7/An-24 lineage and sold across Asia, Africa and the Pacific.
aircraft.introZh: 中國自家 60 座渦槳支線客機，由運-7／安-24 血統改良而來，賣到亞洲、非洲同太平洋島國。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the baseline MA60; the improved MA600 (glass cockpit, PW127J) and the MA700 project are separate variants. The photo shows a Lao Airlines aircraft in Laos.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 數字以基本型 MA60 為準；改良型 MA600（玻璃座艙）同 MA700 計劃係另外型號。相片係老撾航空的 MA60 喺老撾。

history.statusZh: 服役中（主要在中國、老撾、津巴布韋、玻利維亞等地營運，產量逾百架）。
history.statusEn: In service (operated mainly in China, Laos, Zimbabwe, Bolivia and elsewhere; over a hundred built).

photo.author: Motohiro Sunouchi
photo.creditZh: 相片：Motohiro Sunouchi／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY 2.0）· 老撾航空 MA60 喺老撾川壙機場
photo.creditEn: Photo: Motohiro Sunouchi / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0) · Lao Airlines MA60 at Xieng Khouang Airport, Laos
photo.captionZh: 地面側面：高翼雙槳、長機鼻，尾翼編號清楚。
photo.captionEn: On the ground in profile: high wing, twin props and a long nose.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：MA60 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 哈爾濱 運-12 通用飛機

wings.zh: 高翼加支柱撐住，無收起式設計；翼展 17.2 米，翼端有小翼（E 型）。
wings.en: A strut-braced high wing of 17.2 m span; later E-models add small winglets.

engines.zh: 兩台 PT6A 渦槳裝喺翼下短艙，三葉槳；排氣管短而貼艙。
engines.en: Two PT6A turboprops in wing nacelles with three-blade propellers and short exhaust stubs.

fuselage.zh: 方截面機身、平直機底、固定起落架；側面有大貨艙門，方便島嶼補給。
fuselage.en: A boxy square-section fuselage with a flat belly, fixed gear and a big side cargo door for island work.

tail.zh: 高置平尾加單垂尾，垂尾下有腹鰭；尾翼外形四四方方。
tail.en: A high tailplane on a single fin with a ventral strake; everything squared-off and utilitarian.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the MA60 (AC-0126): a much smaller, fixed-gear utility twin that trades speed for short-field island hopping; versus Western types it fills the Twin Otter niche.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 MA60 比（AC-0126）：細得多、固定起落架，犧牲速度換短跑道跳島能力；喺外國市場對位雙水獺嗰類通用機。
aircraft.introEn: China's twin-turboprop utility workhorse: a 17-seat STOL aircraft flown by island nations and air forces from Kiribati to Peru.
aircraft.introZh: 中國雙渦槳通用機代表作：17 座短距起降，由基里巴斯到秘魯都有島國同空軍用緊。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the Y-12E; the current Y-12F adds a glass cockpit and retractable gear. The photo shows an Air Kiribati Y-12E being refuelled at Tabiteuea North.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 數字以運-12E 為準；現行運-12F 改用玻璃座艙同可收起落架。相片係基里巴斯航空運-12E 喺塔比托埃阿加油。

history.statusZh: 服役中（多國民用及軍用營運；運-12F 為現行生產型）。
history.statusEn: In service (civil and military operators worldwide; the Y-12F is the current production model).

photo.author: Steve Bolton
photo.creditZh: 相片：Steve Bolton／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY 2.0）· 基里巴斯航空運-12 在塔比托埃阿北機場
photo.creditEn: Photo: Steve Bolton / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 2.0) · Air Kiribati Y-12 at Tabiteuea North Airport
photo.captionZh: 後側面：方正機身、高翼支柱同國旗尾翼，島嶼機場日常。
photo.captionEn: Rear-quarter view: boxy fuselage, braced high wing and flag tail on an island strip.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：Y12 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 中航 AG600 鯤龍水陸兩棲飛機

wings.zh: 高翼四槳，翼展 38.8 米；翼下有浮筒，係水上起降的記號。
wings.en: A high four-prop wing of 38.8 m span with underwing stabilising floats — the seaplane giveaway.

engines.zh: 四台渦槳-6 各推六葉槳，排成一列喺翼前緣。
engines.en: Four WJ-6 turboprops with six-blade propellers lined up along the leading edge.

fuselage.zh: 船形機底可以劏水滑行，機身長 36.9 米；機鼻圓潤、駕駛艙窗高置。
fuselage.en: A boat hull bottom for planing on water in a 36.9 m fuselage, with a rounded nose and high cockpit windows.

tail.zh: T 形尾翼：平尾坐喺垂尾頂，避開水花同槳流。
tail.en: A T-tail with the tailplane on top of the fin, clear of spray and slipstream.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Y-9 (AC-0130): similar four-turboprop size class, but the AG600's boat hull, wing floats and T-tail mark it out as a true amphibian rather than a landplane transport.
aircraft.similarZh: 同運-9 比（AC-0130）：同屬四渦槳大細，但 AG600 有船底、翼下浮筒同 T 尾，係真正水陸兩棲，唔係陸上運輸機。
aircraft.introEn: The world's largest amphibious aircraft in production: a Chinese firefighting and rescue flying boat that can scoop 12 tonnes of water in 20 seconds.
aircraft.introZh: 全球最大量產中水陸兩棲飛機：中國研發的滅火救援飛行船，20 秒可以汲起 12 噸水。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: AG600M is the dedicated firefighting variant; a search-and-rescue version can carry 50 people. Type certificate was obtained in 2025 with deliveries following. The photo shows the prototype at Airshow China 2016, with a Y-20 behind.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: AG600M 係專用滅火型；搜救型可載 50 人。2025 年取得型號合格證後開始交付。相片係 2016 珠海航展原型機，後面有架運-20。

history.statusZh: 服役中（2025 年取證，同年開始交付；滅火型 AG600M 為主）。
history.statusEn: In service (certified in 2025, deliveries began the same year; the AG600M firefighter leads).

photo.author: Alert5
photo.creditZh: 相片：Alert5／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· AG600 原型機喺 2016 珠海航展
photo.creditEn: Photo: Alert5 / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · AG600 prototype at Airshow China 2016
photo.captionZh: 側面全景：船底、四槳同 T 尾一覽無遺，後面係運-20。
photo.captionEn: Full profile: boat hull, four props and T-tail, with a Y-20 behind.

aircraft.nameZh: 西安 運-20 鯤鵬重型運輸機

wings.zh: 後掠高翼，翼展 45 米；翼下四個短艙吊引擎，起落架收入機身兩側鼓包。
wings.en: A swept high wing of 45 m span; four podded engines beneath and gear sponsons along the fuselage sides.

engines.zh: 四台渦扇：早期俄製 D-30，現行國產 WS-20 大涵道比引擎，短艙粗短。
engines.en: Four turbofans — Russian D-30s on early jets, fat short WS-20 high-bypass engines on current production.

fuselage.zh: 機身 47 米，貨艙橫截面闊落可入大型車輛；機鼻圓鈍、駕駛艙有六塊窗。
fuselage.en: A 47 m fuselage with a wide cargo cross-section for outsized vehicles; a blunt nose with a six-pane cockpit.

tail.zh: T 形尾：垂尾高聳、平尾置頂，尾部有上翹貨艙門跳板。
tail.en: A T-tail on a tall fin, with the upswept rear loading ramp below.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the KC-390 (AC-0119): both are jet airlifters with rear ramps, but the four-engine Y-20 is in the 66-tonne strategic class — roughly twice the KC-390's payload. Versus the Y-9 (AC-0130): the Y-20 is the bigger jet-powered step above the turboprop.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 KC-390 比（AC-0119）：同為噴射運輸機連尾艙門，但四引擎運-20 屬 66 噸戰略級，載重大約係 KC-390 兩倍。同運-9 比（AC-0130）：運-20 係渦槳之上更大一級的噴射型。
aircraft.introEn: China's strategic airlifter: a four-jet, 66-tonne-payload freighter that gives the PLAAF global reach, plus tanker and AEW derivatives.
aircraft.introZh: 中國戰略運輸機：四引擎噴射、載重 66 噸，畀解放軍全球投送力，仲衍生加油機同預警型。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures centre on the WS-20-powered Y-20B; early Y-20As used Russian D-30KP-2s. The YY-20 tanker and KJ-3000 AEW variants share the airframe. The photo shows a PLAAF Y-20 in flight.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 數字以 WS-20 引擎的運-20B 為主；早期運-20A 用俄製 D-30KP-2。運油-20 加油型同空警-3000 預警型共用機體。相片係解放軍運-20 飛行中。

history.statusZh: 服役中（解放軍主力戰略運輸機，加油型運油-20 同步服役）。
history.statusEn: In service (the PLAAF's main strategic airlifter; the YY-20 tanker serves alongside).

photo.author: L.G.Liao
photo.creditZh: 相片：L.G.Liao／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 3.0）· 解放軍空軍運-20 喺珠海
photo.creditEn: Photo: L.G.Liao / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0) · PLAAF Y-20 at Zhuhai
photo.captionZh: 飛行側面：後掠高翼、四台渦扇同起落架鼓包。
photo.captionEn: In flight in profile: swept high wing, four turbofans and gear sponsons.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：Y20 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 陝西 運-9 中型運輸機

wings.zh: 高翼四槳，翼展 38 米；主翼近乎平直，係運-8 血統的延續。
wings.en: A near-straight high wing of 38 m span with four propellers — the Y-8 lineage carried forward.

engines.zh: 四台渦槳-6C 各推六葉槳，短艙沿翼前緣排開。
engines.en: Four WJ-6C turboprops with six-blade propellers spread along the leading edge.

fuselage.zh: 機身 34 米，尾部上翹連貨艙跳板；機鼻圓而駕駛艙窗多，運-9 加長咗機頭段。
fuselage.en: A 34 m fuselage with an upswept rear ramp; the Y-9's stretched, rounder nose carries extra cockpit panes.

tail.zh: 單垂尾加高置平尾，尾翼尺寸大，方便低速裝卸飛行。
tail.en: A single fin with a high tailplane; generously sized for low-speed cargo handling.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Y-20 (AC-0129): the Y-9 is the smaller turboprop tactical lifter beneath the big jet; versus the C-130 class abroad it is China's home-grown equivalent, and it parents a whole family of KJ-500/GX special-mission variants.
aircraft.similarZh: 同運-20 比（AC-0129）：運-9 係噴射大哥之下嘅渦槳戰術型；對位外國 C-130 級別，仲係空警-500 同高新家族特種機的平台。
aircraft.introEn: China's C-130-class tactical airlifter: a four-turboprop transport developed from the Y-8, now the PLA's standard medium lifter and special-mission platform.
aircraft.introZh: 中國 C-130 級戰術運輸機：由運-8 發展的四渦槳運輸機，係解放軍標準中型運輸同特種任務平台。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: China has not assigned the type a separate ICAO Doc 8643 page; the Y9 designator follows structured references (see docs/05). The airframe parents the KJ-500 AEW&C and GX-series special-mission aircraft. Photo: Y-9 at Airshow China 2014.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: ICAO Doc 8643 未有獨立頁面，Y9 代碼依結構化參考採用（見 docs/05）。本機係空警-500 同高新系列特種機的平台。相片係 2014 珠海航展的運-9。

history.statusZh: 服役中（解放軍空海軍中型運輸主力，特種改型眾多）。
history.statusEn: In service (the PLA's standard medium airlifter, with many special-mission derivatives).

photo.author: Danny Yu
photo.creditZh: 相片：Danny Yu／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 運-9 喺 2014 珠海航展
photo.creditEn: Photo: Danny Yu / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Y-9 at Airshow China 2014
photo.captionZh: 地面側面全景：四槳高翼、長機身同尾艙門。
photo.captionEn: Full ground profile: four props, high wing and rear ramp.

aircraft.nameZh: 陝西 空警-500 預警機

height.noteZh: 全高（機體，不連雷達罩頂）

seats.noteZh: 機員及任務操作員（估算，官方未公布）
seats.noteEn: Flight and mission crew (estimate; not officially published)

wings.zh: 運-9 的高翼四槳布局，翼展 38 米；背上多咗個大圓碟，一眼就分得出。
wings.en: The Y-9's high-wing four-prop layout of 38 m span — plus the big dorsal disc that gives it away instantly.

engines.zh: 四台渦槳-6C 六葉槳，同運-9 一樣；預警型唔靠速度，靠滯空。
engines.en: Four WJ-6C six-blade turboprops as on the Y-9; an AEW&C trades speed for time on station.

fuselage.zh: 機身 34 米，背部固定圓盤雷達罩內藏三面 AESA 陣列，360 度覆蓋；機鼻同尾部加裝電子天線。
fuselage.en: A 34 m fuselage carrying a fixed disc radome with three AESA arrays for 360° coverage, plus extra electronic antennas fore and aft.

tail.zh: 尾翼同運-9 一樣高置平尾，但尾錐加長裝電子支援設備。
tail.en: Y-9-style high tailplane, with an extended tail cone housing electronic-support gear.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus its Y-9 parent (AC-0130): same airframe, but the fixed rotodome replaces the cargo role — compare the KJ-200's 'balance beam' for the earlier generation's different answer to the same problem.
aircraft.similarZh: 同平台原型運-9 比（AC-0130）：機體一樣，但固定圓盤雷達罩取代貨運角色；上一代空警-200 用「平衡木」條狀雷達，係唔同世代的解法。
aircraft.introEn: China's third-generation airborne early-warning aircraft: a Y-9 carrying a fixed AESA disc, now the PLA's standard tactical AEW&C with 60+ built.
aircraft.introZh: 中國第三代預警機：運-9 機背固定 AESA 圓盤雷達，係解放軍現行戰術預警主力，產量逾 60 架。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The KJ-500 has no separate ICAO designator; it flies on the Y-9 airframe code (see docs/05). Performance figures are Y-9 platform data flagged as estimates; the KJ-500A adds an aerial-refuelling probe. Photo: KJ-500 in flight before Airshow China 2016.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 空警-500 無獨立 ICAO 代碼，沿用運-9 平台代碼（見 docs/05）。性能數字屬運-9 平台數據並標明估算；空警-500A 加裝空中受油管。相片係 2016 珠海航展前飛行的空警-500。

history.statusZh: 服役中（空軍及海軍航空兵標準戰術預警機，60+ 架；A 型為現行生產標準）。
history.statusEn: In service (standard PLAAF/PLANAF tactical AEW&C, 60+ built; the A-model is the current production standard).

photo.author: Alert5
photo.creditZh: 相片：Alert5／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 空警-500 喺珠海金灣機場附近
photo.creditEn: Photo: Alert5 / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · KJ-500 near Zhuhai Jinwan Airport
photo.captionZh: 飛行中：圓盤雷達罩、四槳同垂尾編號清楚，放低起落架準備降落。
photo.captionEn: In flight with gear down: disc radome, four props and fin serial on show.

aircraft.nameZh: 瀋陽 殲-11 重型戰鬥機

seats.noteZh: 座位（雙座 BS 型 2 名）

wings.zh: 大後掠翼加翼身融合，翼展 14.7 米；係蘇-27「側衛」家族的共同骨架。
wings.en: A big swept wing blended into the fuselage, 14.7 m across — the shared Flanker-family skeleton.

engines.zh: 兩台引擎分開裝喺機身兩側隧道式進氣口之後，尾噴管之間有尾錐。
engines.en: Two engines in widely-spaced tunnel intakes, with a tail cone stinger between the nozzles.

fuselage.zh: 機身 21.9 米，機頭下傾、座艙前有光電探頭；單座 B 型用國產航電同 WS-10。
fuselage.en: A 21.9 m fuselage with a drooped nose and an IRST ball ahead of the canopy; the single-seat B uses Chinese avionics and WS-10s.

tail.zh: 雙垂尾向外斜，尾翼之間距離闊；水平尾翼全動式。
tail.en: Twin outward-canted fins set wide apart, with all-moving tailerons.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the J-16 (AC-0134): same Flanker bones, but the J-11 is the single-seat air-superiority branch while the J-16 is the two-seat strike branch. Versus the J-15 (AC-0133): the naval cousin adds folding wings, canards and a tailhook.
aircraft.similarZh: 同殲-16 比（AC-0134）：同為側衛骨架，殲-11 係單座制空型，殲-16 係雙座打擊型。同殲-15 比（AC-0133）：海軍表親多咗折翼、鴨翼同着艦鉤。
aircraft.introEn: China's Flanker: licence-built from the Su-27, then re-engineered as the J-11B with Chinese engines, radar and missiles — a PLAAF heavyweight for three decades.
aircraft.introZh: 中國版「側衛」：由蘇-27 授權生產起步，再改成國產引擎、雷達同導彈的殲-11B，撐起解放軍重型制空三十年。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: China publishes little performance data; figures are published estimates flagged as such. ICAO's Doc 8643 has no J-11 page; the J11 designator follows structured references (see docs/05). The photo shows a J-11B at the 2025 Changchun air show.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 中國官方甚少公布性能，數字屬公開估算並逐項標明。ICAO Doc 8643 未有殲-11 頁面，J11 代碼依結構化參考採用（見 docs/05）。相片係 2025 長春航展的殲-11B。

history.statusZh: 服役中（解放軍空軍及海軍航空兵重型主力，B/BG 型持續升級）。
history.statusEn: In service (a PLAAF and naval heavyweight; B/BG models continue to be upgraded).

photo.author: 颐园居
photo.creditZh: 相片：颐园居／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 殲-11B 喺 2025 空軍航空開放日（長春）
photo.creditEn: Photo: 颐园居 / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · J-11B at the 2025 PLAAF Aviation Open Day, Changchun
photo.captionZh: 地面前側面：雙垂尾、機頭光電探頭同深灰雷達罩。
photo.captionEn: Front-quarter on the ground: twin fins, IRST ball and dark radome.

aircraft.nameZh: 瀋陽 殲-15 飛鯊艦載戰鬥機

wings.zh: 主翼可向上摺起收窄，翼前加鴨翼；係上艦的關鍵改動。
wings.en: Wings fold upwards for deck parking, with canards added ahead of them — the key naval changes.

engines.zh: 兩台引擎分置機身兩側，尾錐縮短改裝着艦鉤。
engines.en: Two engines in spaced nacelles; the tail cone is shortened to fit an arrestor hook.

fuselage.zh: 機身 22.3 米，前起落架加強配合彈射／滑躍；機頭同殲-11 一樣有光電探頭。
fuselage.en: A 22.3 m fuselage with a strengthened nose gear for launch loads and the family IRST ball in the nose.

tail.zh: 雙垂尾同水平尾翼都可摺或收窄，尾下有明顯着艦鉤。
tail.en: Twin fins on a navalised tail, with the arrestor hook obvious underneath.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the J-11 (AC-0132): the same Flanker base reworked for carriers — folding wing, canards, hook and beefed-up gear. Versus the J-35 (AC-0138): the newer stealth jet now joining it on Fujian's catapults.
aircraft.similarZh: 同殲-11 比（AC-0132）：同一個側衛底子改到上艦——折翼、鴨翼、着艦鉤、加強起落架。同殲-35 比（AC-0138）：新一代隱身艦載機，已經一齊上福建艦彈射。
aircraft.introEn: China's carrier fighter: a navalised Flanker flying from Liaoning, Shandong and now Fujian, nicknamed the Flying Shark.
aircraft.introZh: 中國艦載戰鬥機：海軍版「側衛」，先後上遼寧艦、山東艦同福建艦，外號「飛鯊」。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are published estimates, flagged as such; Doc 8643 has no J-15 page, so J15 follows structured references (docs/05). Later J-15T/J-15S variants add catapult and two-seat options. Photo: a J-15 spotted on Liaoning by Japan's Joint Staff.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 數字屬公開估算並逐項標明；Doc 8643 未有殲-15 頁面，J15 依結構化參考採用（docs/05）。後期殲-15T／S 型加彈射同雙座。相片係日本統合幕僚監部拍攝遼寧艦上的殲-15。

history.statusZh: 服役中（中國海軍航母艦載機主力，T 型配合彈射航母）。
history.statusEn: In service (the PLAN's main carrier fighter; the T-model serves the catapult carrier).

photo.author: 日本防衛省・統合幕僚監部
photo.creditZh: 相片：日本防衛省・統合幕僚監部／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY 4.0）· 遼寧艦甲板上的殲-15
photo.creditEn: Photo: Japan Ministry of Defense / Joint Staff / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 4.0) · J-15 on Liaoning's deck
photo.captionZh: 甲板側面：摺起的主翼同着艦部署狀態。
photo.captionEn: On deck in profile with wings folded for parking.

aircraft.nameZh: 瀋陽 殲-16 多用途戰鬥機

range.noteZh: 作戰／轉場航程（外界估算）

wings.zh: 側衛大翼加翼身融合，掛架多到滿；翼尖常掛電子戰吊艙（D 型）。
wings.en: The big Flanker wing on a blended body, with hardpoints everywhere; J-16Ds carry wingtip EW pods.

engines.zh: 兩台 WS-10B 分置兩側，尾噴管銀灰色，係國產化的標誌。
engines.en: Two WS-10Bs in spaced nacelles with silver-grey nozzles — the mark of the fully Chinese powerplant.

fuselage.zh: 雙座串列座艙拉長咗機頭線條；機鼻雷達罩深色，內藏 AESA 雷達。
fuselage.en: A tandem two-seat canopy stretches the nose line; the dark radome hides an AESA radar.

tail.zh: 雙垂尾外斜，尾翼間有尾錐；D 型拆走機炮同光電，換電子戰天線。
tail.en: Twin canted fins around a tail stinger; the D drops the gun and IRST for EW antennas.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the J-11 (AC-0132): the two-seat strike/EW evolution of the same Flanker — think of the J-11 as the interceptor sibling and the J-16 as the bomb-truck sibling. Versus the JH-7 (AC-0136): a newer, more agile replacement in the strike role.
aircraft.similarZh: 同殲-11 比（AC-0132）：同一個側衛底子的雙座打擊／電戰進化型——殲-11 主制空、殲-16 主對地。同殲轟-7 比（AC-0136）：殲-16 係新一代、靈活得多嘅打擊接班人。
aircraft.introEn: The PLAAF's two-seat strike Flanker: a heavily upgraded J-11 derivative with AESA radar, Chinese engines and a dedicated J-16D electronic-warfare variant.
aircraft.introZh: 解放軍雙座打擊版「側衛」：由殲-11 深度升級，AESA 雷達、國產引擎，仲有專職電戰的殲-16D。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are published estimates, flagged as such; Doc 8643 has no J-16 page, so J16 follows structured references (docs/05). The photo shows a J-16 taking off with afterburners at Aviadarts 2021 (Russian MoD photo).
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 數字屬公開估算並逐項標明；Doc 8643 未有殲-16 頁面，J16 依結構化參考採用（見 docs/05）。相片係殲-16 喺 2021 航空飛鏢比賽開後燃起飛（俄羅斯國防部相片）。

history.statusZh: 服役中（解放軍主力多用途戰機，產量數百架；D 型電戰型同步服役）。
history.statusEn: In service (a PLAAF multirole mainstay built in the hundreds; the J-16D EW variant serves alongside).

photo.author: Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation
photo.creditZh: 相片：俄羅斯聯邦國防部／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY 4.0）· 殲-16 喺 2021 航空飛鏢比賽
photo.creditEn: Photo: Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 4.0) · J-16 at Aviadarts 2021
photo.captionZh: 後方視角：雙垂尾、開後燃的雙噴管同翼下掛架。
photo.captionEn: From behind: twin fins, lit afterburners and loaded hardpoints.

aircraft.nameZh: 成都 JF-17 梟龍戰鬥機

seats.noteZh: 座位（雙座 B 型 2 名）

wings.zh: 中等後掠翼連大邊條，翼展 9.4 米；翼尖掛近距導彈係常見構型。
wings.en: A moderately swept wing with big LERXes, 9.4 m across; wingtip short-range missiles are the usual fit.

engines.zh: 單台 RD-93 渦扇，兩側腮式進氣口（後期改 DSI）；尾噴管短而集中。
engines.en: A single RD-93 fed by cheek intakes (DSI on later blocks) with a short, tight tailpipe.

fuselage.zh: 機身 14.9 米，比例似放大版單座輕型機；座艙視野好，機頭裝 KLJ-7 系列雷達。
fuselage.en: A 14.9 m fuselage like a scaled-up light fighter, with a roomy canopy and a KLJ-7-family radar in the nose.

tail.zh: 單垂尾加腹鰭，全動平尾；尾翼線條簡單直接。
tail.en: A single fin with a ventral strake and all-moving tailerons — simple, direct lines.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the J-10 (AC-0115): both are Chinese single-engine fighters, but the JF-17 is the smaller, cheaper conventional-wing export jet (14.9 m) against the J-10's delta-canard (16.4 m). Versus the Gripen (AC-0113): a close Western rival in the light-fighter class.
aircraft.similarZh: 同殲-10 比（AC-0115）：同為中國單引擎戰機，JF-17 係細啲、平啲、用傳統翼型的外銷機（14.9 米），殲-10 係三角鴨翼（16.4 米）。同 JAS 39 比（AC-0113）：輕型戰機級別的直接對手。
aircraft.introEn: The China-Pakistan light fighter: a low-cost single-engine jet co-developed as the FC-1/JF-17, now Pakistan's backbone fighter and an export success.
aircraft.introZh: 中巴合作輕型戰機：平價單引擎設計（中方稱 FC-1 梟龍），係巴基斯坦空軍主力，亦外銷多國。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: ICAO designator FC1 comes from the Chinese FC-1 name (Doc 8643 lists the FC-1). Block III adds an AESA radar and new avionics. The photo shows a Pakistan Air Force JF-17 in flight.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: ICAO 代碼 FC1 來自中方「FC-1」命名（Doc 8643 以 FC-1 登錄）。Block III 加裝 AESA 雷達同新航電。相片係巴基斯坦空軍 JF-17 飛行中。

history.statusZh: 服役中（巴基斯坦空軍主力，緬甸、尼日利亞、阿塞拜疆等國採用）。
history.statusEn: In service (Pakistan Air Force backbone; also flown by Myanmar, Nigeria, Azerbaijan and others).

photo.author: Shimin Gu
photo.creditZh: 相片：Shimin Gu／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 巴基斯坦空軍 JF-17 飛行中
photo.creditEn: Photo: Shimin Gu / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Pakistan Air Force JF-17 in flight
photo.captionZh: 側面飛行：單引擎、邊條翼同翼尖導彈掛架。
photo.captionEn: In flight in profile: single engine, LERX wing and wingtip rails.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：FC1 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 西安 殲轟-7 飛豹戰鬥轟炸機

wings.zh: 中單翼後掠，翼展 12.8 米；翼下掛架多，反艦導彈係招牌外掛。
wings.en: A shoulder-mounted swept wing of 12.8 m span with multiple hardpoints — anti-ship missiles are the signature load.

engines.zh: 兩台渦扇-9 並排貼住機身後段，進氣口喺機身兩側四方框。
engines.en: Two WS-9s hugging the rear fuselage, fed by boxy cheek intakes on the fuselage sides.

fuselage.zh: 機身 22.3 米，串列雙座座艙突出；機頭尖長裝雷達，係海軍對海打擊的長矛。
fuselage.en: A 22.3 m fuselage with a raised tandem cockpit and a long pointed radar nose — the navy's anti-ship spear.

tail.zh: 單大垂尾加腹鰭，全動平尾位置低；尾翼線條似放大版攻擊機。
tail.en: A single tall fin with a ventral strake and low all-moving tailerons — scaled-up attack-jet lines.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the J-16 (AC-0134): both are two-seat strikers, but the JH-7 is an older, less agile naval strike design while the J-16 is a multirole Flanker. Versus the H-6K (AC-0071): the JH-7 is the tactical end of China's strike family, the H-6K the strategic end.
aircraft.similarZh: 同殲-16 比（AC-0134）：同為雙座打擊機，殲轟-7 係上一代、機動較弱嘅海軍打擊設計，殲-16 係多用途側衛。同轟-6K 比（AC-0071）：殲轟-7 係戰術一端，轟-6K 係戰略一端。
aircraft.introEn: China's first home-designed fighter-bomber: a twin-engine naval strike jet (NATO: Flounder) that has carried anti-ship missiles since the 1990s.
aircraft.introZh: 中國第一款自研戰鬥轟炸機：雙引擎海軍打擊機（北約代號「比目魚」），90 年代起掛反艦導彈服役。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Figures are for the improved JH-7A. The photo shows a JH-7A streaming its brake parachute at Chelyabinsk Shagol during a joint exercise.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 數字以改良型殲轟-7A 為準。相片係殲轟-7A 喺聯合演習喺車里雅賓斯克放減速傘降落。

history.statusZh: 服役中（海軍航空兵對海打擊主力之一，逐步由殲-16 接替）。
history.statusEn: In service (a naval strike mainstay, gradually giving way to the J-16).

photo.author: Dmitriy Pichugin
photo.creditZh: 相片：Dmitriy Pichugin／Wikimedia Commons（GFDL 1.2）· 殲轟-7A 喺車里雅賓斯克沙戈爾基地
photo.creditEn: Photo: Dmitriy Pichugin / Wikimedia Commons (GFDL 1.2) · JH-7A at Chelyabinsk Shagol Air Base
photo.captionZh: 降落側面：長機鼻、串列雙座同張開的減速傘。
photo.captionEn: Landing in profile: long nose, tandem cockpit and brake parachute out.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：JH7 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 成都 殲-7 戰鬥機

wings.zh: 三角翼翼展 8.3 米，後期 E 型改雙三角翼，低空一眼認到隻「鉛筆」身形。
wings.en: A delta wing of 8.3 m span (double-delta on the later E) on a pencil-slim fuselage.

engines.zh: 單台渦噴藏喺機身中軸，機鼻中央一支激波錐進氣——米格-21 的招牌。
engines.en: A single turbojet on the centreline fed by the famous nose shock-cone intake inherited from the MiG-21.

fuselage.zh: 機身長而幼，14.9 米幾乎係一支飛行的鉛筆；座艙細小置中前段。
fuselage.en: A long, thin 14.9 m fuselage — a flying pencil — with a small cockpit set ahead of the wing.

tail.zh: 單垂尾加腹鰭，尾翼細細地貼住機身尾段。
tail.en: A single fin with a ventral strake; small tail surfaces tucked at the end of the tube.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the MiG-29 (AC-0114): both Cold War fighters, but the J-7 is the earlier, smaller single-engine MiG-21 branch — China built and evolved it for nearly five decades. The MG21 designator is shared with the MiG-21 family for the same reason.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 MiG-29 比（AC-0114）：同屬冷戰戰機，殲-7 係更早、更細的米格-21 單引擎分支——中國生產同改良咗近五十年。ICAO 代碼同米格-21 共用 MG21，都係呢個原因。
aircraft.introEn: China's MiG-21: licence-built, then endlessly developed for almost 50 years of production — the most-built Chinese fighter, exported around the world.
aircraft.introZh: 中國版米格-21：授權生產起步，自己改良咗近五十年，係產量最高的中國戰機，外銷全球。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Late-production J-7E/G figures are used; early J-7s were near-copies of the MiG-21F-13, so the type shares the MiG-21's ICAO designator MG21. China's production ended in 2013; the PLAAF has retired the type. Photo: a museum J-7I seen from above in Beijing.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 數字以晚期殲-7E/G 為準；早期殲-7 近乎米格-21F-13 副本，故全系同米格-21 共用 ICAO 代碼 MG21。中國 2013 年停產，解放軍已退役。相片係北京軍事博物館的殲-7I 俯瞰。

history.statusZh: 退役中（中國已退役並停產；巴基斯坦、孟加拉等國仍有服役，F-7 出口型廣泛使用）。
history.statusEn: Retiring (out of Chinese service and production; F-7 export versions still fly with Pakistan, Bangladesh and others).

photo.author: Max Smith
photo.creditZh: 相片：Max Smith／Wikimedia Commons（公有領域）· 北京軍事博物館殲-7I 俯瞰
photo.creditEn: Photo: Max Smith / Wikimedia Commons (public domain) · J-7I from above at the Beijing Military Museum
photo.captionZh: 俯瞰全形：三角翼、鉛筆機身同尾翼一目了然。
photo.captionEn: Plan view: delta wing, pencil fuselage and tail in one glance.

aircraft.nameZh: 瀋陽 殲-35 隱身戰鬥機

wings.zh: 梯形翼連翼身融合，邊緣齊線對齊——隱身設計的共同語言；艦載型主翼可摺。
wings.en: A trapezoidal wing blended into the body with aligned edges — the shared stealth language; the naval jet folds its wings.

engines.zh: 兩台引擎收喺機身入面，尾噴管藏喺尾翼之間，減低紅外同雷達特徵。
engines.en: Two buried engines with nozzles tucked between the tail surfaces, trimming IR and radar signatures.

fuselage.zh: 機身約 17.3 米，機腹平滑有內置彈艙；機頭菱形截面加 DSI 進氣口。
fuselage.en: A ~17.3 m fuselage with a smooth belly and internal weapon bay; a faceted nose with DSI intakes.

tail.zh: 外傾雙垂尾加全動平尾，同機翼邊緣互相對齊。
tail.en: Canted twin fins and all-moving tailerons, edge-aligned with the wing.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the J-20 (AC-0057): both Chinese stealth fighters — the J-35 is the smaller twin-engine jet built for carriers and export, the J-20 the larger land-based flagship. Versus the J-15 (AC-0133): the stealth successor now flying from the same decks.
aircraft.similarZh: 同殲-20 比（AC-0057）：同為中國隱身戰機，殲-35 係細一截、為航母同外銷而生的雙引擎機，殲-20 係陸基旗艦。同殲-15 比（AC-0133）：同一批甲板上的隱身接班人。
aircraft.introEn: China's second stealth fighter: a twin-engine jet in carrier (J-35) and land-based (J-35A) forms, developed from the FC-31 demonstrator and introduced in 2025.
aircraft.introZh: 中國第二款隱身戰機：雙引擎，分艦載殲-35 同陸基殲-35A，由 FC-31 驗證機發展，2025 年正式亮相服役。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Nearly all performance data is unpublished; figures are published estimates flagged as such (same treatment as the J-20 card). Doc 8643 has no entry yet, so J35 follows structured references (docs/05). The photo shows a J-35A's weapon-bay belly at Airshow China 2024.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 性能數據幾乎全部未公開，數字屬公開估算並逐項標明（處理方式同殲-20 卡）。Doc 8643 未有登錄，J35 依結構化參考採用（見 docs/05）。相片係 2024 珠海航展殲-35A 機腹彈艙。

history.statusZh: 服役中（2025 年九三閱兵前後正式公布；艦載型喺福建艦電磁彈射，起源 FC-31 於 2012 年首飛）。
history.statusEn: In service (formally unveiled in 2025; the naval model flies EMALS launches from Fujian; its FC-31 ancestor first flew in 2012).

photo.author: Z3144228
photo.creditZh: 相片：Z3144228／Wikimedia Commons（CC0）· 殲-35A 喺 2024 珠海航展
photo.creditEn: Photo: Z3144228 / Wikimedia Commons (CC0) · J-35A at Airshow China 2024
photo.captionZh: 機腹仰望：內置彈艙艙門線、雙噴管同梯形翼。
photo.captionEn: From below: weapon-bay door lines, twin nozzles and trapezoidal wing.

aircraft.nameZh: 昌河 直-10 武裝直升機

wings.zh: 五葉主旋翼直徑 13 米；短翼掛火箭同反坦克導彈，係攻擊型的標誌。
wings.en: A five-blade 13 m main rotor; the stub wings carry rockets and anti-tank missiles — the attack-helicopter badge.

engines.zh: 兩台渦軸-9 並排喺旋翼轂後，排氣口向上／側引減紅外。
engines.en: Two WZ-9 turboshafts behind the rotor hub, with exhausts routed to cut the IR signature.

fuselage.zh: 窄身串列雙座，前低後高階梯座艙；機身 14.2 米，線條硬朗。
fuselage.en: A narrow 14.2 m fuselage with a stepped tandem cockpit — gunner's front seat low, pilot raised behind.

tail.zh: 尾梁幼長，尾旋翼加 X 形尾翼布局（後期型），尾端有垂尾。
tail.en: A slim tail boom with a crossed-tail layout on later models and an endplate fin.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Z-19 (AC-0140): the Z-10 is the bigger, heavier dedicated gunship; the Z-19 is the lighter Z-9-derived scout-attack stablemate. Both fly PLA attack regiments together.
aircraft.similarZh: 同直-19 比（AC-0140）：直-10 係更大、更重的專職武裝型；直-19 係由直-9 發展的輕型偵察攻擊拍檔，兩者一齊喺陸航服役。
aircraft.introEn: China's first dedicated attack helicopter: a tandem-seat gunship in PLA service since around 2009, also exported as the Z-10ME.
aircraft.introZh: 中國第一款專職武裝直升機：串列雙座，約 2009 年起服役陸航，外銷型係直-10ME。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: ICAO lists the type as WZ10 (the Z-10's military designation). Export Z-10ME versions add extra armour and sensors. The photo shows a Z-10 in a flying display at Airshow China 2012.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: ICAO 以軍用代號 WZ10 登錄。本卡相片係 2012 珠海航展飛行表演的直-10；外銷直-10ME 加強裝甲同感測器。

history.statusZh: 服役中（陸軍航空兵主力武裝直升機，巴基斯坦已採購 ME 型）。
history.statusEn: In service (the PLA ground force's main attack helicopter; Pakistan has bought the ME export model).

photo.author: Peng Chen
photo.creditZh: 相片：Peng Chen／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 2.0）· 直-10 喺 2012 珠海航展
photo.creditEn: Photo: Peng Chen / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) · Z-10 at Airshow China 2012
photo.captionZh: 前側面飛行：串列座艙、短翼武器掛架同五葉旋翼。
photo.captionEn: Front-quarter in flight: tandem cockpit, weapon stub wings and five-blade rotor.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：WZ10 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 哈爾濱 直-19 偵察攻擊直升機

wings.zh: 四葉主旋翼直徑 11.9 米，沿用直-9 的動力系統；短翼掛反坦克導彈。
wings.en: A four-blade 11.9 m rotor on the Z-9's proven drivetrain; stub wings carry anti-tank missiles.

engines.zh: 兩台渦軸-8C 收喺機艙頂，排氣加紅外抑制罩。
engines.en: Two WZ-8C turboshafts above the cabin with IR-suppressed exhausts.

fuselage.zh: 窄身串列座艙重新設計，機身 12 米；機鼻有光電轉塔，成架比直-9 瘦得多。
fuselage.en: A redesigned narrow tandem fuselage of 12 m with a nose sensor turret — far slimmer than the Z-9 it springs from.

tail.zh: 涵道尾旋翼藏喺大垂尾入面，係直-9 家族留落嚟的招牌。
tail.en: The fenestron shrouded tail rotor inside a big fin — the inherited Z-9 family signature.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Z-9 (AC-0041): the same Dauphin-derived drivetrain and fenestron, but the Z-19 swaps the utility cabin for a narrow tandem gunship body. Versus the Z-10 (AC-0139): the lighter scout-attack partner to the heavier gunship.
aircraft.similarZh: 同直-9 比（AC-0041）：同一套海豚系動力同涵道尾槳，但直-19 將通用機艙換成窄身串列武裝機體。同直-10 比（AC-0139）：輕型偵察攻擊拍檔，重火力嗰位係直-10。
aircraft.introEn: A light scout-attack helicopter spun out of the Z-9: tandem seats and a fenestron, flying recce and anti-tank missions for the PLA.
aircraft.introZh: 由直-9 衍生的輕型偵察攻擊機：串列雙座加涵道尾槳，為陸航做偵察同反坦克任務。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Doc 8643 has no Z-19 page; Z19 follows structured references (docs/05). The photo shows a Z-19 making a low pass at Airshow China 2012.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: Doc 8643 未有直-19 頁面，Z19 依結構化參考採用（見 docs/05）。相片係直-19 喺 2012 珠海航展低空通場。

history.statusZh: 服役中（陸軍航空兵偵察攻擊主力之一，同直-10 高低搭配）。
history.statusEn: In service (a PLA scout-attack mainstay, paired with the heavier Z-10).

photo.author: Alert5
photo.creditZh: 相片：Alert5／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 直-19 喺 2012 珠海航展
photo.creditEn: Photo: Alert5 / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Z-19 at Airshow China 2012
photo.captionZh: 側面低空飛行：串列座艙、武器短翼同涵道尾槳。
photo.captionEn: Low pass in profile: tandem cockpit, weapon wings and fenestron.

aircraft.nameZh: 哈爾濱 直-20 通用直升機

length.noteZh: 全長（旋翼轉動，外界估算）

seats.noteZh: 2 名機員 + 約 12 名士兵（估算）

wings.zh: 五葉主旋翼（黑鷹四葉，佢多一片），直徑約 16 米；機身側可加短翼掛載。
wings.en: A five-blade main rotor of about 16 m — one blade more than the Black Hawk — with optional stub wings.

engines.zh: 兩台國產渦軸-10 並排機頂，高原性能係設計重點。
engines.en: Two Chinese WZ-10 turboshafts side by side on top; high-altitude performance was a design priority.

fuselage.zh: 方正機艙、平直機底；外形似黑鷹但線條更新——尾輪位置同座艙窗都唔同。
fuselage.en: A boxy cabin with a flat belly; Black Hawk-like at a glance, but the tailwheel position and window lines differ.

tail.zh: 尾梁向後收，尾旋翼喺左側，垂尾連水平安定面；艦載型尾梁可摺。
tail.en: A tapered boom with a left-side tail rotor and canted stabiliser; naval models fold the tail.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the S-92 (AC-0110): both are 10-tonne-class utility helicopters, but the Z-20 is a slimmer Black Hawk-sized military design. Versus the Z-8 (AC-0052): the older, bigger three-engine type the Z-20 is steadily succeeding.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 S-92 比（AC-0110）：同屬十噸級通用直升機，直-20 係修長啲、黑鷹尺寸的軍用設計。同直-8 比（AC-0052）：直-8 係更大型的三引擎前輩，直-20 正逐步接班。
aircraft.introEn: China's 10-tonne utility helicopter: a Black Hawk-class machine with five-blade rotor and Chinese engines, now the PLA's standard medium lift on land and sea.
aircraft.introZh: 中國十噸級通用直升機：黑鷹級別、五葉旋翼、國產引擎，係解放軍海陸標準中型運輸直升機。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Performance data is largely unpublished; figures are published estimates flagged as such. Doc 8643 has no Z-20 page; Z20 follows structured references (docs/05). The photo shows a PLA Z-20 lifting off at Airshow China 2022 (China News Service footage).
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 性能數據多未公開，數字屬公開估算並逐項標明。Doc 8643 未有直-20 頁面，Z20 依結構化參考採用（見 docs/05）。相片係 2022 珠海航展直-20 起飛（中國新聞社片段）。

history.statusZh: 服役中（2019 年國慶閱兵首次公開，陸海空同武警廣泛裝備）。
history.statusEn: In service (publicly unveiled at the 2019 National Day parade; widely fielded by ground, naval, air and police forces).

photo.author: China News Service
photo.creditZh: 相片：中國新聞社／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY 4.0）· 直-20 喺 2022 珠海航展
photo.creditEn: Photo: China News Service / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY 4.0) · Z-20 at Airshow China 2022
photo.captionZh: 起飛側面：五葉旋翼、方正機艙同尾輪布局。
photo.captionEn: Lifting off in profile: five-blade rotor, boxy cabin and tailwheel gear.

aircraft.nameZh: 洪都 L-15／教-10 獵鷹高級教練機

wings.zh: 後掠翼連大邊條，翼展 9.5 米；外形似迷你戰鬥機，唔似傳統教練機。
wings.en: A swept wing with big LERXes at 9.5 m span — it looks like a miniature fighter, not a school bus.

engines.zh: 兩台帶後燃渦扇並排尾段，令佢有超音速能力，同級教練機少有。
engines.en: Twin afterburning turbofans in the tail give it supersonic dash — rare in its class.

fuselage.zh: 機身 12.3 米，串列雙座大泡型艙蓋；機頭可裝雷達（攻擊型）。
fuselage.en: A 12.3 m fuselage with a big tandem bubble canopy; attack versions fit a radar in the nose.

tail.zh: 雙腹鰭加全動平尾，單垂尾；尾翼布局向四代機睇齊。
tail.en: Twin ventral fins, all-moving tailerons and a single fin — fourth-generation manners.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the K-8 (AC-0143): the two Hongdu trainers bookend the syllabus — the subsonic single-engine K-8 for basic jet training, the twin-engine supersonic L-15/JL-10 for the final step before fighters.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 K-8 比（AC-0143）：洪都兩款教練機包辦課程兩端——單引擎亞音速 K-8 打基礎，雙引擎超音速 L-15／教-10 做上戰機前最後一級。
aircraft.introEn: China's supersonic advanced trainer: a twin-engine jet (JL-10 at home, L-15 for export) that takes pilots the last step to front-line fighters.
aircraft.introZh: 中國超音速高級教練機：雙引擎噴射（國內稱教-10、外銷稱 L-15），係飛行員上前線戰機前最後一站。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Export L-15s and PLAAF JL-10s differ in engines and fit; the L-15A/B attack versions add radar and weapons. The photo shows a JL-10 on static display at Zhuhai 2024.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 外銷 L-15 同解放軍教-10 喺引擎同設備上有別；L-15A/B 攻擊型加雷達同武器。相片係教-10 喺 2024 珠海航展地面展示。

history.statusZh: 服役中（解放軍高級教練主力，阿聯酋、贊比亞等國採用外銷型）。
history.statusEn: In service (the PLAAF's advanced trainer; export aircraft serve the UAE, Zambia and others).

photo.author: Z3144228
photo.creditZh: 相片：Z3144228／Wikimedia Commons（CC0）· 教-10 喺 2024 珠海航展
photo.creditEn: Photo: Z3144228 / Wikimedia Commons (CC0) · JL-10 at Airshow China 2024
photo.captionZh: 地面前側面：大泡型座艙、邊條翼同紅色進氣口警示。
photo.captionEn: Front-quarter on the ground: bubble canopy, LERX wing and red intake warnings.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：L15 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 洪都 K-8 喀喇崑崙教練機

wings.zh: 平直下單翼，翼展 9.6 米；翼下四個掛點可帶火箭同炸彈做輕攻。
wings.en: A straight low wing of 9.6 m span with four underwing hardpoints for light-attack stores.

engines.zh: 單台渦扇收喺後機身，兩側細進氣口；出口型用美製 TFE731。
engines.en: A single turbofan buried in the rear fuselage with small cheek intakes; exports use the US TFE731.

fuselage.zh: 機身 11.6 米，串列雙座艙蓋長；線條簡單，係典型中級教練機比例。
fuselage.en: An 11.6 m fuselage with a long tandem canopy — textbook intermediate-trainer proportions.

tail.zh: 單垂尾加低置平尾，尾翼細而工整，方便訓練飛行。
tail.en: A single fin with a low tailplane — small, neat surfaces for forgiving training manners.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the L-15 (AC-0142): the K-8 is the earlier, subsonic step on the same Hongdu training ladder. Versus the CJ-6 (AC-0144): the jet that takes over after the piston primary trainer.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 L-15 比（AC-0142）：K-8 係同一條洪都訓練階梯較早、亞音速的一級。同初教-6 比（AC-0144）：活塞初教之後接上的噴射一級。
aircraft.introEn: The China-Pakistan basic jet trainer: a simple, rugged single-engine jet (JL-8 at home) exported to air forces across Asia, Africa and South America.
aircraft.introZh: 中巴合作基礎噴射教練機：簡單可靠的單引擎設計（國內稱教-8），外銷亞非拉多國空軍。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: Export K-8s use the Honeywell TFE731; Chinese JL-8s use the WS-11. The photo shows a Bangladesh Air Force K-8W in display colours at Dhaka.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 外銷 K-8 用 Honeywell TFE731，國內教-8 用渦扇-11。相片係孟加拉空軍 K-8W 表演塗裝喺達卡。

history.statusZh: 服役中（十多國空軍基礎教練主力，產量數百架）。
history.statusEn: In service (the basic jet trainer of a dozen-plus air forces; several hundred built).

photo.author: Md Shaifuzzaman Ayon
photo.creditZh: 相片：Md Shaifuzzaman Ayon／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 孟加拉空軍 K-8W 喺達卡
photo.creditEn: Photo: Md Shaifuzzaman Ayon / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Bangladesh Air Force K-8W at Dhaka
photo.captionZh: 側面：平直翼、串列座艙同表演塗裝。
photo.captionEn: In profile: straight wing, tandem canopy and display colours.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：K8 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 南昌 初教-6 初級教練機

wings.zh: 平直下單翼略帶上反角，翼展 10.2 米；外形係五六十年代教練機的標準樣。
wings.en: A straight, slightly dihedralled low wing of 10.2 m — the standard 1950s trainer silhouette.

engines.zh: 一台星形活塞引擎藏喺圓機鼻入面，兩葉槳；氣冷缸頭喺整流罩邊隱約見到。
engines.en: A radial piston engine in a round cowling with a two-blade propeller; cylinder heads peek from the cowl flaps.

fuselage.zh: 機身 8.5 米，串列雙座艙蓋分兩格；半硬殼結構簡單耐用。
fuselage.en: An 8.5 m fuselage with a two-piece tandem canopy; simple, tough semi-monocoque construction.

tail.zh: 垂尾圓潤、平尾低置，尾輪式起落架（可收）令機鼻微微仰起。
tail.en: A rounded fin and low tailplane; the retractable tailwheel gear leaves the nose sitting slightly high.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the K-8 (AC-0143): the piston first step before the jet trainer in PLA service. Abroad it is often compared with the Yak-18 it outlived — and it is now a favourite warbird far beyond China.
aircraft.similarZh: 同 K-8 比（AC-0143）：解放軍訓練階梯入面，活塞初教行先、噴射教練跟後。外國常將佢同 Yak-18 比——佢命更長，今日仲係全球熱門的古董戰機（warbird）。
aircraft.introEn: China's radial-engine primary trainer since 1958: over 2,000 built to school PLA pilots, and now a beloved warbird on the civil market worldwide.
aircraft.introZh: 1958 年起服役的星形引擎初級教練機：產量逾 2,000 架，教出幾代解放軍飛行員，今日係全球民用市場的寵兒古董機。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: The CJ-6A (285 hp HS-6A) is the main production model; China developed it independently after Soviet Yak-18 plans fell through. The photo shows a US-registered civil CJ-6 in Maryland.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 初教-6A（285 匹活塞-6甲）係主力量產型；蘇聯 Yak-18 圖紙告吹後中國自行完成設計。相片係美國註冊的民用初教-6 喺馬里蘭州。

history.statusZh: 服役中／退役中（解放軍逐步退役，民用 warbird 市場大量飛行，全球現役數百架）。
history.statusEn: In service / retiring (leaving PLA service, but hundreds fly on as civil warbirds worldwide).

photo.author: Acroterion
photo.creditZh: 相片：Acroterion／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 初教-6 喺美國馬里蘭州 Frederick 機場
photo.creditEn: Photo: Acroterion / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · CJ-6 at Frederick Municipal Airport, Maryland
photo.captionZh: 正面：圓形引擎罩、兩葉槳同平直主翼。
photo.captionEn: Head-on: round cowling, two-blade propeller and straight wing.

deepLinks.labelZh: ICAO Doc 8643 經 doc8643.com：CJ6 代碼頁

aircraft.nameZh: 成都 翼龍 II 無人攻擊機

payload.noteZh: 外掛載荷（另有內部載荷）

range.noteZh: 作戰半徑（衛星通訊可延伸）

cruise.noteZh: 最高速度（續航約 32 小時）

wings.zh: 長直中單翼翼展 20.5 米，翼端小翼向上；長航時靠佢慢慢巡航。
wings.en: A long straight mid wing of 20.5 m span with upturned winglets — built for slow, long endurance.

engines.zh: 單台渦槳裝喺機尾向後推，槳葉喺 V 尾之間——無人機的常見布局。
engines.en: A single pusher turboprop at the tail, its propeller spinning between the V-tail — the classic MALE UAV layout.

fuselage.zh: 機身 11 米，機鼻球狀衛星天線罩特別搶眼；機腹有光電轉塔。
fuselage.en: An 11 m fuselage with a bulbous satellite-antenna nose and an electro-optical turret under the chin.

tail.zh: 下反 V 形尾翼（後期型改三片式），尾翼兼做起落架保護。
tail.en: A downward V-tail (three-surface on later models) that doubles as ground-clearance protection.

aircraft.similarEn: Versus the Wing Loong I generation before it: bigger, heavier and able to carry a dozen weapons. In role it is China's counterpart to the MQ-9 class — long-endurance surveillance plus precision strike, flown by remote crew.
aircraft.similarZh: 同上一代翼龍 I 比：更大更重，可掛十多件武器。角色上係中國版 MQ-9 級別——長航時偵察加精確打擊，由地面站遙控飛行。
aircraft.introEn: China's MALE strike drone: a satellite-controlled, 32-hour-endurance UAV exported across the Middle East, Africa and Asia (GJ-2 in PLA service).
aircraft.introZh: 中國中空長航時無人攻擊機：衛星遙控、續航 32 小時（解放軍稱攻-2），外銷中東、非洲同亞洲多國。
aircraft.variantNoteEn: No ICAO Doc 8643 designator has been assigned to the type, so the card shows '—' (the same treatment as the Wright Flyer). Military GJ-2s and export Wing Loong IIs share the airframe. The photo shows a Wing Loong II on static display at the 2017 Dubai Airshow.
aircraft.variantNoteZh: 本型未獲編配 ICAO Doc 8643 代碼，卡面以「—」如實標示（處理方式同 Wright Flyer）。軍用攻-2 同外銷翼龍 II 共用機體。相片係翼龍 II 喺 2017 杜拜航展地面展示。

history.statusZh: 服役中（解放軍攻-2 及多國外銷用戶，中國無人機外銷主力）。
history.statusEn: In service (as the PLA's GJ-2 and with many export customers; China's flagship UAV export).

photo.author: Mztourist
photo.creditZh: 相片：Mztourist／Wikimedia Commons（CC BY-SA 4.0）· 翼龍 II 喺 2017 杜拜航展
photo.creditEn: Photo: Mztourist / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0) · Wing Loong II at Dubai Airshow 2017
photo.captionZh: 側面靜態展示：球形機鼻、長直翼同 V 尾，前面陳列掛載武器。
photo.captionEn: Static side view: bulbous nose, long straight wing and V-tail, weapons laid out ahead.
